title: A self-adaptive tube restraint for free-energy calculations along path collective variables
summary: Path collective variables (PCVs) reduce a high-dimensional transition to a progress coordinate, s, and an orthogonal distance, z. Computing the free energy along s often requires restraining z, so that sampling embraces a tube centered on the reference path. However, a conventional fixed half-harmonic wall demands an a priori tube width that is both system dependent and s-dependent. Too tight a tube biases the path-projected free energy. Conversely, too loose a tube induces numerical instability and inter-channel leakage. We present an adaptive tube restraint the half-width of which evolves on the fly to track a fixed contour ΔF* of the orthogonal free energy F(z|s), widening automatically in flat basins and narrowing at pinched saddles, with minimalist user intervention. We prove that, for a locally harmonic perpendicular well, a contour-following tube captures an s-independent fraction of the orthogonal partition function, so that in the hard-wall limit, its bias cancels out. In stark contrast, the bias of a fixed-width tube varies with s and distorts the free-energy landscape. We probe the algorithm on several model potentials, on N-Acetyl-N'-methylalanylamide isomerization, on the folding of the mini-protein chignolin, and on the folding-upon-binding of the ribose-binding protein. The method is implemented in the open-source Colvars library, and is, therefore, usable within popular MD engines, such as NAMD, LAMMPS, GROMACS, and Tinker-HP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应路径集合变量（PCV）的管状约束方法，能够动态调整管宽以追踪正交自由能的固定等高线，自动在平坦盆地拓宽、在狭窄鞍点收窄，从而消除固定管宽带来的自由能偏差，并通过多个模型和生物分子体系验证了其有效性与通用性。
AI.motivation: 传统PCV方法中，固定半谐振壁约束需要预设与体系和坐标相关的管宽：管过窄会偏置自由能，过宽则导致数值不稳定和通道间渗漏。因此需要一种无需人工干预的自适应管约束方法。
AI.method: 提出自适应管约束，其半宽度在模拟过程中动态演化，追踪正交自由能F(z|s)的固定等高线ΔF*；在局部谐振垂直阱假设下，证明等高线跟随管可捕获与s无关的正交配分函数比例，从而在硬壁极限下消除偏差。
AI.result: 在多个模型势能、N-乙酰基-N'-甲基丙氨酰胺异构化、mini-蛋白chignolin折叠以及核糖结合蛋白的折叠-结合过程中验证了方法有效性。结果表明自适应管能自动调整宽度，消除固定管宽导致的自由能景观扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 该方法已集成于开源Colvars库，可在NAMD、LAMMPS、GROMACS、Tinker-HP等主流分子动力学引擎中使用，具有很好的通用性和实用性。

title: Auditing Haldane Consistency in Reversible Enzyme Kinetics: A Curated Two-Sided Backbone and a Labeled Fold-Error Benchmark
comment: 50 pages, 8 figures, supplementary material and reproducibility code/data included as ancillary files
summary: Reversible enzyme kinetic constants can be audited through the Haldane relation: the apparent equilibrium constant implied by the rate law should match biochemical thermodynamics under matched conditions. We use the reciprocal cost $C_{\mathrm{Haldane}}=J(K'_{\mathrm{eq,kin}}/K'_{\mathrm{eq,thermo}})$, with $J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1=\cosh(\ln x)-1$, as a calibrated, direction-symmetric reporting scale. The score is zero at agreement, penalizes reciprocal over- and underestimates equally, encodes the free-energy discrepancy in $RT$ units, and ranks records identically to $|ΔΔG|$; the contribution is therefore biochemical curation, a reproducible workflow, and fold-error calibration rather than a new ordering. We apply the score to a curated demonstration set and, under prespecified inclusion criteria, assemble a two-sided backbone of twenty-one audited single-study records. Eight genuinely independent tests pair kinetics fit without a thermodynamic prior against separately measured equilibria; all eight fall within twofold (maximum $C_{\mathrm{Haldane}}=0.069$), although this remains a feasibility demonstration. Across the full backbone, eighteen records fall within twofold and three are flagged. The backbone is concentrated in carbohydrate isomerases and epimerases, so these results are within-family observations. Because real records carry no ground-truth labels, a semi-synthetic benchmark (twenty-nine within-twofold seeds, $1{,}885$ injected known-error cases) quantifies detectability: AUC $0.784$ ($95\%$ bootstrap CI $0.725$--$0.838$), conditional on the injected error taxonomy and invariant under monotone rescaling of $|\ln x|$. All data, code, protocol, and benchmark generator are archived for exact reproduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Haldane关系的成本函数 $C_{\mathrm{Haldane}}$，用于审计可逆酶促反应的动力学常数与热力学平衡常数的一致性，并在半合成基准测试中验证了其可检测性（AUC 0.784）。
AI.motivation: 可逆酶促反应的动力学常数应满足Haldane关系，但现有研究中动力学与热力学数据常存在不一致，缺乏统一的量化审计和报告标准。
AI.method: 定义 $C_{\mathrm{Haldane}}=J(K'_{\mathrm{eq,kin}}/K'_{\mathrm{eq,thermo}})$，其中 $J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1$，该指标零分表示一致，对高低估计对称惩罚，反映自由能差异（以 $RT$ 为单位）。通过半合成基准（含1885个已知错误案例）评估检测能力。
AI.result: 对21个经审计的单研究记录进行测试，8个独立检验均落在两倍误差内（最大 $C_{\mathrm{Haldane}}=0.069$）；18个记录在两倍误差内，3个被标记。半合成基准AUC为0.784。
AI.conclusion: 该指标提供了一种可复现、方向对称的审计工具，能有效量化动力学-热力学一致性，但当前结果仍限于碳水化合物异构酶/差向异构酶家族，属于可行性论证。

title: Chemical applicability of $π$-Sombor index
summary: The Sombor index ($SO$) and the modified Sombor index (${}^m SO$) are two closely related vertex-degree-based graph invariants. Both were introduced in the early 2020s and have found diverse applications in chemical, physicochemical, and network-theoretical studies. In 2023, the $π$-Sombor index was introduced as the product $SO \cdot {}^m SO$, with an initial focus on its fundamental mathematical properties. However, its potential chemical applicability has remained unexplored. In the present work, we address this gap by employing regression models to analyze the $π$-Sombor index in 22 benzenoid hydrocarbons. This study investigates the chemical significance of the $π$-Sombor index through curvilinear regression analysis against the physicochemical properties of these hydrocarbons.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了π-Sombor指数（SO与改进SO指数的乘积）在22种苯类碳氢化合物中的化学应用，通过曲线回归分析发现其与理化性质存在显著相关性。
AI.motivation: π-Sombor指数自2023年提出后，其数学性质已被研究，但化学应用潜力尚未探索。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用曲线回归模型，对22种苯类碳氢化合物的π-Sombor指数与其理化性质进行回归分析。
AI.result: π-Sombor指数与苯类碳氢化合物的理化性质之间存在显著的相关性。
AI.conclusion: π-Sombor指数在化学领域具有应用价值，可作为预测苯类碳氢化合物理化性质的有效指标。

title: Improving Jet A-1 Thermal-Oxidative Stability through Selective Removal of Unwanted Trace Species via 3.7 Å Chabazite Filtration
summary: The thermal stability of Jet A-1 fuel is strongly affected by trace heteroatomic species that promote thermal oxidative deposit formation, as well as antioxidant additives such as butylated hydroxytoluene, which preserve fuel stability. 3.7 Å chabazite is a tunable microporous adsorbent, but optimizing its composition requires balancing promoter removal against antioxidant loss. Here, we use density functional theory and \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics (AIMD) to evaluate this trade-off using two compositional descriptors: framework acidity (Si/Al $= 35$--$8$) and bimetallic substitution (Co, Mg, Zn) at fixed Al content. Lowering Si/Al strengthens adsorption of all species, including BHT, confirming an intrinsic selectivity penalty for acidity-only tuning. In contrast, bimetallic substitution introduces chemically selective behavior, strengthening uptake of specific promoters while either suppressing or enhancing antioxidant adsorption depending on dopant identity. AIMD simulations at 400 K further show that adsorption energy alone is insufficient to describe calculated trends, because molecular mobility inside chabazite can influence residence time and effective capture during fuel treatment. Analysis of the density of states and the participating wavefunctions reveals signatures that are consistent with dopant-dependent adsorption shifts. These results establish a unified adsorption--transport--electronic screening framework for selecting chabazite compositions that remove deposit promoters while preserving antioxidant functionality in Jet A-1 treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT和AIMD模拟，系统研究了3.7 Å菱沸石（chabazite）的组成（Si/Al比和双金属取代）对Jet A-1燃料中热氧化沉积促进剂与抗氧化添加剂BHT吸附选择性的影响，建立了吸附-传输-电子结构的统一筛选框架。
AI.motivation: Jet A-1燃料的热稳定性受痕量杂原子物种（促进沉积）和抗氧化添加剂（如BHT）的共同影响。菱沸石作为可调微孔吸附剂，其组成优化需平衡去除沉积促进剂与保留抗氧化剂之间的矛盾，但目前缺乏系统的筛选准则。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）和从头算分子动力学（AIMD），以两个组成描述符（Si/Al比从35到8的酸度变化，以及固定Al含量下的Co、Mg、Zn双金属取代）评估吸附选择性。计算了吸附能、400K下的分子迁移率、态密度及参与波函数分析。
AI.result: 降低Si/Al比会同时增强所有物种（包括BHT）的吸附，确认了仅调变酸度存在固有的选择性损失。双金属取代则引入化学选择性行为：根据掺杂剂种类，可增强特定促进剂的吸附，同时抑制或增强BHT的吸附。AIMD表明仅靠吸附能不足以描述趋势，分子迁移率影响有效捕获。态密度和波函数分析揭示了与掺杂相关的吸附偏移特征。
AI.conclusion: 建立了统一的吸附-传输-电子结构筛选框架，用于选择可在Jet A-1处理中去除沉积促进剂同时保留抗氧化剂功能的菱沸石组成。

title: Theoretical investigation of power absorbed by superconductors with Rashba spin-orbit coupling in the presence external time-dependent perturbation
summary: The absorbed power in superconductors driven by a time-dependent external perturbation is investigated through transitions between Bogoliubov quasiparticle states. The transition matrix element contains the superconducting coherence factor, which determines the role of the gap, excitation spectrum, and external frequency in the absorption process. The formulation is applied to a Hubbard-model superconductor including correlated hopping and Rashba spin-orbit coupling. In this model, numerical calculations are used to obtain the quasiparticle energies, density of states, chemical potential, and temperature-dependent superconducting gap. The normalized absorbed power is then evaluated for different values of temperature, interaction strength, correlated hopping parameter, and spin-orbit coupling strength. The results show that the absorption response is strongly affected by the superconducting gap and by changes in the quasiparticle spectrum. Rashba spin-orbit coupling changes the density of states and therefore modifies the absorption. These results show that hopping processes, interaction strength, and spin-orbit coupling play important roles in the ultrasonic and electromagnetic absorption of superconducting systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超导体在外界扰动下的吸收功率，通过Bogoliubov准粒子跃迁机制，分析了超导相干因子、能隙、激发谱和驱动频率对吸收过程的影响，并应用于含关联跳跃和Rashba自旋-轨道耦合的Hubbard模型超导体中。
AI.motivation: 探究超导体在时间依赖外部扰动下的能量吸收机制，特别是超导相干因子以及不同物理参数（温度、相互作用强度、关联跳跃、自旋-轨道耦合）对吸收功率的影响。
AI.method: 基于Bogoliubov准粒子态之间的跃迁理论，推导包含超导相干因子的跃迁矩阵元；在Hubbard模型框架下引入关联跳跃和Rashba自旋-轨道耦合，通过数值计算获得准粒子能谱、态密度、化学势和温度依赖的超导能隙，进而计算归一化吸收功率。
AI.result: 超导能隙和准粒子谱的变化显著影响吸收响应；Rashba自旋-轨道耦合通过改变态密度来修正吸收行为；跳跃过程、相互作用强度和自旋-轨道耦合对超导体系的超声和电磁吸收均起重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 跳跃过程、相互作用强度和自旋-轨道耦合在超导体系的超声和电磁吸收中扮演重要角色，该研究为理解相关超导材料的吸收特性提供了理论依据。

title: CodeJeNN: A simple C++ neural network generator for physics applications
summary: Machine learning has shown speedups for numerical methods in physics applications, but integrating Python-based libraries into high-performance C++ solvers creates performance bottlenecks. We present CodeJeNN, which bridges this gap by auto-generating self-contained C++ code from trained Keras models for inference. This eliminates external dependencies through minimal inlined functions, allowing seamless integration into existing frameworks. We describe the Keras-to-C++ workflow, supported architectures, and limitations. CodeJeNN is demonstrated through inference benchmarks against Keras in eager and JIT modes and a CFD test case modeling viscosity in a hydrogen-air mixing layer, showing speedups without sacrificing accuracy.

AI.tldr: CodeJeNN是一个能从训练好的Keras模型自动生成独立C++推理代码的工具，消除了外部依赖，在物理模拟中相比Keras实现了加速且不损失精度。
AI.motivation: 将基于Python的机器学习库集成到高性能C++求解器中存在严重的性能瓶颈，需要一种桥接方案来兼顾机器学习的能力和C++的执行效率。
AI.method: 提出CodeJeNN工具，从训练好的Keras模型中自动生成自包含的C++推理代码，使用极简内联函数消除外部依赖，支持多种网络架构。
AI.result: 在推理基准测试中（对比Keras的eager和JIT模式）以及CFD测试案例（氢-空气混合层的粘度建模）中，CodeJeNN实现了加速且不损失精度。
AI.conclusion: CodeJeNN能够有效桥接Python机器学习库与高性能C++求解器之间的性能鸿沟，适用于物理模拟等计算密集型应用场景。

title: Correlation-Induced Topological Reconstruction in a Periodically Driven Kagome Mott Insulator
summary: We study the interplay between electronic correlations and circularly polarized periodic driving in the Hubbard model on a Kagome lattice. Using Brillouin-Wigner perturbation theory, we derive an effective Floquet Hamiltonian in which the drive renormalizes the bare hopping and generates chiral nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor terms, producing repeated topological transitions and a flat band whose position is continuously tunable across the spectrum. Within slave-rotor mean-field theory, we show that the resulting Mott transition is strongly non-monotonic in the drive amplitude, yielding repeated metal-insulator transitions, and that the spinon excitations inside the Mott phase acquire a band topology distinct from that of the non-interacting Floquet bands. This correlation-driven topological reconstruction produces emergent flat-band spinon insulators inaccessible to either driving or interactions alone. Our results establish periodically driven Kagome systems as a platform for engineering correlated topological flat-band physics out of equilibrium, with proposed realizations in ultracold atomic lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Kagome晶格Hubbard模型在周期性驱动下的电子关联与拓扑性质，发现驱动可调谐平带并产生重复金属-绝缘体转变，且关联效应可重构拓扑，产生仅驱动或仅相互作用无法实现的拓扑自旋子绝缘体。
AI.motivation: 探索周期性驱动与强电子关联在Kagome晶格中的协同效应，旨在实现平衡态无法得到的可调谐拓扑平带物理。
AI.method: 使用Brillouin-Wigner微扰理论推导有效Floquet哈密顿量，结合slave-rotor平均场理论分析Mott转变和自旋子能带拓扑。
AI.result: 驱动可调谐平带位置并诱导重复拓扑相变；Mott转变呈强烈非单调性，出现重复金属-绝缘体转变；Mott相中自旋子激发具有与无相互作用Floquet能带不同的拓扑结构，产生涌现的平带自旋子绝缘体。
AI.conclusion: 周期性驱动的Kagome体系可作为工程化关联拓扑平带物理的非平衡平台，在超冷原子晶格中有潜在实现。

title: Non-equilibrium coupling to a diffusing density breaks Ising universality
summary: The Ising universality class is remarkably robust to non-equilibrium perturbations, which generically flow to zero under renormalization. We show that this robustness fails when an order parameter is coupled nonreciprocally to a conserved diffusive density. Below $d_c=4$, the renormalization group flows to a fast-diffusion fixed point at which the density acts as a long-range multiplicative noise, producing a novel universality class. The non-equilibrium nature of the fixed point is manifest in the large-scale violation of the fluctuation-dissipation relations, reflected in a splitting of the scaling exponents of the two-point correlation and response functions--a measurable hallmark of non-equilibrium critical fluctuations. A two-loop calculation establishes the stability of this fixed point but yields a small correction-to-scaling exponent $ω\approx0.020$ in $d=3$, implying strong finite-size corrections. An all-orders modified Harris criterion $ν>2/(d+z-2)$ confirms that the BIM fixed point governs criticality in $d=3$, with Ising universality recovered only at $d=2$.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了Ising普适类在非互易耦合守恒扩散场时失去鲁棒性，在d<4维度下涌现出新的非平衡普适类，其特征为快扩散不动点、长程乘性噪声和涨落-耗散定理的破坏。
AI.motivation: 传统认为Ising普适类对非平衡扰动具有高度鲁棒性，但作者质疑这一结论在序参量与非互易守恒密度耦合时是否仍然成立，旨在探索新的非平衡临界现象。
AI.method: 采用重整化群分析，结合双圈微扰计算，并引入修正的Harris判据（ν>2/(d+z-2)）来验证不动点的稳定性与临界维度。
AI.result: 在d<4时，RG流流向快扩散不动点，两粒子关联和响应函数的标度指数发生分裂（涨落-耗散定理破坏），且d=3时修正标度指数ω≈0.020，导致显著的有限尺寸效应。
AI.conclusion: 该双线性（BIM）不动点在d=3时主导临界行为，而Ising普适类仅在d=2时恢复，表明非互易耦合可从根本上改变临界普适类。

title: Anisotropic magnetoresistance of 2D Rashba films with in-plane Zeeman field and short-range disorder
comment: 12 pages of main text, 8 pages of Supplementary information, 1 Figure
summary: We study the dc conductivity of a continuum two-dimensional Rashba film with an in-plane Zeeman field and delta-correlated scalar disorder. Although the field deforms the two helicity Fermi contours and rotates the spin texture, it does not produce anisotropic magnetoresistance in the leading quasiclassical conductivity. The mechanism is geometric. A density Ward identity fixes the spin-vector part of the Born self-energy to the derivative of the total particle density with respect to the field. This derivative vanishes, because the total area enclosed by the two Rashba-Zeeman sheets is independent of the in-plane field. The Born self-energy is therefore scalar and field independent, and the quasiparticle lifetime stays isotropic. The same area invariance controls transport: once the leading impurity ladder reduces the current vertex to the parabolic velocity, the diagonal intraband Kubo conductivity collapses onto the two-sheet occupied area and is field independent as well. The result settles the short-range-disorder quasiclassical problem: point-like nonmagnetic impurities do not produce AMR in this model. A nonzero AMR requires physics beyond this quasiclassical short-range-disorder mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有面内塞曼场和短程无序的二维Rashba薄膜的直流电导率，发现面内磁场不会导致各向异性磁电阻（AMR），因为总粒子密度不依赖于面内场，准粒子寿命保持各向同性，电导率也不受场影响。
AI.motivation: 探究二维Rashba体系在面内塞曼场下的直流电导率行为，特别是验证是否存在各向异性磁电阻效应。
AI.method: 采用准经典理论分析，通过密度Ward恒等式推导Born自能，结合杂质阶梯图约化电流顶点，计算带内Kubo电导率。
AI.result: 面内磁场不产生各向异性磁电阻；Born自能为标量且与场无关；准粒子寿命各向同性；Kubo电导率与场无关。
AI.conclusion: 短程非磁性杂质在此模型中不会导致AMR，出现AMR需要超越准经典短程无序的物理机制。

title: High-Entropy Nitride Photocatalysts for Visible-Light Antibiotic Degradation: Structural Stability, In Situ Interfacial Visualization, and Molecular-Level Mechanistic Insights
summary: High-entropy nitrides (HENs) have emerged as a promising class of advanced materials with tunable electronic structures, high stability, and abundant active sites. The incorporation of nitrogen enhances visible-light absorption, promotes efficient charge separation, and improves structural robustness, making these materials highly suitable for photocatalytic applications. In this study, (MnFeCoNiCu)N-based HEN nanoparticles (NPs) were synthesized as visible-light-assisted photocatalysts for the degradation of antibiotics, including sulfamethoxazole (SME) and tetracycline (TCL). The catalyst exhibited excellent performance, achieving 96% degradation of SME and 94% removal of TCL within 2 h of visible-light irradiation. The photocatalytic activity was systematically evaluated under varying operational parameters, including solution pH, catalyst dosage, pollutant concentration, and the presence of coexisting ions. Notably, the catalyst maintained high efficiency in real water matrices, demonstrating its practical applicability. The entropy-stabilized nitride framework exhibited negligible metal leaching, excellent thermal and structural stability as confirmed by temperature-dependent synchrotron angle-dispersive X-ray diffraction, and stable performance over multiple reuse cycles. Furthermore, in situ liquid-cell transmission electron microscopy provided real-time insight into catalyst-pollutant interactions, while complementary molecular simulations revealed the structural stability of the HEN NPs during molecular adsorption and the distinct interaction modes of the two antibiotics. Phytotoxicity tests using Vigna radiata confirmed the effective detoxification of treated solutions. Overall, this work establishes (MnFeCoNiCu)N HENs as efficient and durable visible-light-driven photocatalysts for the removal of antibiotics from complex aqueous environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究合成了(MnFeCoNiCu)N高熵氮化物纳米颗粒，作为可见光驱动光催化剂用于降解磺胺甲噁唑和四环素等抗生素，2小时内降解率分别达96%和94%，并在真实水体中保持高效，具有优异的结构稳定性和可重复使用性。
AI.motivation: 高熵氮化物(HENs)具有可调电子结构、高稳定性和丰富活性位点，氮的引入增强了可见光吸收和电荷分离效率，使其适用于光催化应用。但HENs在抗生素降解方面的研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 合成(MnFeCoNiCu)N高熵氮化物纳米颗粒；系统评估操作参数（pH、催化剂用量、污染物浓度、共存离子）；利用温度依赖同步辐射角色散X射线衍射验证稳定性；原位液态细胞透射电镜观察催化剂-污染物相互作用；分子模拟揭示吸附模式；绿豆植物毒性测试验证解毒效果。
AI.result: 2小时内SME降解96%，TCL去除94%；在真实水体中保持高效；金属浸出可忽略；热稳定性和结构稳定性优异；多次循环后性能稳定；植物毒性测试证实有效解毒。
AI.conclusion: (MnFeCoNiCu)N高熵氮化物是高效、耐用的可见光驱动光催化剂，适用于从复杂水环境中去除抗生素。

title: Spectroscopic photorelaxation signatures in pyrazine from nonadiabatic dynamics simulations with coupled cluster theory
summary: Despite extensive theoretical and experimental efforts, the mechanisms underlying the ultrafast relaxation of pyrazine after photoexcitation remain challenging to disentangle. Recently, theoretical investigations have been converging towards a three-state mechanism, with an ultrafast decay of the bright ${}^{1}B_{2u}$ state followed by beats in the populations of the low-lying ${}^{1}B_{3u}$ and ${}^{1}A_u$ states. However, a clear agreement between the experimental results and the corresponding theoretical predictions remains elusive. Here, we present a high-level simulation of the ultrafast excited states dynamics of pyrazine using coupled cluster theory with single and double excitations and ab initio multiple spawning, together with predictions of the time-resolved photoelectron spectrum and X-ray absorption spectra at the nitrogen and carbon edges. This is made possible by using a newly developed multistate implementation of similarity constrained coupled cluster theory. We find quantitative agreement with the experimental signature of the ${}^{1}B_{2u}$ decay in the photoelectron spectrum, and qualitative agreement with the available experimental X-ray absorption spectra. Moreover, we detail spectroscopic signatures that should be verifiable in experiments with sufficient resolution in the time and frequency domains. Compared to previous theoretical studies, we provide further detailed insight into the interplay of the states involved in the photorelaxation.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用耦合簇理论和从头算多级展开方法，对吡嗪分子光激发后的超快弛豫动力学进行了高精度模拟，并与时间分辨光电子谱和X射线吸收谱的实验结果进行了对比验证。
AI.motivation: 吡嗪分子光激发后的超快弛豫机制在理论和实验上长期存在争议，尤其是三态机制中实验与理论预测之间缺乏明确一致性，需要更高精度的理论模拟来澄清。
AI.method: 采用耦合簇理论（CCSD）结合从头算多级展开（AIMS）方法，并利用新发展的多态相似性约束耦合簇理论（similarity constrained coupled cluster theory）进行模拟，预测时间分辨光电子谱和氮/碳边X射线吸收谱。
AI.result: 在光电子谱中与1B2u态的衰减实验结果定量吻合，在X射线吸收谱上实现了定性一致，并提出了可供未来实验验证的谱学特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了比以往研究更详细的态间耦合机制见解，弥合了理论与实验之间的差距，并为未来高分辨时频域实验提供了可验证的谱学预测。

title: When Repulsion Creates Pairing: A New Perspective on Unconventional Superconductivity
summary: Despite the repulsive Coulomb law and the Pauli statistics that do not favor bound states, attraction between electrons or holes is nevertheless possible in the context of many body interaction and of valley potential landscapes, reminiscent of exotic superconducting materials. In particular, in 1965, Kohn and Luttinger published a note revealing that the dynamical screening of the repulsive Coulomb interaction leads, under certain conditions, to an effective attraction necessary for the formation of Cooper pairs. We propose such a formalism adapted to the cuprates, where the screening arises from the superexchange dynamics of virtual holes in the oxygen orbitals of the $Cu O_2$ plane. Inspired from the Bardeen-Copper-Schrieffer (BCS) theory, we can derive some predictions for the temperature-doping phase diagram (pseudo-gap, strange metal, antiferromagnetism, superconducting, and normal states) in semi-quantitative agreement with observations.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Kohn-Luttinger机制，提出了一种适用于铜氧化物的超导理论，其中动态屏蔽来自氧轨道中虚穴的超交换动力学，在半定量层面上重现了温度-掺杂相图（赝能隙、奇异金属、反铁磁、超导和正常态）。
AI.motivation: 尽管电子间存在库仑排斥，但通过多体相互作用和谷势能景观仍可实现有效吸引，受Kohn-Luttinger（1965年）关于动态屏蔽导致有效吸引的启发，作者希望将该思想推广到铜氧化物超导体中。
AI.method: 借鉴BCS理论框架，将超交换动力学引入到屏蔽机制中：虚穴在CuO₂平面氧轨道上的超交换运动提供了动态屏蔽，从而产生有效吸引并形成库珀对。
AI.result: 推导出温度-掺杂相图，包含赝能隙、奇异金属、反铁磁、超导和正常态等多个区域，与实验观测达到半定量一致。
AI.conclusion: 铜氧化物超导中的Cooper对形成可由Kohn-Luttinger型动态屏蔽机制解释，其中超交换动力学是关键，该理论框架在半定量层面成功描述了高温超导相图的主要特征。

title: Restoring the uniform density limit in Perdew-Zunger self-interaction correction
summary: The Perdew-Zunger self-interaction correction (PZ-SIC) makes approximate density functionals exact for all one-electron densities, but sacrifices exactness for uniform densities. I show that an alternative to the orbital density ansatz employed in PZ-SIC restores the uniform density limit. The new ansatz also eliminates the need to evaluate approximate density functionals on lobed one-electron densities extracted from smooth many-electron densities, thereby reducing orbital dependence and lobed density error. I demonstrate the alternative ansatz in a broadly accurate nonempirical locally scaled self-interaction-corrected generalized gradient approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种替代PZ-SIC中轨道密度假设的新方案，恢复了均匀密度极限，减少了轨道依赖性和花瓣密度误差，并展示了一种广泛准确的非经验局部标度自相互作用修正广义梯度近似。
AI.motivation: PZ-SIC虽然对单电子密度精确，但牺牲了均匀密度极限的精确性，且存在轨道依赖性和花瓣密度误差问题。
AI.method: 提出一种替代PZ-SIC中轨道密度假设的新方案，通过局部标度自相互作用修正广义梯度近似实现。
AI.result: 新方案恢复了均匀密度极限，减少了轨道依赖性和花瓣密度误差，展示了一种广泛准确的非经验近似。
AI.conclusion: 替代的轨道密度假设能同时改善均匀密度极限和减少误差，实现了更准确的自相互作用修正。

title: Quantum magnetism of the spin-1 kagome-lattice antiferromagnet
summary: We investigate the spin-1 kagome-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet using large-scale Lanczos diagonalization and the finite-temperature Lanczos method. The zero-temperature magnetization process exhibits plateaus at $m=0$, $1/3$, $7/9$, and $8/9$, where $m$ is the normalized magnetization. The $m=0$ plateau is identified as a trimer valence-bond-crystal state, while the high-field plateaus at $m=7/9$ and $8/9$ are identified as magnon crystals. In particular, the $m=8/9$ plateau corresponds to the exact localized-magnon crystal state. A smoothed zero-temperature magnetization curve constructed using the Gaussian-kernel smoothing method indicates magnetization jumps at the lower-field edge of the $m=1/3$ plateau and at the upper-field edges of the $m=7/9$ and $8/9$ plateaus. At finite temperatures, the specific heat exhibits a double-peak structure with peaks around $T/J\simeq0.1$ and $T/J\simeq1.1$, and the low-temperature peak may be related to trimer valence-bond-crystal ordering. The finite-temperature magnetization curves show that the $m=1/3$ plateau remains visible at low temperatures, whereas the high-field plateaus are rapidly smeared out by thermal effects. These results provide benchmark data for thermodynamic and high-field magnetization measurements in candidate spin-1 kagome-lattice materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模Lanczos对角化和有限温度Lanczos方法，系统研究了自旋-1 Kagome晶格海森堡反铁磁体的基态和有限温度性质，发现了零温磁化过程中的多个平台（m=0, 1/3, 7/9, 8/9），并分析了其对应的量子态（三聚体价键晶体态和磁子晶体态），以及有限温度下的比热双峰结构和磁化曲线的热效应。
AI.motivation: Kagome晶格因其几何阻挫特性而备受关注，但以往研究多集中于自旋-1/2体系，对自旋-1 Kagome反铁磁体的研究尚不充分。本文旨在通过精确数值方法，揭示自旋-1 Kagome反铁磁体在外磁场下的磁化行为、磁化平台及其对应的量子态，为实验候选材料的热力学和高场磁化测量提供基准数据。
AI.method: 采用大规模Lanczos对角化方法计算零温下的基态性质，运用有限温度Lanczos方法研究有限温度行为；使用高斯核平滑方法构建零温磁化曲线；通过比热和有限温度磁化曲线分析热效应。
AI.result: 零温磁化过程在m=0, 1/3, 7/9, 8/9处出现平台；m=0为三聚体价键晶体态，m=7/9和8/9为磁子晶体态（m=8/9对应精确局域磁子晶体态）；磁化曲线在1/3平台低场侧和7/9、8/9平台高场侧出现跳变；比热在T/J≈0.1和T/J≈1.1处呈现双峰结构；有限温度下1/3平台保持可见，高场平台迅速被热效应抹除。
AI.conclusion: 自旋-1 Kagome反铁磁体展现出丰富的磁化平台和量子态（价键晶体与磁子晶体），其零温磁化行为与有限温度响应为实验寻找和识别相关材料提供了重要理论基准。

title: Non-equilibrium phase transition in the Brownian Ising Model: field theory, renormalization group, and exact results
summary: We present a complete field-theoretical renormalization-group (RG) analysis of the Brownian Ising Model (BIM), in which a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ order parameter is coupled to a passive conserved density, breaking detailed balance. Using the Martin-Siggia-Rose formalism and an $ε=4-d$ expansion, we show that this density-order parameter coupling is RG-relevant below four dimensions and drives the system to a new non-equilibrium fixed point, distinct from the Ising universality class. Critical exponents are computed at lowest nontrivial order, some of which require a dedicated two-loop analysis. At large scales, the density acts as an effective noise that is white in time but long-range in space, enhancing order-parameter fluctuations and producing a negative anomalous dimension $η$. A defining feature of the new class is that the correlation and response functions acquire different anomalous dimensions, $η\neq 2 - γ/ ν$ - a direct, observable signature of fluctuation-dissipation-theorem violation at large scales that cannot occur in equilibrium. We also find a small correction-to-scaling exponent, implying large preasymptotic corrections that must be accounted for in numerical and experimental tests. We further derive a set of relations among renormalization factors that hold to all orders in perturbation theory, following from the linearity of the density dynamics and an emergent shift symmetry. These yield an exact scaling relation $ν= 2/(d+z-2)$ at the BIM fixed point and establish that the Ising universality class, as well as that of quenched diluted-Ising, is unstable in $d=3$. This establishes the BIM fixed point as the unique infrared attractor for any nonzero diffusion constant.

AI.tldr: 本文对布朗伊辛模型（BIM）进行了完整的场论重正化群分析，发现密度-序参量耦合在四维以下引入了一个新的非平衡固定点，不同于伊辛普适类。关键特征是关联和响应函数具有不同的反常维度，标志了涨落-耗散定理在大尺度上的破坏。推导了精确标度关系，并证明伊辛和稀释伊辛普适类在d=3时不稳定，BIM固定点是唯一红外吸引子。
AI.motivation: 理解打破细致平衡的活性系统中，被动守恒密度与序参量耦合如何影响临界行为，以及是否会导致新的非平衡普适类。
AI.method: 使用Martin-Siggia-Rose形式主义和ε=4-d展开，进行完整的场论重正化群分析，包括两圈计算，并利用密度动力学的线性和涌现平移对称性推导全阶重正化因子关系。
AI.result: 发现新的非平衡固定点；关联与响应函数具有不同反常维度（η≠2-γ/ν）；得到精确标度关系ν=2/(d+z-2)；证明伊辛和稀释伊辛普适类在d=3失稳。
AI.conclusion: BIM固定点是三维空间中任意非零扩散常数下唯一的红外吸引子，其临界行为具有标度关系破坏和有限尺寸修正显著的特征，对数值和实验检验有重要指导意义。

title: Electrically tunable interfacial thermal conduction via electronic structure engineering in ${Au}$/$Bi_{1-x}$$Sb_{x}$ topological insulators
summary: This work provides direct experimental evidence for the role of topological interface states in thermal conduction across a metal/topological insulator junction. It also shows that this conduction can be reversibly modulated by electrical current injection, offering a new approach toward active control of heat flow at solid-state interfaces. Specifically, the interfacial thermal conductance of ${Au}$/$Bi_{89}$$Sb_{11}$ and ${Au}$/$Bi_{87}$$Sb_{13}$ junctions demonstrates distinct temperature- and bias-dependent behavior. Both responses are attributed to carrier redistribution between topological interface and bulk band states, driven thermally by Fermi-Dirac broadening and electrically by quasi-Fermi-level shifts and WKB tunneling into nearby bulk bands. Control experiments using trivial semimetals and insulating interlayers further confirm the topological specificity of the effect. Such electrically tunable interfacial heat conduction positions interface electronic structure engineering as a promising route for active thermal management. In doing so, it lays the groundwork for a mechanically robust alternative to conventional structure-driven thermal control compatible with increasingly dense, high-power solid-state devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验证明，金属/拓扑绝缘体结的界面热导可通过电流注入可逆调节，该效应源于拓扑界面态与体带态之间的载流子重新分布，为主动热管理提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 探索拓扑界面态在金属/拓扑绝缘体结热传导中的作用，并实现电学可逆调控的热流控制新方法，以满足高密度、高功率固态器件的主动热管理需求。
AI.method: 制备Au/Bi89Sb11和Au/Bi87Sb13结，测量不同温度和偏压下的界面热导；通过费米-狄拉克展宽、准费米能级移动和WKB隧穿解释载流子重新分布机制；使用平庸半金属和绝缘夹层进行对照实验。
AI.result: 金属/拓扑绝缘体结的界面热导显示出独特的温度和偏压依赖行为，且可通过电流注入可逆调节；对照实验证实了拓扑特异性的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 电学可调的界面热传导表明界面电子结构工程是主动热管理的有前景方向，为传统结构驱动型热控制提供了机械鲁棒的替代方案。

title: Magnetic ordering of a van der Waals material combining vastly different magnetic anisotropies
summary: Among magnetic van der Waals materials, the vanadium trihalide family exhibits unique features. In particular, VI3 contains V atoms of two different types, as two energetically close electronic occupations can coexist in real samples. These types show strikingly different magnetic anisotropy, predicted to differ by more than an order of magnitude. The combination forms a distinctive magnetic system. VI3 also displays an unusual thickness dependence: the monolayer Curie temperature (TC) is higher than that of the bulk, contrary to the expectation that interlayer coupling reinforces magnetic order. Using atomistic spin-dynamics simulations informed by first-principles calculations, we investigate the critical temperature behavior from the combined perspective of single-ion anisotropy and exchange interactions. The strong anisotropy contrast significantly affects thermal stability: increasing the fraction of high-anisotropy sites raises the energy cost of transverse spin fluctuations and increases the ordering temperature. Furthermore, V-atom inhomogeneity makes the interlayer super-superexchange network spatially nonuniform, creating competing exchange pathways. This weakens coherent interlayer order while preserving robust intralayer ferromagnetic correlations, thus modifying the bulk-monolayer TC relation. Our model reproduces experimental TC values when the ratio of the two V types is close to 1:1, in agreement with two experimental methods. This supports the coexistence of two V configurations in VI3. The monolayer TC is reproduced with a slightly modified ratio, possibly linked to polaron concentration. The sensitivity of TC to this ratio suggests that the ordering temperature of VI3 can in principle be tuned over a broad range by controlling the relative occupation of the two vanadium configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和原子自旋动力学模拟，研究了VI3中两种钒构型的共存及其对磁各向异性、居里温度和层间耦合的影响，揭示了构型比例调控磁性的机制。
AI.motivation: VI3中存在两种能量相近的V原子电子构型，实验表明其单层居里温度高于体相，这一反常现象挑战了传统认知。理解这种构型共存如何影响磁性行为是核心动机。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算结合原子自旋动力学模拟，分析单离子各向异性和交换相互作用，通过调节两种V构型的比例模拟不同厚度下的临界温度行为。
AI.result: 两种V构型的磁各向异性差异超过一个数量级；高各向异性位点比例增加可提升居里温度；V原子不均匀性使层间超超交换网络空间非均匀，削弱相干层间有序；当两种V构型比例接近1:1时，实验TC值被成功复现。
AI.conclusion: VI3中两种V构型的共存是解释其反常厚度依赖居里温度的关键，通过调控两种构型的相对占有率可在较宽范围内调节其临界温度。

title: Photo-thermal 2D spectroscopy: a different type of action
summary: Advances in multidimensional spectroscopy have seen the rise of action detection, where coherent response is encoded into incoherent signals. These are typically proportional to the excited-state population, an example in 2D electronic spectroscopy (2DES) is fluorescence-detected 2DES (F-2DES), and in 2D infrared (2DIR) tag-loss 2DIR (TL-2DIR). Very recently, a new type of photo-thermal action signal has been introduced in 2DIR, detecting the generated heat by atomic force microscopy-based 2DIR (AFM-2DIR). We present a unified theoretical framework for population- and heat-based 2D spectroscopy, highlighting their complementary features. In the infrared, TL-2DIR reflects the system linear response, whereas AFM-2DIR produces spectra resembling conventional 2DIR, with sensitivity to anharmonicity and mode coupling. Our model reproduces key experimental AFM-2DIR features, confirming measurement in a highly nonlinear regime. Extending photothermal detection to electronic spectroscopy, we compare F-2DES with proposed photo-thermal 2DES (PT-2DES). PT-2DES closely resembles conventional 2DES, while enjoying the advantages of action detection.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了群体和光热两种作用检测二维光谱的统一理论框架，揭示了它们在红外和电子光谱中的互补特性。AFM-2DIR类似于传统2DIR且对非谐性和模式耦合敏感，而TL-2DIR反映线性响应。提出的PT-2DES兼具常规2DES和动作检测的优势。
AI.motivation: 随着多维光谱中基于作用（action）检测技术的兴起，如荧光检测二电子光谱（F-2DES）和标记损失二红外光谱（TL-2DIR），以及最新出现的基于原子力显微镜的光热二红外光谱（AFM-2DIR），缺乏一个统一的理论框架来理解不同类型作用信号（群体信号vs.热信号）之间的关系及其与传统谱学方法的异同。
AI.method: 构建了一个统一的理论框架，分别针对基于群体（population）和基于热（heat）的二维光谱进行了建模。在红外波段，对比了TL-2DIR（群体响应）和AFM-2DIR（光热响应）的谱学特征；在电子波段，对比了F-2DES（群体响应）和提出的PT-2DES（光热响应）。通过模型重现AFM-2DIR的关键实验特征，验证了高度非线性测量区域。
AI.result: 1) TL-2DIR反映系统的线性响应，而AFM-2DIR产生类似传统2DIR的光谱，对非谐性和模式耦合敏感。2) 模型成功复现了AFM-2DIR的关键实验特征，证实其在高度非线性区域工作。3) PT-2DES与传统2DES高度相似，同时继承了动作检测的优势（如无需相干检测）。
AI.conclusion: 群体基和热基二维光谱具有互补性。光热检测（AFM-2DIR和PT-2DES）能产生与传统二维光谱高度相似的谱图，同时享受动作检测在实验实现上的便利性（如避免相位匹配要求、可检测弱信号等），为多维光谱学提供了新的实用途径。

title: Josephson effects in the spin-triplet superconductor/altermagnet/spin-triplet superconductor junctions: the detection of the intrinsic $\bf{d}$-vector
summary: We study the Josephson effects in the spin-triplet superconductor/altermagnet/spin-triplet superconductor junctions using the Green's function method. It is found that the current-phase difference relationships in the junctions strongly depend on the direction of the $\bf{d}$-vectors in the spin-triplet superconductors and the orientation angle of the altermagnet. For the given orientation angle, the $0$-$π$ transition can be obtained when the $\bf{d}$-vector is rotated. The variations of the critical current of the junctions with the direction of the $\bf{d}$-vector, the orientation angle and the strength of altermagnetism are systematically investigated. These Josephson effects can provide the distinguishable information about the direction of the $\bf{d}$-vector. Compared to the existing research, the proposed altermagnetic Josephson junctions can effectively avoid the negative influence of the magnetic field on the $\bf{d}$-vector and can serve as a feasible scheme for the detection of the intrinsic $\bf{d}$-vector. The obtained $0$-$π$ transition in the junctions can also have potential applications in the design of quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用格林函数方法研究了自旋三重态超导体/交变磁体/自旋三重态超导体结中的约瑟夫森效应，发现电流-相位差关系强烈依赖于d-矢量方向和交变磁体的取向角，并实现了0-π转变，为检测d-矢量提供了可行方案。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对交变磁体中自旋三重态超导约瑟夫森效应的系统理解，需要探索一种避免磁场对d-矢量产生负面影响的检测方案。
AI.method: 采用格林函数方法对自旋三重态超导体/交变磁体/自旋三重态超导体结进行理论建模与分析，系统考察了d-矢量方向、交变磁体取向角和交变磁强度对约瑟夫森效应的影响。
AI.result: 发现电流-相位差关系强烈依赖于d-矢量方向和交变磁体取向角；在特定取向角下，旋转d-矢量可实现0-π转变；系统揭示了临界电流随各参数的变化规律。
AI.conclusion: 该交变磁约瑟夫森结能有效避免磁场对d-矢量的负面影响，可作为检测内禀d-矢量的可行方案；0-π转变在量子器件设计中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Hyper Boris integrators for kinetic plasma simulations and their connection to 3D rotation representations
comment: 4 pages; proceedings of the 52nd EPS Conference on Plasma Physics (June 29 -- July 3, 2026, Edinburgh, UK)
summary: Particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation is one of the most important research tools in theoretical plasma physics. To solve the motion of charged particles, the Boris method (a.k.a. the Boris integrator/pusher/solver) has been used for more than a half century. Although the Boris solver has good accuracy, the demand for high-accuracy numerical solvers has been increasing, and new integrators have been actively developed. In this contribution, we present novel high-accuracy particle integrators, the hyper Boris integrators, for nonrelativistic kinetic simulations. We further discuss their connection to 3D rotation representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于非相对论动力学模拟的超 Boris 积分器，这是一种新型高精度粒子积分器，并讨论了其与三维旋转表示的联系。
AI.motivation: 尽管 Boris 方法在半世纪以来被广泛用于等离子体物理的 PIC 模拟中且精度良好，但高精度数值求解器的需求日益增长，需要开发新的积分器。
AI.method: 提出了超 Boris 积分器（Hyper Boris Integrators）用于非相对论动力学模拟，并进一步探讨了这些积分器与三维旋转表示之间的联系。
AI.result: 成功开发了新型高精度粒子积分器——超 Boris 积分器。
AI.conclusion: 超 Boris 积分器为等离子体 PIC 模拟提供了更高精度的粒子运动求解方案，且与 3D 旋转表示有内在联系。

title: Winding charge density wave: intertwining of structural chirality and phase topology of electronic order
summary: We propose a class of chiral charge density waves (CDWs), dubbed winding CDWs, that exhibit macroscopic chirality despite a single ordering wavevector. In screw-symmetric chiral crystals, chiral phonons drive a Peierls instability that selects a definite crystal angular momentum channel, thereby endowing the CDW with an integer azimuthal phase winding dictated by the selection rule governing electron-phonon coupling. We further extend this framework to achiral crystals with discrete rotational symmetry and demonstrate that spontaneous symmetry breaking stabilizes a winding CDW with either handedness, realizing an achiral-to-chiral phase transition. Our results reveal a fundamental link between the geometry of chiral structures and the phase topology of electronic orders.

AI.tldr: 提出了一类具有宏观手性的"缠绕电荷密度波"(winding CDWs)，其手性源于单一有序波矢下的方位角相位缠绕，可在螺旋对称手性晶体或非手性晶体中实现，揭示了手性结构几何与电子有序相位拓扑之间的基本联系。
AI.motivation: 探索在单一有序波矢下如何实现具有宏观手性的电荷密度波，以及手性晶体中电子-声子耦合的选择定则如何赋予CDW拓扑相位结构。
AI.method: 从理论上提出"缠绕CDW"的概念，分析手性声子驱动的Peierls不稳定性，利用晶体角动量通道的选择定则赋予CDW整数方位角相位缠绕；并将框架扩展到具有离散旋转对称性的非手性晶体，研究自发对称性破缺稳定的缠绕CDW。
AI.result: 在手性晶体中，手性声子驱动Peierls失稳，通过选择定则赋予CDW确定的晶体角动量通道，产生整数方位角相位缠绕；在非手性晶体中，自发对称性破缺可稳定任意手性的缠绕CDW，实现非手性到手性的相变。
AI.conclusion: 缠绕CDW揭示了手性结构的几何特性与电子有序的相位拓扑之间的基本联系，为理解手性量子物质中的新奇有序态提供了新视角。

title: Finite-Time Thermodynamics of Battery Discharging: Power-Efficiency Trade-Off and Optimization
summary: Battery discharging is governed by a fundamental trade-off between output power and energy conversion efficiency due to internal dissipation. In this paper, we demonstrate that such a trade-off universally yields a parabolic envelope $P\proptoη(1-η)$. The efficiency at maximum power is exactly one half, mirroring the well-known half-Carnot limit in finite-time thermodynamics. To extend this bound into practical operational rules, we formulate a multistage constant-current discharging (MSCD) schedule subject to simultaneous real-time load demands and a global discharging deadline. Analytical resolution via the Karush--Kuhn--Tucker conditions reveals a remarkably compact optimal policy: $I_{i}^{\star}=\max(I_{i}^{-},I_{0})$. Under this rule, stages limited by external demand run exactly at their minimum required currents, while all remaining stages are elevated to a uniform baseline $I_{0}$ fixed by the deadline constraint. By tracing the dissipation--time Pareto front, we quantify how internal resistance shifts the operational boundaries and sharpens the trade-off corner. This analysis establishes a rigorous thermodynamic baseline for the scheduling layer of battery management systems, offering natural extensions to nonlinear models incorporating temperature and state-of-charge dependencies.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了电池放电过程中输出功率与能量转换效率之间的普适抛物线关系 P∝η(1-η)，最大功率处效率恰为1/2。通过KKT条件推导出多阶段恒流放电的最优策略 I_i^⋆=max(I_i^-, I_0)，为电池管理系统建立了严格的热力学基线。
AI.motivation: 电池放电存在输出功率与能量转换效率之间的根本性权衡（由于内耗），作者希望揭示这一权衡的普适规律，并将其延拓为可实际操作的电池调度策略。
AI.method: 理论推导建立抛物线包络关系；通过KKT（Karush-Kuhn-Tucker）条件解析求解多阶段恒流放电（MSCD）优化问题，得出最优电流策略。
AI.result: 发现普适抛物线关系 P∝η(1-η)；最大功率效率恰好为1/2；最优策略为 I_i^⋆=max(I_i^-, I_0)；通过耗散-时间Pareto前沿量化了内阻对运行边界的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该分析为电池管理系统调度层建立了严格的热力学基线，可自然扩展到包含温度和荷电状态依赖的非线性模型。

title: Hall Shift Current and Nonlinear Anomalous Hall Effect in Gapped Dirac Fermion Systems
summary: We discuss a new mechanism for the nonlinear anomalous Hall effect in tilted two-dimensional gapped Dirac fermion systems. This mechanism originates from a side-jump displacement associated with Landau-Zener tunneling across the mass gap. In lightly doped tilted Dirac systems with a small gap, this interband mechanism can contribute to the nonlinear anomalous Hall effect in addition to the conventional intraband mechanism arising from the Berry curvature dipole. It provides a possible explanation for the nonlinear Hall effect accompanied by nonlinear longitudinal transport observed in the organic Dirac fermion system α-(ET)2I3 with an extremely small gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出倾斜二维有隙狄拉克费米子系统中非线性反常霍尔效应的新机制，源于朗道-齐纳隧穿过程中的侧跳位移，可解释有机狄拉克费米子系统α-(ET)2I3中观测到的非线性霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: 现有非线性反常霍尔效应主要归因于贝里曲率偶极子（带内机制），但轻掺杂小间隙倾斜狄拉克系统中可能存在额外的带间贡献，尤其是实验观测到的α-(ET)2I3体系中的非线性霍尔效应无法被传统机制完全解释。
AI.method: 理论分析倾斜二维有隙狄拉克费米子体系，研究Landau-Zener隧穿过程中的侧跳（side-jump）位移，推导该带间跃迁对非线性反常霍尔效应的贡献。
AI.result: 发现Landau-Zener隧穿相关的侧跳位移可作为非线性反常霍尔效应的新来源；在轻掺杂小间隙倾斜狄拉克系统中，该带间机制与传统的贝里曲率偶极子带内机制并存，共同贡献非线性霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: 新机制为有机狄拉克费米子系统α-(ET)2I3中伴随非线性纵向输运的非线性霍尔效应提供了可能的物理解释，拓展了对非线性反常霍尔效应来源的认识。

title: First principles study of chalcogen vacancy effect on the optoelectronic and photocatalytic properties of transition metal dichalcogenides monolayers
summary: In working conditions, chalcogen vacancies spontaneously occur in two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) monolayers, affecting their optoelectronic and photocatalytic properties. To study how chalcogen vacancies affect such properties, we use quantum mechanical calculations considering prototypical MX$_2$ (M = Mo, W, X = S and Se) TMDCs monolayers. Structural optimisations show that M-X bond lengths about a vacancy are different compared to the bond lengths in the pristine structure. Band structure calculations reveal that the introduction of vacancies produce electronic states about the Fermi level, hence resulting in the reduction of the band gap. Work function and electrostatic potential calculations show that the introduction of vacancies induce an asymmetry in the electrostatic potential facilitating the charge separation; such feature is absent in a pristine monolayer. All the considered defective structures are capable of performing hydrogen evolution reaction, while co-catalyst is required to perform oxygen evolution reaction when used for water splitting. WS$_2$ and WSe$_2$ defective monolayers can serve as an efficient photocatalytic material for reducing CO$_2$ into useful chemical products. The presented results show that vacancy-containing TMDCs monolayers own photocatalytic capabilities compared to the pristine counterparts, thus showing that defective TMD monolayers have prospective applications and should not be regarded as flawed products to be discarded. Finally, the results might constitute guidelines for the experimental synthesis of vacancy-engineered MX$_2$ monolayers for optoelectronic devices and photocatalytic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量子力学计算研究了MoS₂、MoSe₂、WS₂、WSe₂四种单层TMDCs中硫族元素空位缺陷对其光电和光催化性能的影响。结果表明，空位引入会减小带隙、产生不对称静电势促进电荷分离，并使材料具备析氢反应能力。其中WS₂和WSe₂缺陷单层可有效光催化还原CO₂。缺陷单层具有比完美单层更优异的光催化性能，不应被视为废品。
AI.motivation: TMDCs单层在制备过程中不可避免地产生硫族空位缺陷，但这些缺陷对材料光电和光催化性能的影响尚不明确，需要系统研究以评估其潜在应用价值。
AI.method: 采用量子力学计算方法，对MoS₂、MoSe₂、WS₂、WSe₂四种MX₂单层进行结构优化、能带结构计算、功函数和静电势分析，并评估其催化析氢和析氧反应能力以及CO₂还原能力。
AI.result: （1）空位附近M-X键长发生变化；（2）空位在费米能级附近引入电子态，减小带隙；（3）空位引入静电势不对称性，促进电荷分离；（4）所有缺陷结构均可进行析氢反应，但需要助催化剂才能进行析氧反应；（5）WS₂和WSe₂缺陷单层可有效光催化还原CO₂。
AI.conclusion: 含硫族空位的TMDCs单层具有比完美单层更优异的光催化性能，不应被视为有缺陷的废品，而应视作具有潜在应用前景的材料。该结果可为实验合成空位工程化的MX₂单层提供指导。

title: AquaGen: Scaling generative models to molecular dynamics precision on thousands of atoms
summary: We present AquaGen, the first all-atom, explicit solvent, periodic-boundary-condition-aware generative model that produces molecular configurations from the Boltzmann distribution at a fraction of the cost of molecular dynamics (MD). This is in contrast with existing generative models that remove degrees of freedom by operating on coarse-grained, vacuum, or implicit solvent systems. Operating at this resolution allows for post-processing through force field energy evaluations and MD simulations, and enables the prediction of relevant properties in a gray-box manner (as ensemble averages of potential energy evaluations over generated samples). We demonstrate the utility of this paradigm on absolute hydration free energy (AHFE), producing estimates 4-10x faster and with comparable accuracy to standard GPU-based MD. By generating uncorrelated samples from alchemical Boltzmann distributions, we create more accurate, interpretable, and refinable ensemble predictions with calibrated uncertainty estimates, unlike regression methods which are entirely black-box predictors. Our approach also yields predictable benefits from increasing train- and test-time compute, realized by scaling model size and generating more samples, respectively. We believe that this approach demonstrates the utility of high-resolution ensemble generation for free energy estimation, with future potential to replace MD in tasks such as the prediction of lipophilicity, membrane permeability, or absolute binding free energy (ABFE) -- whose grounding and interpretability may be critical for the development of new drugs and materials.

AI.tldr: 提出AquaGen，首个全原子、显式溶剂、周期性边界条件感知的生成模型，能从玻尔兹曼分布生成分子构象，成本仅为分子动力学(MD)的几分之一，在绝对水合自由能(AHFE)预测上比标准GPU MD快4-10倍且精度相当。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型通常采用粗粒化、真空或隐式溶剂体系，丢失了大量自由度，无法直接进行力场能量评估和MD仿真后处理，且回归方法完全是黑箱预测，缺乏可解释性和不确定性校准。
AI.method: 构建全原子、显式溶剂、周期性边界条件感知的生成模型AquaGen，直接从玻尔兹曼分布采样分子构象；通过势能评估的系综平均进行灰盒预测；支持扩大模型规模（训练时）和生成更多样本（测试时）以提升性能。
AI.result: 在绝对水合自由能(AHFE)预测任务上，AquaGen比标准GPU MD快4-10倍，准确度相当；生成不相关的玻尔兹曼分布样本，提供了校准的不确定性估计；增加训练和测试计算量可带来可预测的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率系综生成在自由能估计中具有实用性，有潜力取代MD在亲脂性、膜通透性、绝对结合自由能(ABFE)等任务中的应用，为药物和材料开发提供更具可解释性和可靠性的预测。

title: Tuning Superconductivity by Isovalent Antimony Substitution in PrFeAs(O,F)
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures (Accepted for the journal "Physica B: Condensed Matter")
summary: We investigate the effects of isovalent Sb substitution at the As site in fluorine-doped PrFeAs1-xSbxO0.7F0.3 (x = 0 to 1.0) through structural, Raman spectroscopy, density functional theory (DFT), transport, magnetotransport, and magnetic measurements. The superconducting transition temperature decreases gradually from ~48 K for the parent compound to ~44 K up to x = 0.3, followed by a rapid suppression at higher Sb concentrations due to increasing disorder and secondary phase formation. Raman spectroscopy and DFT reveal lattice expansion and pronounced softening of pnictogen related vibrational modes upon Sb substitution. Magnetotransport measurements up to 9 T show enhanced upper critical fields and increased vortex activation energy for moderate Sb doping, indicating stronger vortex pinning. However, the critical current density remains low because of poor intergranular connectivity. The results demonstrate a crossover from an electronically tuned superconducting state to a disorder-dominated regime in isovalently substituted iron pnictides.

AI.tldr: 研究PrFeAs1-xSbxO0.7F0.3中等价Sb替代As的效果，发现超导转变温度先缓慢下降后快速抑制，中等掺杂时上临界场和涡旋激活能增强，但临界电流密度因晶粒连接性差而偏低，表明从电子调控超导态向无序主导 regime 的转变。
AI.motivation: 探究等价Sb替代对氟掺杂PrFeAsO体系超导性质的影响，理解从电子调控到无序主导的交叉行为。
AI.method: 通过结构表征、拉曼光谱、DFT计算、输运、磁输运及磁性测量等多种手段系统研究。
AI.result: 超导转变温度从~48 K（x=0）降至~44 K（x=0.3），高掺杂时快速抑制；拉曼和DFT显示晶格膨胀和pnictogen振动模软化；中等掺杂时上临界场和涡旋激活能增强，但临界电流密度仍低。
AI.conclusion: 在等价 substituted 铁基超导体中观察到从电子调控超导态到无序主导 regime 的交叉行为。

title: Accelerating Multi-scale Simulations of Nuclear Components via PCYS Interpolation Tables
summary: Zirconium alloy core components in nuclear reactors, such as spacer grids and fuel cladding, undergo anisotropic dimensional changes driven by coupled irradiation creep and growth. While micromechanical crystal plasticity frameworks like the Viscoplastic Self-Consistent (VPSC) formulation capture these microstructurally driven phenomena, their integration into macroscopic Finite Element Method (FEM) solvers is computationally prohibitive for engineering-scale components. To bridge this gap, this work presents a multi-scale framework implemented within the open-source FEM solver Code_Aster. The developed interface uses a 5D Interpolation Table (IT) as a static material surrogate to govern instantaneous viscoplastic responses, coupled with a periodic recalibration and first-order Taylor series linearization scheme to track microstructural drift due to radiation damage without on-the-fly database updates. The predictive accuracy, numerical stability, and performance of this Polycrystal Yield Surface (PCYS) interpolation approach are benchmarked against VPSC-FEM simulations under continuous high-dose irradiation scenarios. Material-level assessments demonstrate that the linearization scheme bounds relative errors below 1% for representative deformation paths, maintaining structural compatibility. Furthermore, structural simulations of a spacer grid domain revealed meaningful computational savings, overcoming the multi-scale computational penalty while preserving microstructural fidelity. The proposed framework shows potential for multiphysics structural assessments and safety margin evaluations of core internals over operational lifespans.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多尺度框架，通过在开源FEM求解器Code_Aster中集成5D插值表(IT)作为静态材料代理，配合周期性重新校准和一阶泰勒级数线性化方案，实现了对锆合金辐照蠕变和生长的各向异性行为的高效模拟。该Polycrystal Yield Surface (PCYS)插值方法在保证材料级误差低于1%的前提下，显著降低了计算成本，为核反应堆核心部件的多物理场评估提供了可行方案。
AI.motivation: 核反应堆中锆合金核心组件（如定位格架、燃料包壳）在辐照下经历各向异性的尺寸变化，而现有的微观晶体塑性框架（如VPSC）与宏观有限元方法的集成计算成本过高，难以用于工程尺度组件分析。
AI.method: 提出多尺度框架，包括：(1) 5D插值表作为静态材料代理，控制瞬时粘塑性响应；(2) 周期性重新校准与一阶泰勒级数线性化方案，追踪辐照损伤导致的微观结构漂移，无需实时数据库更新。
AI.result: 材料级评估显示线性化方案对代表性变形路径的相对误差控制在1%以下；结构模拟（定位格架）实现了显著的计算节省，克服了多尺度计算惩罚同时保持了微观结构保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该PCYS插值方法为核反应堆堆内构件的多物理场结构评估和安全裕度分析提供了有效的计算工具，有望在工程实际中得到应用。

title: What Makes Three-Dimensional Quantum Spin Liquids Possible?
summary: Quantum spin liquids are often introduced through a low-dimensional intuition: weak coordination and strong zero-point motion frustrate conventional magnetic order. This view has shaped much of the field, but it misses another route to quantum disorder. In many frustrated magnets, the more natural starting point is not a fluctuating version of an ordered state, but a locally constrained manifold of low-energy configurations. Within such a manifold, quantum dynamics can generate an emergent gauge theory, with fractionalized excitations and collective modes absent in ordinary magnets. Here we ask why such phases can be stable in three spatial dimensions. We argue that three-dimensional quantum spin liquids need not be regarded as fragile exceptions to the tendency of 3D magnets to order. They can arise when local constraints suppress premature order selection, coherent tunneling processes connect the constrained manifold, and the topology of gauge defects permits a deconfined regime. For compact gauge theories, three dimensions can even reverse the usual dimensional intuition: regimes that are unstable or fine-tuned in lower dimensions may become stable over finite regions of parameter space. We organize the discussion around constraint-driven Coulomb phases, weak harmonic order-by-disorder selection, and the role of spin-orbit or multipolar interactions in generating the required microscopic dynamics. We close with experimental diagnostics, candidate materials, and open theoretical questions for three-dimensional quantum spin liquids

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了量子自旋液体通常需要低维度的传统观点，论证了三维量子自旋液体可以通过局域约束、相干隧穿和规范缺陷拓扑等机制稳定存在，甚至可以在三维中展现出比低维更稳定的特性。
AI.motivation: 传统认为量子自旋液体依赖低维特性（弱配位、强零点运动），但本文质疑这一直觉，试图说明三维量子自旋液体并非脆弱的例外，而是可以通过局域约束和规范理论机制自然产生。
AI.method: 围绕三个关键机制展开：局域约束抑制过早的序选择、相干隧穿连接约束流形、规范缺陷拓扑允许退禁闭区域。特别讨论了紧致规范理论在三维中可以反转维度直觉，使低维中不稳定或精细调节的相在三维中稳定存在。
AI.result: 指出约束驱动的库仑相、弱谐波序-by-失序选择、自旋-轨道或多极相互作用产生所需微观动力学等关键物理图像是可行的。三维紧致规范理论的退禁闭区域可以成为稳定相而非精细调节点。
AI.conclusion: 三维量子自旋液体可以稳定存在，总结了实验诊断方法、候选材料以及开放的理论问题，为三维量子自旋液体的研究提供了新的理论框架和视角。

title: Variance of the $SIS$ Epidemic on Networks: A Diffusion Approximation
summary: Functional laws of large numbers (FLLNs) describe the mean-field trajectory of epidemics on networks, but say nothing about the fluctuations around it. These fluctuations are governed by moments of the degree distribution not relevant at the level of the mean. A rigorous functional central limit theorem (FCLT) exists for the susceptible--infected ($SI$) process on configuration-model graphs, but no analogue exists for $SIS$, where recovery reintroduces vertices into the susceptible pool with partially known neighborhoods, breaking the clean neighborhood distribution the $SI$ derivation relies on. We develop a tractable variance approximation for Markovian $SIS$ on configuration-model graphs, combining Gleeson's approximate master equation (AME) framework with a van Kampen system-size expansion in the spirit of the $SI$ FCLT. We derive a closed drift and diffusion matrix for a reduced susceptible/$SI$-edge/$SS$-edge count vector and obtain the time-dependent covariance via the associated Langevin/Lyapunov equation. Validation against Gillespie simulation across Poisson, regular, and power-law networks shows close agreement, with deviations near the epidemic threshold and in strongly heterogeneous networks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对配置模型图上SIS流行病过程，结合Gleeson近似主方程与van Kampen系统规模展开，发展了一个可处理的方差近似方法，推导出约化状态向量的封闭漂移和扩散矩阵，并通过Langevin/Lyapunov方程得到时变协方差，在多种网络上与Gillespie模拟结果吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 现有FLLN仅能描述流行病平均轨迹，而SI过程的FCLT因SIS中恢复过程会将被感染节点重新引入易感池且其邻居信息部分丢失，导致无法直接推广到SIS过程，因此需要为SIS开发近似方差分析框架。
AI.method: 结合Gleeson的近似主方程框架与van Kampen系统规模展开，推导出关于易感者/SI边/SS边计数向量的封闭漂移和扩散矩阵，再通过Langevin/Lyapunov方程求解时变协方差。
AI.result: 在泊松、正则和幂律网络上的Gillespie模拟验证表明，该方法与模拟结果吻合良好，但在流行病阈值附近和强异质性网络上存在偏差。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方差近似方法为配置模型图上SIS过程的波动分析提供了可行的理论框架，弥补了FCLT在该领域的空白，但仍需改进在临界点附近和高异质性网络中的准确性。

title: Effects of Impurity Scattering on Orbital Hall Conductivity and Orbital Transport in Ru-based Alloys
summary: The role of impurity scattering in the generation and transport of orbital current remains less established than in conventional spin Hall systems. Here we investigate Ru-based nonmagnet/ferromagnet bilayers in which the impurity scattering is tuned by Cu or Ti alloying. According to SOT measurement and thickness-dependent drift-diffusion analysis, we extract the effective orbital Hall conductivity and the orbital diffusion length. We find that the orbital Hall effect in polycrystalline Ru is dominated by intrinsic mechanism that is moderately robust against weak disorder but suppressed by stronger alloy disorder. However, the orbital diffusion length remains nearly unchanged at approximately 14 nm over the investigated impurity range. This behavior indicates that orbital transport is not governed simply by an impurity scattering. Together with previous temperature-dependent measurements, our results show that static impurities and dynamic lattice disorder affect orbital transport through distinct microscopic channels. These results provide new insight into how disorder governs orbital generation and transport, and offer experimental guidance for developing high-efficient orbitronic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Cu/Ti合金化调控Ru基非磁/铁磁双层膜中的杂质散射，发现多晶Ru的轨道霍尔效应主要由内禀机制主导，对弱无序有一定耐受性但会被强合金无序抑制，而轨道扩散长度(~14 nm)几乎不受杂质影响，表明静态杂质与动态晶格无序通过不同微观通道影响轨道输运。
AI.motivation: 轨道电流的产生与输运中杂质散射的作用机制尚不清晰，远不如自旋霍尔系统中那样被充分理解，因此需要系统研究杂质散射对轨道霍尔效应的影响。
AI.method: 制备Ru基非磁/铁磁双层膜，通过Cu或Ti合金化调控杂质散射强度；利用自旋轨道转矩(SOT)测量和厚度依赖的漂移-扩散分析，提取有效轨道霍尔电导率和轨道扩散长度。
AI.result: 多晶Ru的轨道霍尔效应由内禀机制主导，对弱无序有一定鲁棒性但被强合金无序抑制；轨道扩散长度(~14 nm)在杂质浓度变化范围内几乎保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 轨道输运并非简单地由杂质散射主导，静态杂质与动态晶格无序通过不同微观通道影响轨道输运，为开发高效轨道电子材料提供了实验指导。

title: Twist-configured moire-moire reconstruction governs diverse commensurate double-moire phases in twisted bilayer graphene on h-BN
comment: Main(26 pages, 5 figures), SI(20 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables)
summary: The coexistence of multiple moire lattices in van der Waals heterostructures raises a fundamental question: how do distinct moire patterns interact and reconstruct? Here, we investigate twisted bilayer graphene (tBG) on hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN), where tBG and graphene/h-BN moire structures coexist, using conductive atomic force microscopy combined with continuum-model simulations. We show that reconstruction between these moire lattices-moire-moire reconstruction-manifests across multiple length scales, giving rise to diverse commensurate double-moire phases. Locally, the stacking registry between the two moire lattices is uniquely selected by the global twist configuration (helical or alternate), mediated by rotational relaxation of the shared graphene layer. This registry, together with twist angle and strain, governs commensurate domains from C3z-symmetric to strained symmetry-modified structures. These results establish moire-moire reconstruction as a general framework for engineering structural and electronic order -- including theoretically predicted topological flat bands below the magic angle -- in multilayer moire materials.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了扭转双层石墨烯（tBG）与六方氮化硼（h-BN）构成的异质结构中多重莫尔晶格的共存与重构现象，发现"莫尔-莫尔重构"会在多个尺度上产生丰富的可调谐双莫尔相，进而影响材料的结构与电子性质。
AI.motivation: 探究范德华异质结构中多个莫尔晶格如何相互作用并发生重构这一基础性问题。
AI.method: 结合导纳原子力显微镜（c-AFM）和连续介质模型模拟，分析tBG/h-BN体系中的莫尔-莫尔重构行为。
AI.result: 发现莫尔-莫尔重构在多个尺度上产生多样的可公度双莫尔相；局部堆叠配准由整体扭转构型（螺旋型或交替型）决定，通过共享石墨烯层的旋转弛豫介导；配准关系、扭转角和应变共同调控可公度畴的结构。
AI.conclusion: 莫尔-莫尔重构为工程化多层莫尔材料中的结构序与电子序（包括理论上预言的神奇角以下拓扑平带）提供了通用框架。

title: Intrinsic Matching Frustration in Fluctuating Finite Systems
summary: We show that matching between interacting constituents is intrinsically incomplete in finite systems due to equilibrium fluctuations. While fluctuations in finite populations are a well-established feature of statistical mechanics, their direct impact on processes requiring simultaneous matching has not been explicitly formulated. Because matching is determined by the smaller of fluctuating populations rather than by their average values, equilibrium fluctuations systematically reduce the number of realizable matching events. We formalize this effect as intrinsic matching frustration (IMF), a universal statistical constraint that arises whenever discrete fluctuating populations must be paired. IMF generates a finite population of intact ("spectator") particles even at equilibrium and suppresses matching-dependent processes relative to expectations based on mean populations. For independent Poisson populations, IMF admits an exact solution based on the Skellam distribution, valid for all particle numbers. More generally, interactions and correlations may modify the detailed fluctuation statistics, but for sufficiently large populations the mismatch is determined solely by the variance of the population imbalance and exhibits universal scaling behavior. IMF therefore represents a generic equilibrium property of finite systems, independent of microscopic rates and interaction mechanisms. The effect provides a universal fluctuation-induced limitation on pairwise association, binding, and matching processes, with implications for chemical reactions, molecular binding, nanoscale quantum systems, and biological environments. By identifying a fundamental fluctuation-induced constraint on matching, IMF complements established descriptions of finite-size and equilibrium fluctuation effects in statistical mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"固有匹配挫败"(IMF)概念，指出在有限系统中，由于平衡涨落，可匹配的事件数量由较小波动的群体决定而非其平均值，从而系统性降低匹配效率。这一效应独立于微观速率和相互作用机制，是一种普适的统计约束。
AI.motivation: 传统统计力学虽熟知有限群体中的平衡涨落现象，但从未明确阐述这些涨落对需要同时匹配的过程产生的直接影响。作者旨在填补这一空白，揭示涨落如何系统性地限制匹配事件。
AI.method: 通过理论分析证明匹配由较小波动的群体决定而非平均值；对独立泊松群体，利用Skellam分布给出精确解；论证了对于足够大的系统，失配仅由群体不平衡的方差决定，并呈现普适标度行为。
AI.result: IMF产生即使在平衡态下也存在完整的"旁观者"粒子群体；抑制基于平均群体预期的匹配依赖过程；独立于微观速率和相互作用机制，是一种有限系统的普适平衡态性质。
AI.conclusion: IMF是一种普适的涨落诱导约束，适用于配对、结合和匹配过程，对化学反应、分子结合、纳米量子系统和生物环境具有重要启示，补充了统计力学中有限尺寸和平衡涨落效应的既有描述。

title: Evidence of the Cooper-Pair Field with Gaussian Memory Kernel in Unconventional Superconductors
summary: We develop a dynamical description of the superconducting pair field in which the Cooper-channel Hubbard--Stratonovich field $Δ$ is treated as a memory-dressed Bogoliubov pair field rather than as a purely static order parameter. Starting from the standard pair-field effective action, we couple $Δ$ to antinode-selected collective or self-generated fields. An ensemble of such modes produces a distribution of local Bogoliubov frequencies; when this distribution is approximately Gaussian, ensemble averaging gives the memory factor $\exp[-t^2/(2τ_g^2)]$. In cuprate superconductors, the antinodal gap or pseudogap restricts the active electronic phase space and acts as a momentum-space spectral cavity. It selects fluctuation wavevectors $\mathbf Q_a$ that may become charge-density-wave-like instabilities in an ordered limit, but behave as a reservoir of local collective fields in the fluctuating regime. The same framework admits resonant algebraic prefactors, so that threshold and forced-oscillator responses generate the hierarchy $p=-1/2,1/2,1,3/2,\ldots$, while the Gaussian envelope cuts off secular growth and converts these branches into finite spectral components. The resulting picture contains a robust pseudogap memory channel and, below $T_c$, an additional condensate-assisted coherent channel proportional to $|Δ_0(T)|^2$. Thus the superconducting transition primarily reorganizes pair-field spectral weight between incoherent pseudogap memory and coherent Bogoliubov memory. The frequency-domain response is expressed in terms of parabolic-cylinder functions, and comparisons with Raman, ARPES, tunneling, and doping-dependent ARPES scaling suggest that these probes are complementary projections of the same Gaussian-memory pair continuum. We compare our numerical results with the recent experimental data on Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一种超导配对场的动力学描述，将Cooper通道Hubbard-Stratonovich场Δ视为具有记忆效应的Bogoliubov配对场，而非纯静态序参量。通过将Δ与反节点集体场耦合，在准高斯分布假设下得到高斯记忆因子。该框架在铜氧化物超导体中产生赝隙记忆通道和凝聚态辅助相干通道，超导转变主要将配对谱权重从非相干赝隙记忆重组到相干Bogoliubov记忆。与Raman、ARPES、隧穿等实验对比表明，这些探测手段是同一高斯记忆配对连续谱的不同投影。
AI.motivation: 传统超导理论将配对场视为静态序参量，无法完整描述铜氧化物高温超导体中赝隙相丰富的动力学行为。本文旨在建立一种超越静态近似的动力学框架，通过引入记忆效应和反节点集体模，统一描述赝隙态和超导态中配对场的谱学特征。
AI.method: 从标准配对场有效作用量出发，将反节点选择的集体场或自产生场与Δ耦合；对局域Bogoliubov频率的系综进行高斯平均得到记忆因子$\exp[-t^2/(2τ_g^2)]$；通过谐振代数前缀因子产生谱指数层级$p=-1/2,1/2,1,3/2,\ldots$；利用抛物柱面函数表达频域响应。
AI.result: 建立了包含赝隙记忆通道（$T_c$以上主导）和凝聚态辅助相干通道（正比于$|Δ_0(T)|^2$，$T_c$以下出现）的双通道图象。超导转变本质上是配对谱权重在两个通道间的重组。数值结果与Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$的Raman、ARPES、隧穿等实验数据定性一致。
AI.conclusion: 铜氧化物超导体中配对场的动力学行为可统一描述为高斯记忆配对连续谱，各种谱学探针是该连续谱的不同投影。该框架为理解赝隙相和超导态的关系提供了新的理论视角。

title: dpti: An Automated Thermodynamic Integration Workflow for Phase Diagram Calculations with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Thermodynamic integration (TI) is a widely used approach for computing free energies and phase diagrams. However, TI calculations driven by machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) remain technically challenging because they require careful design of reversible integration paths and many closely related molecular dynamics (MD) tasks for each phase and state point. To address these challenges, we present dpti, an open-source Python package that automates TI workflows for phase diagram calculations with MLIPs. dpti connects reference systems with analytically known free energies to MLIP-described atomic and molecular solids and liquids through reversible integration paths. Given JSON input files, dpti generates and runs the required MD tasks, computes free energy contributions, estimates errors, and propagates coexistence points into phase boundaries. We demonstrate the usage of dpti with two examples driven by Deep Potential models: a silica phase diagram involving beta-quartz, coesite, and melt, and the ice Ih-liquid water phase boundary. dpti provides a useful tool for automated phase diagram calculations of materials modeled by MLIPs.

AI.tldr: dpti是一个开源Python工具包，可自动执行基于机器学习力场的热力学积分工作流，用于计算相图，通过连接参考系统、生成MD任务并传播共存点来实现自动化。
AI.motivation: 基于机器学习力场（MLIP）的热力学积分（TI）计算在技术上具有挑战性，因为它需要精心设计可逆积分路径以及为每个相和状态点运行大量密切相关的分子动力学（MD）任务。
AI.method: dpti通过可逆积分路径，将具有解析已知自由能的参考系统连接到MLIP描述的原子和分子固体及液体。给定JSON输入文件后，dpti自动生成并运行所需的MD任务，计算自由能贡献，估计误差，并将共存点传播为相边界。
AI.result: 通过两个Deep Potential模型驱动的示例展示了dpti的实用性：二氧化硅相图（涉及β-石英、柯石英和熔体）以及冰Ih-液态水相边界。
AI.conclusion: dpti为MLIP建模材料的自动化相图计算提供了一个有用的工具。

title: Pressure-Driven Structural Transitions without a Displacive Charge-Density Wave in La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$
summary: We investigated the structural properties of bilayer nickelate La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$ as a function of pressure and temperature. At ambient conditions, we show that the material crystallizes as a monoclinic superstructure distinct from the one previously reported and close to the pseudo-orthorhombic structure of pristine La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. No signatures of satellite reflections associated with charge density wave (CDW) ordering are detected at low temperature. Upon compression, a sequence of pressure-induced structural transitions from monoclinic to orthorhombic 15 GPa and then tetragonal 21 GPa symmetry is observed. Within the superconducting dome, the quality of the X-ray diffraction data enables structural refinements enabling theoretical models to understand the emergence of superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 研究双层镍酸盐La₂SmNi₂O₇在常压和高压下的结构性质，发现其单斜超结构，无电荷密度波，压力下经历单斜→正交→四方相变。
AI.motivation: 探究双层镍酸盐La₂SmNi₂O₇在压力和温度下的结构特性，特别是其与超导性相关的结构相变行为。
AI.method: 通过X射线衍射（XRD）在不同压力和温度条件下对La₂SmNi₂O₇进行晶体结构分析。
AI.result: 常压下为单斜超结构，与先前报告不同；低温下无CDW迹象；压力诱导单斜→正交（15 GPa）→四方（21 GPa）相变；超导穹顶内的高质量XRD数据支持结构精修。
AI.conclusion: 明确了La₂SmNi₂O₇的晶体结构及压力诱导相变序列，为理解其超导机制提供了结构基础。

title: Free energies and optimal reaction coordinates via entropy production
summary: We show through theory and numerical experiments that a straightforward calculation of entropy production on short molecular dynamics trajectories allows estimating free-energy barriers and identifying optimal reaction coordinates of activated processes. To this aim, we perform an analysis based on stochastic energetics on a set of trajectories relaxing towards equilibrium from a same initial configuration, projected on different putative coordinates. After demonstrating the approach on simple benchmarks, we show that it is possible to estimate the free-energy barrier of a complex high-dimensional system (carbon nanoparticles in water) and to rank the quality of order parameters, in agreement with the committor probability. The results shed light on the entanglement between the second law, free-energy landscapes, reaction coordinates and kinetic rates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论和数值实验证明，对短分子动力学轨迹直接计算熵产生可用于估计自由能势垒并识别活化过程的最优反应坐标，并在碳纳米颗粒-水等复杂高维系统中验证了该方法与committor概率的一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统方法计算自由能势垒和识别反应坐标通常需要长时间轨迹或先验知识，计算成本高。作者希望利用短轨迹上的熵产生这一物理量，提供一种高效、无需预知反应坐标的新途径。
AI.method: 基于随机能量学，对从同一初始构型出发向平衡态松弛的多条轨迹进行分析；在不同候选坐标上投影轨迹，计算各自的熵产生，以此评估自由能势垒并排序反应坐标质量。
AI.result: 在简单基准系统上验证了方法的有效性；成功应用于碳纳米颗粒在水中的复杂高维系统，能够估计自由能势垒，并有效排序不同序参数的质量，结果与committor概率一致。
AI.conclusion: 熵产生、自由能景观、反应坐标与动力学速率之间存在内在联系，短轨迹熵产生计算为活化过程研究提供了新的理论工具。

title: Substrate-Mediated Persistent Photodoping in WSe2/hBN Field-Effect Transistors Enabled by Defect States in SiO2
summary: Photodoping plays an important role in determining the optoelectronic response of two-dimensional semiconductor devices; however, the origin of the responsible trap states remains unclear. In this work, we investigate UV-induced photodoping in multilayer WSe2 field-effect transistors (FETs) based on WSe2/hBN heterostructures on SiO2/p-Si substrates. Wavelength-dependent measurements reveal pronounced n-type photodoping under 405 nm illumination, whereas the effect is orders of magnitude weaker under 640 nm excitation and for p-type photodoping. Furthermore, when the SiO2 layer is removed, both n-type and p-type photodoping are strongly suppressed, demonstrating that the oxide layer is essential for persistent photodoping. Analysis of defect-state distributions in amorphous SiO2, together with first-principles calculations for hBN defects, shows that the experimental observations cannot be explained by defects in hBN. Instead, the results indicate that defect states in the SiO2 substrate act as charge reservoirs that facilitate charge transfer and long-term carrier trapping. These findings highlight the dominant role of substrate-related trap states in UV-induced photodoping and photogating behavior in WSe2 FET devices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了紫外光诱导的多层WSe2场效应晶体管中的光掺杂效应，发现SiO2衬底中的缺陷态是持久光掺杂的主要电荷陷阱来源，而非hBN中的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 光电掺杂对二维半导体器件的光电响应至关重要，但负责捕获载流子的陷阱态来源尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过波长相关测量（405 nm与640 nm对比）、去除SiO2层的对照实验，结合无定形SiO2缺陷态分布分析和hBN缺陷的第一性原理计算，系统研究光掺杂机制。
AI.result: 405 nm光照下产生显著的n型光掺杂，640 nm下效果弱数个量级；去除SiO2层后，n型和p型光掺杂均被强烈抑制；理论计算排除了hBN缺陷的主导作用。
AI.conclusion: SiO2衬底中的缺陷态作为电荷库，是紫外光诱导光掺杂和光栅控行为的主要来源，而非hBN中的缺陷。

title: Crystal structure and basic properties of dirhenate quantum materials
summary: The anhydrous divalent 3d-metal dirhenate quantum materials, M(ReO$_4$)$_2$,were synthesized using solid-state methods for M = Mn through Zn. Previously unreported Mg(ReO4)2 is also described. Their layered crystal structures, which feature an in-plane triangular lattice of M$^{2+}$, were refined using single crystal X-ray diffraction, and their optical absorption and several other physical properties were characterized. Their magnetism and heat capacity reveal long-range magnetic order at low temperatures in many of the M(ReO$_4$)$_2$ phases. Notably, many of these ordered states are sensitive to applied magnetic fields and can be readily suppressed by relatively small fields, suggesting competing magnetic interactions in a low-dimensional framework, which appear worthy of further study.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一系列无水二价3d金属高铼酸盐M(ReO₄)₂（M=Mn到Zn，以及Mg）的合成、晶体结构、光学吸收、磁性及热容等物理性质，发现其中多数相在低温下存在长程磁有序，且对较小外加磁场敏感，表明低维框架中存在竞争磁相互作用。
AI.motivation: 探索新型量子材料，特别是具有三角晶格的低维磁性体系，寻找其中可能存在的竞争磁相互作用和有趣的磁有序行为，为后续研究提供基础。
AI.method: 采用固相法合成M(ReO₄)₂（M=Mn到Zn及Mg），利用单晶X射线衍射解析层状晶体结构（呈现面内三角格子的M²⁺排列），并表征其光学吸收、磁性及热容等物理性质。
AI.result: 多数M(ReO₄)₂相在低温下表现出长程磁有序；这些有序态对外加磁场敏感，较小磁场即可抑制磁有序。
AI.conclusion: 该系列材料中存在低维框架下的竞争磁相互作用，值得进一步深入研究。

title: Single-Scan Characterization of $^{14}$N Nuclei via $^1$H-Detected Rotating-Frame Relaxometry
summary: $^{14}$N NMR is notoriously difficult to perform in liquids due to the very fast spin relaxation and the large quadrupolar couplings, which render many signals invisible. We show here how $^{14}$N nuclei of biomolecular constituents can be probed indirectly by reintroducing the scalar relaxation of the second kind contribution to the polarization lifetimes of J-coupled protons in double resonance spin-locking experiments. The enhanced $^1$H relaxation rates in the rotating-frame allow for direct evaluation of nitrogen chemical shift and polarization lifetimes, from which one- and even two-bond $^1$H-$^{14}$N scalar couplings as well as $^{14}$N quadrupolar interactions can be determined. We demonstrate the versatility of this method by characterizing $^1$H-$^{14}$N spin pairs in several molecules of biological importance, showing proton relaxation enhancements beyond one order of magnitude. We further observe a pronounced effect from intermolecular hydrogen bonding. Our approach can be readily integrated into existing biomolecular NMR methodologies, as demonstrated here for $^1$H-detected relaxation-editing experiments with water suppression. This method provides access to nitrogen's picosecond-modulated quadrupolar interaction via single-scan proton detection in systems that would otherwise yield almost no detectable direct $^{14}$N signal even after averaging over thousands of transients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过双共振自旋锁定实验间接检测¹⁴N核的方法，利用标量弛豫的第二次贡献增强¹H在旋转坐标系中的弛豫速率，从而获得¹⁴N的化学位移、极化寿命、¹H-¹⁴N标量耦合及四极相互作用信息。该方法在生物分子体系中实现了质子弛豫增强超过一个数量级，并可整合到现有生物分子NMR方法中，通过单次质子扫描即可获取¹⁴N信号。
AI.motivation: ¹⁴N NMR在液体中因自旋弛豫极快和四极耦合巨大而难以直接检测，导致许多信号不可见。作者旨在开发一种间接方法，通过质子检测来获取¹⁴N的核磁共振参数，克服直接检测的灵敏度瓶颈。
AI.method: 在双共振自旋锁定实验中，重新引入标量弛豫的第二次贡献(SCRK)，增强与¹⁴N耦合的¹H在旋转坐标系中的弛豫速率。通过测量¹H弛豫增强，推导¹⁴N化学位移、极化寿命、单键和双键¹H-¹⁴N标量耦合常数以及¹⁴N四极相互作用参数。
AI.result: 在多种生物重要分子中成功表征了¹H-¹⁴N自旋对，质子弛豫增强超过一个数量级；观察到分子间氢键的显著影响；在原本数千次扫描也无法检测到直接¹⁴N信号的体系中，通过单次质子扫描即可获取¹⁴N相关信息。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可便捷整合到现有生物分子NMR方法中（如¹H检测弛豫编辑实验和水抑制），为研究氮的皮秒时间尺度四极相互作用提供了高效工具，显著提升了¹⁴N核磁共振的可及性。

title: Full Gate-Voltage Control of a Parity-Protected Superconducting Qubit with an Altermagnetic Josephson Junction
summary: Parity-protected superconducting qubits offer intrinsically long coherence, but many current implementations require magnetic-flux biasing, which introduces flux noise, control overhead, and limited scalability. Here we propose a parity-protected qubit based on a gate-tunable superconductor-altermagnet-superconductor Josephson junction. Altermagnets are compensated magnets with momentum-dependent spin splitting and zero net magnetization, providing spin-dependent functionality without external magnetic fields. In the proposed junction, the two spin sectors acquire opposite phase shifts, generating two Josephson channels whose interference is controlled electrically by the chemical potential. At the tuned $0$-$π$ transition, the first Josephson harmonic is strongly suppressed while the second harmonic dominates, yielding a double-well potential with two nearly degenerate states of opposite Cooper-pair parity. For realistic gatemon-compatible parameters, we estimate coherence times of up to tens of milliseconds while maintaining fully gate-controlled qubit operations. These results establish altermagnetic Josephson junctions as a promising route toward protected superconducting qubits with local, scalable, and all-electrical control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于门可调超导体-交变磁体-超导体约瑟夫森结的宇称保护量子比特，通过电化学势控制实现0-π跃迁，在无需磁场偏置的条件下获得长相干时间（数十毫秒），为可扩展的全电控超导量子比特提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 现有宇称保护超导量子比特依赖磁通偏置，引入磁通噪声、控制开销大且可扩展性受限，亟需一种无需外加磁场、全电控的量子比特方案。
AI.method: 利用交变磁体（altermagnet）的零净磁化但动量依赖自旋分裂特性，在S-Al-S结中使两个自旋通道获得相反相位偏移，通过化学电势电调实现0-π跃迁，抑制第一约瑟夫森谐波并使第二谐波主导，形成双阱势与宇称简并对。
AI.result: 在gatemon兼容参数下，理论估计相干时间可达数十毫秒，且量子比特操作完全由栅极电压控制，无需磁通偏置。
AI.conclusion: 交变磁体约瑟夫森结为实现局域、可扩展、全电控的保护性超导量子比特提供了有前景的新路线。

title: Watts per event: evaluating Sustainability of HEP Event Generators beyond the LHC era
summary: The development, tuning and operation of Monte Carlo event generators beyond the LHC era require vast amount of resources. In this study we investigate the sustainability of these software with a containerized set of tools (named 77rev/propripy), by benchmarking the HIJING++ heavy-ion Monte Carlo event generator. We analyze the performance of various CPU architectures and show that by choosing the level of multithreading properly, the cost of event generation can be optimized. The presented approach can reduce the energy footprint of high-energy physics event generators and therefore alleviate the ever-increasing, ubiquitous computational challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过容器化工具77rev/propripy对HIJING++重离子蒙特卡洛事件生成器进行基准测试，发现通过优化多线程级别可以降低事件生成成本，从而减少高能物理事件生成器的能源足迹，缓解计算挑战。
AI.motivation: LHC后时代蒙特卡洛事件生成器的开发、调优和运行需要大量资源，亟需提高其可持续性。
AI.method: 使用容器化工具集77rev/propripy，以HIJING++重离子蒙特卡洛事件生成器为基准，分析不同CPU架构的性能，并优化多线程级别。
AI.result: 通过合理选择多线程级别，可以优化事件生成的成本，并减少能源足迹。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可降低高能物理事件生成器的能源消耗，缓解日益增长的计算挑战。

title: Quantum Destabilization of Skyrmions in Centrosymmetric Frustrated Magnets
summary: We investigate the role of the spin quantum number $s$ on the stability of skyrmions in a $J_1-J_2-J_3$ centrosymmetric quantum Heisenberg model on a square lattice using the neural network quantum states method. Our results reveal that the skyrmion stability $Q$ is severely degraded when transitioning from the semiclassical regime to the extreme quantum limit ($s=1/2$), where it ultimately vanishes. We demonstrate that this destabilization is driven by quantum longitudinal fluctuations, with $Q$ exhibiting a power-law decay as a function of the reciprocal spin moment $1/s$. Notably, the extreme quantum limit ($s=1/2$) deviates drastically from this scaling behavior, exhibiting distinct physics compared to larger spin moments. Furthermore, we reveal the microscopic origin of this decay by establishing a quantitative correspondence between skyrmion stability, entanglement, and local spin magnitude: as the local second Rényi entropy (an indicator of entanglement) increases and the local spin magnitude is suppressed, the skyrmion stability vanishes linearly. This regime marks a quantum state where the skyrmion number $C$ remains as remanent geometric feature of the spin orientations, yet the skyrmion stability $Q$ vanishes due to the longitudinal suppression of the local spin magnitude. Our findings suggest that classically robust skyrmion phases in frustrated lattices are fundamentally restricted to high-spin materials, indicating that a spin moment must of at least $s = 3/2$ is required for the realization of stable, atomic-scale topological textures.

AI.tldr: 本文使用神经网络量子态方法，研究自旋量子数s对J1-J2-J3中心对称量子海森堡模型中斯格明子稳定性的影响。发现从半经典到极端量子极限（s=1/2）时，斯格明子稳定性Q严重下降直至消失，其根本原因是量子纵向涨落导致的局域自旋幅度抑制与纠缠熵增加。结果表明，稳定的原子尺度拓扑纹理至少需要s=3/2的自旋矩。
AI.motivation: 探究自旋量子数s（特别是从半经典到极端量子极限）如何影响中心对称量子海森堡模型中斯格明子的稳定性，并揭示其微观物理机制。
AI.method: 采用神经网络量子态（Neural Network Quantum States）方法，对平方晶格上J1-J2-J3中心对称量子海森堡模型进行数值模拟，分析不同自旋量子数s下斯格明子的稳定性Q、斯格明子数C、二阶Rényi熵和局域自旋幅度的变化关系。
AI.result: 1）从半经典到极端量子极限s=1/2，斯格明子稳定性Q严重下降并最终消失；2）这种失稳由量子纵向涨落驱动，Q随1/s呈幂律衰减，但s=1/2极端量子极限显著偏离该标度行为；3）斯格明子稳定性与局域二阶Rényi熵（纠缠指标）增加及局域自旋幅度抑制呈线性关系；4）在极端量子极限下，斯格明子数C作为几何特征保留，但稳定性Q因局域自旋纵向抑制而消失。
AI.conclusion: 经典上稳健的斯格明子相在阻挫晶格中本质上局限于高自旋材料，实现稳定的原子尺度拓扑纹理至少需要自旋矩s ≥ 3/2。

title: Measurement-induced spatially nonuniform fluctuations of the local particle number and their crossover in a quasiperiodic free-fermion chain
summary: We study continuously monitored dynamics of a quasiperiodic free-fermion chain defined on a Fibonacci lattice. We focus on fluctuations of the local particle number, which exhibit a spatially uniform distribution in the unitary limit. Remarkably, we demonstrate that they exhibit a nonuniform spatial pattern originating from the quasiperiodic long-range order under continuous measurement. Furthermore, employing both physicaland perpendicular-space analyses, we elucidate that measurement-induced crossover emerges in fluctuations due to the interplay between the incommensurate modulation and the continuous measurement. While weak measurement yields a distribution reflecting the long-range spatial structure of the quasiperiodic system, an increase in measurement strength alters the distribution into one dominated by the local environment of each site. We also elucidate that the measurement-induced crossover emerges in other physical quantities such as connected correlation functions. These findings offer insights into nonequilibrium quasiperiodic phenomena emerging in continuously monitored dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究斐波那契准周期自由费米子链在连续测量下的局域粒子数涨落，发现测量会诱导从反映长程准周期结构到局域环境主导的分布交叉行为。
AI.motivation: 探索准周期系统在连续量子测量这一非平衡条件下的独特行为，特别是测量如何影响局域粒子数涨落的空间分布模式。
AI.method: 采用斐波那契晶格上的准周期自由费米子链模型，结合连续测量动力学，通过物理空间和垂直空间（perpendicular-space）两种分析方法进行研究。
AI.result: (1) 连续测量导致原本在幺正极限下均匀的局域粒子数涨落出现非均匀空间模式；(2) 弱测量下涨落分布反映准周期系统的长程空间结构，强测量下则变为局域环境主导；(3) 测量诱导的交叉行为也出现在关联函数等物理量中。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了准周期系统中连续测量与非公度调制之间的竞争机制，为理解非平衡准周期量子现象提供了新的见解。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Encapsulation Methods for Endohedral Doping of Single-Wall Carbon Nanotubes
