summary: Single wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) are promising building blocks for nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices, yet reliable and stable doping, particularly n type, remains challenging due to strong environmental sensitivity and competing extrinsic effects. Encapsulation of charge transfer molecules within the SWCNT cavity offers a promising route to stable doping while preserving the nanotubes outer surface for subsequent processing. Here, we systematically investigate the filling of arc discharge SWCNTs with the electron donor tetrathiafulvalene and electron acceptor tetracyanoquinodimethane, comparing different methods for filling, including melt filling, solution reflux, and vacuum phase sublimation. We follow the entire processing workflow from raw, unfilled powders to aqueous dispersions and employ density gradient ultracentrifugation to separate filled from empty nanotubes as well as metallic from semiconducting ones. Encapsulation efficiency and electronic modification are assessed using absorption spectroscopy, resonant Raman scattering, thermogravimetric analysis, and electron paramagnetic resonance. Finally, we introduce a complementary vacuum-phase method that removes externally adsorbed molecules without extensive solvent washing, enabling cleaner encapsulated systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了通过将电子给体TTF和电子受体TCNQ封装入单壁碳纳米管（SWCNT）内部实现稳定掺杂的方法，比较了熔融填充、溶液回流和真空相升华三种填充工艺，并利用密度梯度超速离心分离填充与未填充的纳米管，最后提出一种真空相方法去除外部吸附分子，获得更清洁的封装体系。
AI.motivation: 单壁碳纳米管在纳米电子和光电器件中具有巨大潜力，但可靠且稳定的掺杂（尤其是n型掺杂）因环境敏感性和竞争性外在效应而面临挑战。将电荷转移分子封装在碳纳米管内部可避免外部环境干扰，同时保留外表面用于后续加工，因此亟需系统研究封装方法和效率。
AI.method: 采用电弧放电SWCNT，以四硫富瓦烯（TTF）为电子给体、四氰基对苯醌二甲烷（TCNQ）为电子受体，通过熔融填充、溶液回流和真空相升华三种方法进行填充。利用密度梯度超速离心分离填充/未填充纳米管及金属/半导体型纳米管。通过吸收光谱、共振拉曼散射、热重分析和电子顺磁共振评估封装效率和电子修饰效果。最后引入真空相方法去除外部吸附分子。
AI.result: 成功比较了三种填充方法对SWCNT的封装效率，实现了填充与未填充纳米管以及金属型与半导体型纳米管的分离。真空相方法可以有效去除外部吸附分子，无需大量溶剂洗涤，得到更清洁的封装体系。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将电荷转移分子（TTF和TCNQ）封装入SWCNT空腔是实现稳定掺杂的有效途径，真空相方法为获得清洁封装体系提供了新方案，有助于推动SWCNT在纳米电子和光电器件中的应用。

title: Thermophysical and mechanical properties of UFe$_2$ fabricated by spark plasma sintering
summary: Following the accident at the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant in 2011, core meltdown produced fuel debris whose safe retrieval and management require reliable thermophysical and mechanical property data. Among the metallic phases identified in the debris, the U-Fe system is particularly important because of the abundant iron originating from in-vessel stainless steel structures. However, within this system, the high-temperature thermophysical properties of UFe$_2$ have received relatively little attention, with most prior studies focusing on its magnetic and electronic properties. To fill this data gap in the literature, we fabricated dense, nearly single-phase polycrystalline UFe$_2$ by arc melting followed by spark plasma sintering, and characterized its thermal and mechanical properties from room temperature to 1073 K. Results show that the thermal conductivity of UFe$_2$ increased monotonically from 10 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ at 306 K to 25 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ at 1073 K, surpassing those of the iron intermetallics Fe$_2$Zr and Fe$_2$B at high temperatures. In addition, UFe$_2$ is mechanically more compliant, displaying a Young's modulus $E$ of 69 GPa, a shear modulus $G$ of 24 GPa, and a Vickers hardness $H_{\mathrm{V}}$ of 5.6 GPa, all well below those of both Fe intermetallics. Consequently, during decommissioning, thermal-management and structural evaluations should take into account the comparatively high-conductivity and mechanically compliant nature of UFe$_2$ within the heterogeneous fuel debris.

AI.tldr: 本文通过制备高密度多晶UFe₂，首次系统测量了其从室温到1073K的热物理和力学性能，发现其热导率随温度升高而增加（10→25 W/mK），且比Fe₂Zr和Fe₂B更软更易变形，为福岛核燃料碎片的退役处理提供了关键数据支撑。
AI.motivation: 福岛核事故后产生的燃料碎片中含有U-Fe系金属相（UFe₂），但高温热物理性质数据严重缺失，以往研究多聚焦于磁性和电子性质，无法满足安全回收与管理的工程需求。
AI.method: 采用电弧熔炼+放电等离子烧结（SPS）制备高密度近单相多晶UFe₂，系统测量从室温到1073K的热导率、杨氏模量、剪切模量、维氏硬度等热物理和力学性能。
AI.result: UFe₂热导率从306K的10 W/mK单调升至1073K的25 W/mK，高温下优于Fe₂Zr和Fe₂B；力学上更柔顺，杨氏模量69 GPa、剪切模量24 GPa、维氏硬度5.6 GPa，均低于上述Fe基金属间化合物。
AI.conclusion: 在核退役过程中，燃料碎片的散热管理和结构评估需考虑UFe₂的高热导率和低刚度特性，以保证安全处置。

title: Application of SAP-X2C to Spectroscopy and Comparison to Screened Nuclear Spin--Orbit Approximations
summary: Recently, Surjuse and Valeev [\textit{J. Chem. Theory Comput.} \textbf{22}, 3443--3452 (2026).] suggested to use a simple superposition of atomic potentials to account for two-electron picture-change error in one-electron exact two-component (SAP-X2C) theory. Herein, we generalize this ansatz to analytical derivative theory and apply SAP-X2C to molecular spectroscopy. The accuracy is assessed for NMR, EPR, Mössbauer, UV/vis, as well as X-ray absorption spectroscopy. A thorough comparison with four-component results and the even simpler screened nuclear spin--orbit (SNSO) approximation reveals that both SNSO-X2C and SAP-X2C perform excellently for spectroscopic properties. The major advantage of SAP-X2C over SNSO-X2C is consequently its well defined thermochemical limit and its less empirical nature. Therefore, SAP-X2C may be expected to become the default choice to mitigate the two-electron picture-change error in density functional theory approaches for spectroscopy thanks to its accuracy, simplicity, and efficiency. More complicated approaches to account for this error based on atomic mean-field ansätze may still be relevant for high-level correlated methods and highly accurate thermochemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文将SAP-X2C方法推广至解析导数理论，并应用于分子光谱计算。通过NMR、EPR、Mössbauer、UV/vis和X射线吸收光谱等多种光谱的对比评估，发现SAP-X2C和SNSO-X2C均表现优异。SAP-X2C的主要优势在于其明确的热化学极限和较少的经验性，有望成为密度泛函理论光谱计算中处理双电子图像变化误差的默认选择。
AI.motivation: 解决相对论量子化学中双电子图像变化误差（two-electron picture-change error）对光谱性质计算的影响。此前Surjuse和Valeev提出的SAP-X2C方法仅用于单电子性质，本文将其推广到解析导数和光谱学应用领域。
AI.method: 将简单原子势叠加（SAP-X2C）方法推广至解析导数理论框架，系统评估其在NMR、EPR、Mössbauer、UV/vis和X射线吸收光谱等多种分子光谱中的表现，并与四分量计算结果及SNSO-X2C近似进行对比。
AI.result: SNSO-X2C和SAP-X2C在光谱性质计算中均表现出色。SAP-X2C相比SNSO-X2C具有明确的热化学极限和更少的经验性。基于原子平均场（AMF）的更复杂方法对于高阶相关方法和精确热化学计算仍具价值。
AI.conclusion: SAP-X2C因其准确性、简单性和高效性，有望成为DFT光谱计算中处理双电子图像变化误差的默认方法。而SNSO-X2C虽性能优异但更具经验性。对于高精度热化学和相关方法，AMF类方法仍有其必要性。

title: Vortex-Number-Controlled Josephson Diode Polarity in Corbino Junctions
summary: We demonstrate that the polarity of the Josephson diode effect in Corbino Josephson junctions can be deterministically controlled by the vortex number, which arises as a generic consequence of structured spatial inhomogeneity. By solving the continuum Andreev spectral problem, we identify a mechanism in which the vortex number selectively filters specific spatial Fourier harmonics of the local inhomogeneity. This harmonic selection reshapes the amplitudes and relative phases of higher-order Josephson current harmonics, ultimately reversing the critical-current asymmetry. Numerical simulations of both an effective one-dimensional edge model and full two-dimensional lattice models confirm the robustness of this mechanism. Crucially, our results show that a vortex-parity-dependent reversal of diode polarity is not an exclusive signature of Majorana physics, but can emerge generically from geometric and structural inhomogeneities in Corbino junctions.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在Corbino约瑟夫森结中，通过涡旋数可以确定性控制约瑟夫森二极管效应的极性，这种效应源于空间结构不均匀性。通过连续安德烈夫谱问题求解，发现涡旋数选择性过滤局部不均匀性的特定空间傅里叶谐波，从而重塑高阶约瑟夫森电流谐波的振幅和相对相位，逆转临界电流不对称性。数值模拟验证了该机制的鲁棒性。关键结论是：涡旋奇偶性依赖的二极管极性反转并非马约拉纳物理的专属特征，而可普遍源于Corbino结中的几何和结构不均匀性。
AI.motivation: 揭示约瑟夫森二极管效应极性可控的物理机制，澄清涡旋数调控极性的普适性，避免将其误认为马约拉纳费米子的独有特征。
AI.method: 通过求解连续安德烈夫谱问题、有效一维边缘模型和全二维晶格模型的数值模拟，分析涡旋数对空间傅里叶谐波的过滤机制。
AI.result: 涡旋数选择性过滤特定空间傅里叶谐波，从而改变高阶约瑟夫森电流谐波的振幅和相对相位，实现临界电流不对称性的反转。
AI.conclusion: 涡旋奇偶性依赖的二极管极性反转并非马约拉纳物理的专属特征，而是Corbino结中几何和结构不均匀性的通用效应。

title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
summary: Gold nanonecklace networks are promising platforms for single-electron switching, chemical sensing, and biogating devices because of their nonlinear current--voltage ($I$--$V$) characteristics arising from collective Coulomb-blockade transport. However, the mechanisms governing this macroscopic behavior remain poorly understood because experimental measurements are generally limited to the network topology and global $I$--$V$ response. To address this, we developed a graph-based Kirchhoff framework that represents a self-assembled nanonecklace network as a graph, with nodes corresponding to junctions between necklace segments and edges to the conducting segments themselves. The solver returns the active nodes, conducting subgraph, nodal potentials, and edge currents at each applied bias, while allowing the activation-voltage statistics, network density, and structural topology to be varied independently. The model reproduces the experimentally observed non-Ohmic response, $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$, and shows that this behavior emerges from the collective, staggered activation of threshold junctions and voltage-driven percolation of the conducting subgraph. Independent parameter sweeps reveal that the mean activation voltage shifts the threshold $V_T$ while leaving $ζ$ nearly unchanged, increasing network density raises $ζ$ from approximately 1.9 to 3.1 and enhances current, and topology controls the response even at fixed density and node characteristics. These trends agree qualitatively with experimental observations and establish the model as a design tool for engineering collective transport in self-assembled nanonecklace devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图的Kirchhoff框架，用于模拟自组装金纳米项链网络的集体库仑阻塞输运行为，成功再现了实验观察到的非线性I-V特性，并通过独立参数扫描揭示了激活电压、网络密度和拓扑结构对输运的影响。
AI.motivation: 实验测量通常只能获得网络拓扑和全局I-V响应，而金纳米项链网络中集体库仑阻塞输运的宏观行为机制尚不清晰，缺乏对微观机理的理解。
AI.method: 将自组装纳米项链网络表示为图，节点对应项链节段间的结，边对应导电节段；基于Kirchhoff框架求解各偏压下的活跃节点、导电子图、节点电位和边电流，并独立调控激活电压统计、网络密度和拓扑结构。
AI.result: 模型成功再现了实验观察到的非欧姆响应I ∝ (V-V_T)^ζ；发现该行为源于阈值结的集体阶梯式激活和电压驱动的导电子图逾渗；平均激活电压主要影响V_T而对ζ影响小；网络密度增大使ζ从约1.9升至3.1并增强电流；拓扑结构在固定密度和节点特性下仍控制响应。
AI.conclusion: 模型与实验定性一致，可作为自组装纳米项链器件中集体输运工程的设计工具。

title: Fixed-point tensor network for compactified boson conformal field theory
summary: Fixed-point (FP) tensor networks provide a discrete spacetime representation of conformal field theories (CFTs), offering a new route toward understanding holographic duality, generalized symmetries, and even quantum gravity. In this work, we construct FP tensors for the 2D compactified boson theory at a generic compactification radius, an archetypal irrational CFT, using boundary (open-string) data with conformal boundary conditions. We show that the resulting tensors reproduce the closed-string spectrum with high accuracy and generate stable renormalization-group (RG) flows under the tensor complex renormalization algorithm. Moreover, we identify a controllable exactly marginal deformation at the level of a single tensor, enabling flows that move continuously along the $c=1$ moduli space. This framework establishes a concrete lattice-level route toward describing a broad class of 2D irrational CFTs.

AI.tldr: 本文利用边界（开弦）数据与共形边界条件，为二维紧致玻色子理论构建了固定点张量网络，精确重现了闭弦谱，并通过张量重正化群算法实现了稳定的RG流，识别出可精确调控的边缘形变，建立了在格点层面描述二维无理共形场论的新框架。
AI.motivation: 固定点张量网络为CFT提供了离散时空表示，有助于理解全息对偶、广义对称性和量子引力。作者希望将这一方法推广到无理CFT（如紧致玻色子理论），此前相关工作多局限于有理CFT。
AI.method: 利用边界（开弦）数据与共形边界条件构造FP张量；通过张量复重正化算法验证RG流的稳定性；在单张量层面识别并引入可精确控制的边缘形变，沿c=1模空间连续移动。
AI.result: 所构造的FP张量高精度地重现了闭弦谱，生成的RG流稳定，且通过单张量层面的边缘形变实现了沿模空间的连续流动。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在格点层面描述更广泛的二维无理CFT提供了具体可行的路径，拓展了张量网络方法在CFT和全息研究中的应用范围。

title: Quantum tunneling Mpemba effect
summary: The quantum tunneling Mpemba effect is investigated within a continuous one-dimensional symmetric double-well potential open to external environmental sinks at the boundaries ($x=\pm L$). Using a non-Hermitian spectral decomposition of the effective Hamiltonian, we characterize the open-system relaxation dynamics without relying on abstract state-space quenches. We mathematically prove that the non-monotonic behavior of the first non-trivial even-parity spectral coefficient, $a_{2}(T_{i})$, with respect to the initial preparation temperature $T_{i}$ is a universal topological property born from quantum statistical mechanics. Crucially, we demonstrate that this intermediate thermal peak is governed by the Sturm-Liouville oscillation theorem and remains completely invariant with respect to the global system size $L$, contrasting sharply with the boundary-driven classical Mpemba effect. This universal peak arises from the geometric and nodal alignment between highly localized unperturbed states and extended non-Hermitian decay channels. Furthermore, we clarify that while this mechanism is robust, the actual observation of anomalous crossings in the total survival probability trace $S(t,T_{i})$ and the trace distance $\mathcal{D}(t,T_i)$ demand a strict separation of timescales, requiring the over-barrier escape rate to vastly exceed the decay rate of the deep-well tunneling doublet ($Γ_{2}\gg Γ_{0}$ and $Γ_2\gg Γ_1$). Our continuous formulation successfully bridges real-space classical boundary-driven dissipation with open quantum dynamics, providing novel insights for engineering non-equilibrium states via tailored boundary loss.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了连续一维对称双势阱中开放量子系统的量子隧穿Mpemba效应，发现中间温度峰是量子统计力学的普适拓扑性质，由Sturm-Liouville振荡定理控制且对系统尺寸L完全不变，并阐明异常交叉观测需要严格的时间尺度分离条件。
AI.motivation: 探究开放量子系统中是否存在类似经典Mpemba效应的量子隧穿版本，并用非厄米谱分解方法避免抽象的状态空间淬火，建立更连续的物理图像。
AI.method: 采用非厄米有效哈密顿量的谱分解方法，分析连续一维对称双势阱中开放量子系统的弛豫动力学，结合Sturm-Liouville振荡定理进行数学证明。
AI.result: 证明偶宇称谱系数a₂(Tᵢ)的非单调行为是量子统计力学的普适拓扑性质；中间热峰由Sturm-Liouville振荡定理支配，且对系统尺寸L完全不变；揭示了局域态与非厄米衰变通道的几何与节点对齐机制。
AI.conclusion: 量子隧穿Mpemba效应具有普适拓扑起源，异常交叉的观测需要过垒逃逸率远深阱隧穿双峰的衰变率，为通过边界损耗工程非平衡态提供了新见解。

title: One-dimensional carbon nanostructures with periodic graphitic nitrogen substitution
comment: Manuscript: 24 pages and 4 figures; Supporting Information: 19 pages and 18 figures
summary: Heteroatom substitution is a powerful route to tune the chemical and electronic properties of carbon nanomaterials. In particular, replacement of an sp2 hybridized carbon atom in the graphene lattice with a nitrogen atom (denoted as graphitic nitrogen) induces substantial changes in the electronic properties. These include changes in the band structure that can influence electronic transport, and magnetism. A key requirement for applications is both the periodic and precise incorporation of the heteroatoms in extended carbon lattices. Here, we report the on-surface synthesis and characterization of two one dimensional carbon nanostructures, a polymer and a graphene nanoribbon, consisting of periodically incorporated graphitic nitrogen atoms. The on-surface reactions toward formation of the nanostructures were monitored by scanning tunneling microscopy. The bond-resolved chemical structures of the reaction intermediates and products were investigated by atomic force microscopy, which enabled atomic-scale visualization of the graphitic nitrogen sites. The electronic properties of the nanostructures were studied by scanning tunneling spectroscopy and density functional theory calculations. Our analyses revealed the presence of localized nitrogen-centered electronic states. In the gas phase where the nanostructures are in a neutral charge state, these states undergo spin polarization leading to an open-shell ground state. Upon adsorption on Au(111), the nanostructures exhibit electron transfer to the surface, which resulted in a closed-shell ground state. Our results demonstrate a straightforward and generally applicable route to synthesize graphitic nitrogen-substituted carbon nanomaterials with potential applications in spintronics, catalysis and energy storage.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了通过表面合成方法制备两种一维碳纳米结构（聚合物和石墨烯纳米带），其中周期性掺入石墨型氮原子，并利用STM、AFM、STS和DFT计算对其结构与电子性质进行表征，发现氮中心电子态的自旋极化及电荷转移行为。
AI.motivation: 杂原子取代是调控碳纳米材料化学和电子性质的有效手段，尤其是石墨型氮的掺入能显著改变能带结构和磁性。为实现应用，需要在碳晶格中周期性地精确引入杂原子，但目前缺乏简便通用的合成方法。
AI.method: 采用表面合成方法，在Au(111)表面制备含周期性石墨型氮的聚合物和石墨烯纳米带；利用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）监测反应过程，原子力显微镜（AFM）解析键合分辨的化学结构，结合扫描隧道谱（STS）和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算研究电子性质。
AI.result: 成功实现了石墨型氮原子的周期性掺入，在原子尺度上可视化了氮位点；发现氮中心局域电子态在气相中性态下发生自旋极化，形成开壳层基态；吸附于Au(111)后发生电荷转移，转变为闭壳层基态。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种简便且通用的表面合成路线，用于制备石墨型氮取代的碳纳米材料，在自旋电子学、催化和能量存储等领域具有潜在应用价值。

title: Chiropiezoelectric Energy Harvesting from Lattice-Handedness-Controlled Selenium Nanowires
summary: The growth of wearable electronics, soft robotics, and Internet-of-Things systems has intensified the demand for inorganic piezoelectric materials that harvest weak biomechanical energy. Advances through composition optimization, defect engineering, strain engineering, and orientation control have improved existing electromechanical responses, but have not introduced a new mechanism for enhancing piezoelectricity. Here we propose atomic chirality engineering as a design principle for inorganic piezoelectric nanomaterials. Unlike conventional strategies that modify composition or morphology, atomic chirality alters the handedness of the crystal lattice itself, adding a degree of freedom for controlling dipole alignment, electromechanical coupling, and potentially spin-dependent transport. Using atomically chiral trigonal selenium nanowires as a model system, we show that crystal handedness alone changes piezoelectric performance at identical chemical composition. Piezoresponse force microscopy resolved a consistent enantiomeric difference, with right-handed D-Se nanowires reaching a higher effective piezoelectric coefficient than their left-handed counterparts, and flexible nanogenerators and self-powered acoustic sensors built from the two enantiomers produced distinct outputs under identical deformation. This work establishes atomic chirality as a distinct route for designing piezoelectric materials, one that may extend across non-centrosymmetric inorganic semiconductors for sustainable energy harvesting and wearable sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出原子手性工程作为无机压电纳米材料的设计新原理，以手性三硒纳米线为模型体系，证明晶体手性本身即可改变压电性能，右旋D-Se纳米线比左旋具有更高的有效压电系数，为可穿戴能量收集和传感提供了新思路。
AI.motivation: 现有无机压电材料通过成分优化、缺陷工程、应变工程和取向控制等手段提升了机电响应，但并未引入全新的压电增强机制。可穿戴电子、软体机器人和物联网系统的发展迫切需要能高效收集微弱生物机械能的压电材料。
AI.method: 提出原子手性工程设计原理，即改变晶格本身的手性（左旋/右旋），以原子手性三硒纳米线为模型体系，通过压电力显微镜测量不同手性纳米线的有效压电系数，并构建柔性纳米发电机和自供电声学传感器进行性能对比。
AI.result: 右旋D-Se纳米线的有效压电系数高于左旋对应物；基于两种手性纳米线构建的柔性纳米发电机和自供电声学传感器在相同形变条件下产生显著不同的输出性能，手性差异具有一致性。
AI.conclusion: 原子手性可作为设计压电材料的全新路线，有望推广至其他非中心对称无机半导体，用于可持续能量收集和可穿戴传感应用。

title: ML and AI for density functional theory: different priorities for Kohn-Sham and orbital-free DFT, for electronic and nuclear DFT
summary: We overview similarities and, importantly, differences in computational bottlenecks and accuracy requirements that can be addressed with machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques in electronic and nuclear DFT. From these follow different promising methodological and algorithmic choices depending on whether one machine learns the exchange correlation (XC) functional, the kinetic energy functional (KEF), the density or the basis functions. In particular, while the popular deep neural networks remain a potent choice in the context of KS DFT, we highlight their disadvantages when building KEFs and highlight conceptual advantages - yet to be fully realized - of symbolic regression for both electronic and nuclear DFT. We point out promising approaches that can be carried from the more extensively investigated ML-enhanced electronic DFT to nuclear DFT.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了机器学习（ML）和人工智能（AI）技术在电子和核密度泛函理论（DFT）中的计算瓶颈与精度需求差异，重点分析了交换关联泛函、动能泛函、密度或基函数的学习策略，指出深度神经网络在KS DFT中有效但在构建动能泛函时存在劣势，并强调了符号回归的概念优势，同时探讨了从电子DFT向核DFT迁移的可行方法。
AI.motivation: 旨在系统梳理ML/AI在电子与核DFT中面临的不同计算瓶颈和精度需求，识别两种DFT领域间可迁移的 promising 方法，为未来研究提供方向性指导。
AI.method: 通过对比分析ML/AI在电子DFT与核DFT中的应用差异，分别讨论学习交换关联泛函、动能泛函、密度和基函数四种路径的优劣，特别对比深度神经网络与符号回归两种方法的适用性。
AI.result: 指出深度神经网络在KS DFT中表现强劲，但在构建动能泛函时存在劣势；符号回归虽然在概念上具有优势但尚未充分实现；同时识别出可从前沿电子DFT迁移至核DFT的有前景的方法。
AI.conclusion: 需要根据DFT具体类型（电子 vs. 核）和待学习对象（泛函 vs. 密度 vs. 基函数）合理选择ML方法，符号回归值得在两种DFT领域中被进一步探索，电子DFT的ML经验可为核DFT提供重要参考。

title: Hall Coefficient Sign Reversal Driven by Orbital-Selective Oxygen-Vacancy Scattering in Nickelate Films
summary: Hall measurements in superconducting bilayer nickelate films show sign reversals that cannot be explained by rigid-band electron doping alone. We combine a DFT+CDMFT-derived correlated multi-orbital quasiparticle model with a $T$-matrix treatment of oxygen-vacancy scattering in a semiclassical Boltzmann transport framework. We find that multiband compensation is insufficient by itself: in-plane vacancies selectively suppress the transport channel dominated by the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbital and drive $R_H$ through zero, whereas inner-apical vacancies make $R_H$ more negative. These results identify pocket-resolved and orbital-selective oxygen-vacancy scattering as the microscopic origin of the Hall coefficient sign reversal and provide a framework for oxygen-stoichiometry-dependent transport in nickelate films.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT+CDMFT结合T-matrix散射与玻尔兹曼输运理论，发现氧空位在镍酸盐超导薄膜中通过轨道选择性散射导致霍尔系数符号反转，而非单纯电子掺杂或多带补偿效应。
AI.motivation: 实验发现双层镍酸盐薄膜的霍尔测量存在符号反转现象，但传统的刚性带电子掺杂模型无法解释，需要更微观的散射机制来阐明其物理起源。
AI.method: 采用DFT+CDMFT推导关联多轨道准粒子模型，结合T-matrix处理氧空位散射，在半经典玻尔兹曼输运框架下计算输运性质。
AI.result: 多带补偿效应不足以解释符号反转；面内氧空位选择性地抑制d_{x^2-y^2}轨道主导的输运通道，驱动RH过零；而内顶氧空位使RH更负。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了口袋分辨和轨道选择的氧空位散射是霍尔系数符号反转的微观起源，为镍酸盐薄膜中氧化学计量依赖的输运行为提供了理论框架。

title: Beyond-adiabatic flat Chern bands from a double-helix skyrmion crystal
summary: A central challenge in flat-band engineering is suppressing kinetic energy without sacrificing Berry curvature. We show that a double-helix skyrmion crystal (DHSKX)--two sublattice-resolved skyrmion textures locked at opposite helicities, obtained here as the classical ground state of a frustrated honeycomb spin model--provides such a route under double exchange. The key mechanism is a single real-space organization, phase clustering: the $π$-locked helicities expel the wave function's phase winding from the skyrmion cores, and the magnetic $C_3$ symmetry pins it into three phase-locked clusters whose distributed destructive interference cancels net transport while preserving the Berry curvature. Ordinary skyrmion crystals, even with the same symmetry, do not develop this organization. Phase clustering yields isolated flat $|C| = 1$ Chern bands over broad coupling windows, one of which surpasses the adiabatic reference in quantum geometry at intermediate coupling. In this beyond-adiabatic window, band-projected exact diagonalization gives finite-size evidence consistent with $ν= 1/3$ Laughlin-type fractional-Chern-insulator physics; the same texture also hosts a higher-Chern ($C = -2$) flat band. Built from site-resolved complex hoppings alone, the DHSKX architecture is directly programmable in topolectric, acoustic, and photonic platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双螺旋斯格明子晶格(DHSKX)作为一种新型平带工程方案，通过相位聚类机制在抑制动能的同时保留贝里曲率，实现了孤立拓扑平带和分数陈绝缘体物理。
AI.motivation: 平带工程的核心挑战是在抑制动能的同时不牺牲贝里曲率，传统方法难以兼顾两者。
AI.method: 在受挫蜂窝自旋模型中构建DHSKX基态，利用π锁定螺旋性将波函数相位缠绕排斥出斯格明子核心，通过磁性C₃对称性形成三个相位锁定簇，利用分布式的相消干涉消除净输运但保留贝里曲率。
AI.result: 实现了孤立的|C|=1陈平带和C=-2的高陈数平带，在中等耦合区域量子几何超越绝热参考，投影精确对角化给出了ν=1/3 Laughlin型分数量子陈绝缘体的有限尺寸证据。
AI.conclusion: DHSKX架构仅由位点解析的复跳跃构建，可直接在拓扑电路、声学和光子平台上编程实现，为平带拓扑物理提供新平台。

title: The Reweighting Principle in Statistical Mechanics
summary: Reweighting of probability measures provides a unifying perspective on conditioning, exponential tilting, and, more generally, ensemble transformations in statistical mechanics. We show that exponential tilting and conditioning arise as the minimum-relative-entropy updates associated with soft and hard constraints, respectively. Their relative entropies naturally inherit complementary thermodynamic structures: exponential tilting gives rise to the Legendre structure of the canonical ensemble and reduces to the Gibbs entropy for a uniform reference measure, while conditioning reduces to the Boltzmann entropy through the surprisal of the constrained macrostate. By introducing an enlarged probability space in which observables are treated as explicit variables, we further show that microcanonical and canonical ensembles arise as conditional and marginal distributions of a common structural prior after exponential reweighting. In the thermodynamic limit, described through large deviation theory, conditioning emerges from exponential tilting by concentration of measure, revealing ensemble equivalence as a consequence of entropy--bias competition. Finally, we outline how the same information-theoretic framework naturally extends to path space, suggesting a unified probabilistic description of equilibrium thermodynamics and conditioned stochastic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过信息论视角（最小相对熵）统一了指数倾斜（软约束）和条件分布（硬约束），揭示了它们分别对应正则系综和微正则系综的热力学结构，并在大偏差理论下建立了系综等价性。
AI.motivation: 传统上，指数倾斜和条件分布被视为不同的概率操作，但作者希望从信息论（最小相对熵）的统一视角重新审视它们，揭示其内在的热力学结构联系。
AI.method: 通过最小相对熵框架定义软约束（指数倾斜）和硬约束（条件分布）；引入增广概率空间，将可观测量作为显式变量；利用大偏差理论分析热力学极限下的系综等价性。
AI.result: 指数倾斜对应正则系综的Legendre结构，条件分布对应微正则系综的Boltzmann熵；在热力学极限下，条件分布可以通过指数倾斜的测度集中现象导出，证明了熵-偏差竞争下的系综等价性。
AI.conclusion: 该信息论框架可自然扩展到路径空间，为平衡态热力学和条件随机动力学的统一概率描述提供了基础。

title: Many-body quantum chaos in excitonic spectra from first principles
comment: 9 pages + 5 figures; Supplemental Material (10 pages + 5 figures)
summary: We demonstrate that realistic excitonic many-body Hamiltonians obtained from first-principles GW-Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations can exhibit quantum chaos governed by random-matrix universality. Considering a prototypical van der Waals heterostructure (WS$_2$-graphene), with and without lattice disorder, we analyze their energy-resolved spectral correlations and identify a disorder-driven crossover from regular to complete chaotic dynamics. We show that while pristine samples exhibit incomplete chaos (non-ergodicity) due to an approximate valley symmetry that restricts excitonic mixing, the presence of disorder-induced electronic flat bands act as a catalyst for valley mixing to drive the system into a fully developed chaotic (ergodic) regime with reduced symmetry. Crucially, fluctuations in many-body oscillator strengths are shown to follow universal Porter-Thomas statistics, directly linking the underlying quantum chaos and experimentally accessible optical observables. Finally, by examining long-range spectral correlations, we estimate the Thouless time associated to excitonic mixing across the entire many-body bandwidth. Our results establish excitons as a highly tunable platform for probing many-body ergodicity and its spectroscopic signatures in realistic interacting 2D materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理GW-BSE计算，证明了实际激子多体哈密顿量可以表现出量子混沌行为，并发现无序诱导的电子平带可以驱动系统从非遍历态向完全混沌（遍历）态转变，且振荡器强度涨落遵循Porter-Thomas统计，建立了量子混沌与光学观测之间的联系。
AI.motivation: 探索现实材料中激子多体系统的量子混沌行为，并建立其与可观测光谱学特征之间的直接联系。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理GW-BSE方法计算WS₂-石墨烯异质结构的激子哈密顿量，通过能量分辨谱关联分析研究无序驱动的正则-混沌动力学转变，并分析振荡器强度涨落的统计特性。
AI.result: 1) 原始样品因谷对称性限制表现出不完全混沌（非遍历）；2) 无序诱导的电子平带催化谷混合，驱动系统进入完全混沌（遍历）态；3) 多体振荡器强度涨落遵循Porter-Thomas统计；4) 估算了激子多体混合的Thouless时间。
AI.conclusion: 激子可作为研究多体遍历性的高度可调平台，为实际二维材料中量子混沌的光谱学探测提供了理论依据。

title: Self-Driven Atomic Dispersion in Graphitic Layers
summary: Carbon-supported single-atom catalysts maximize metal utilization, but how metal nanoparticles transform into isolated atoms within carbon remains unclear. We show that metal nanoparticles can undergo a self-driven dispersion process under hydrocarbon oxidation conditions, transforming into single atoms that are confined in carbon matrix. Using Pt-catalysed hydrocarbon oxidation as a model, we combine operando electron microscopy, near-ambient-pressure X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and mass spectrometry to track coupled structural and chemical evolution. Graphitic carbon grows at step edges of Pt nanoparticle, continuously reconstructing Pt surface and generating undercoordinated sites for atom release. In-situ generated CO accumulates at the metal-carbon interface, weakening bonding and facilitating self-amplified atom release and migration. Defective carbon overlayers then trap, stabilize and transport liberated atoms, while oxidative etching preserves interfacial access of reaction-gas. Similar behaviour across other metals suggests a general atomization pathway for single-atom catalyst synthesis, yielding products with electrocatalytic hydrogen production activity beyond standard commercial benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了碳负载金属纳米颗粒在烃类氧化条件下自发分散为单原子的机制，并通过多种原位表征技术阐明了碳层生长、CO积累及缺陷捕获等关键步骤，为单原子催化剂合成提供了通用路径。
AI.motivation: 碳负载单原子催化剂虽能最大化金属利用率，但金属纳米颗粒如何转化为碳基质中孤立原子的机制尚不明确，这一认知空白限制了单原子催化剂的理性设计与合成。
AI.method: 以Pt催化烃类氧化为模型体系，结合原位电镜、近常压X射线光电子能谱和质谱，追踪结构与化学演化过程。
AI.result: 石墨碳在Pt纳米颗粒台阶边缘生长，持续重构Pt表面并产生欠配位位点用于原子释放；原位生成的CO在金属-碳界面积累，削弱键合促进原子释放与迁移；缺陷碳层捕获、稳定并运输释放的原子，氧化刻蚀维持界面气体通道。
AI.conclusion: 该原子化路径具有普适性（其他金属类似行为），所得单原子催化剂在电催化产氢活性上超越商业标准。

title: Speed limits on biomolecular processes from fundamental physical constants
summary: Many of the timescales of life have speed limits set by quantum-mechanical constraints along with non-fundamental quantities, such as the temperature of the environment, which are however bounded by anthropic considerations. Here, some of such speed limits are examined, including those for the rates of elementary chemical reactions and biomolecular folding. Limitations of simple back-of-envelope estimates are also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了生命活动中多种时间尺度在量子力学约束下的速度极限，包括化学反应速率和生物分子折叠的极限，并讨论了简单估算方法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 生命过程中的时间尺度受到量子力学约束和温度等非基本因素的限制，而后者又受到人择原理的约束。作者希望系统性地审视这些速度极限。
AI.method: 采用理论分析的方法，基于量子力学基本原理和已知的物理化学约束，对化学反应速率和生物分子折叠等过程的极限速度进行估算和讨论。
AI.result: 识别出生命过程中多种时间尺度的速度极限，指出简单估算方法存在局限性。
AI.conclusion: 生命活动的时间尺度受到量子力学和环境的双重约束，简单的"信封背面"估算方法可能不够精确。

title: Pseudo-superconducting-diode effect in ferroelectric Josephson junctions
summary: The superconducting diode effect (SDE), characterized by unequal critical supercurrents in opposite current directions, enables supercurrent rectification. We propose a magnetic-field-free pseudo-superconducting-diode effect in ferroelectric Josephson junctions with broken inversion symmetry. Using a coupled dynamical model that combines a polarization-dependent RCSJ description with Landau-Khalatnikov-Tani ferroelectric dynamics, we show that ferroelectric polarization switching induces asymmetric critical and retrapping currents under current sweeps. The resulting nonreciprocity is highly tunable via ferroelectric parameters and the sweep protocol and remains robust at finite temperatures. Our work identifies ferroelectric Josephson junctions as a promising platform for magnetic-field-free nonreciprocal superconducting devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在铁电约瑟夫森结中实现无磁场的赝超导二极管效应，通过铁电极化翻转诱导临界电流不对称性，从而实现超导整流。
AI.motivation: 探索无需外加磁场的超导二极管新机制，克服传统超导二极管依赖磁场的局限性。
AI.method: 建立耦合动力学模型，将极化相关的RCSJ描述与Landau-Khalatnikov-Tani铁电动力学相结合。
AI.result: 铁电极化翻转可诱导非对称的临界电流和重俘获电流，非互易性高度可调且对有限温度鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 铁电约瑟夫森结是实现无磁场非互易超导器件的有前景平台。

title: Differentiable OPLS Force Field Parameterization for Ionic Electrolytes and High-Throughput Application to Lithium-ion Batteries
summary: The rational design of ionic electrolytes for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) is severely constrained by the vast solvent-salt combinatorial space and low efficiency of empirical trial-and-error. While molecular dynamics (MD) bridges microscopic solvation structures and macroscopic physicochemical properties, classical force fields often lack sufficient accuracy for multicomponent systems. To address these challenges, we develop an automated differentiable OPLS-AA force field parameterization workflow tailored for general ionic electrolytes. It employs topology-guided atom typification to reduce parameter redundancy and optimizes Lennard-Jones parameters via the DMFF framework, with experimental density as the fitting target and ionic conductivity as an independent validation metric. Rigorous convergence tests yield a standardized simulation protocol with $\sim$100,000-atom systems and 35-40 ns NVT runs to ensure reliable transport property quantification. High-throughput MD simulations of over 10,000 formulations spanning 67 solvents and 15 lithium salts are conducted on the Tianqiong platform, generating a comprehensive dataset covering five core properties: density, dielectric constant, viscosity, diffusion coefficient, and ionic conductivity. t-SNE visualization reveals partial clustering of distinct salt chemistries, continuous property gradients with concentration and temperature, and internal physical self-consistency, with solvent composition identified as another key performance regulator. Together, the accurate transferable force field and large-scale dataset provide a solid foundation for data-driven rational design of ionic electrolytes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种自动化的可微分OPLS-AA力场参数化流程，用于通用离子电解质，并在天琼平台上对超过10,000种电解液配方进行了高通量分子动力学模拟，生成了涵盖五种核心性质的综合数据集。
AI.motivation: 锂离子电池电解液的理性设计受到溶剂-盐组合空间庞大和传统试错法效率低下的严重制约，而经典力场对多组分系统的精度不足。
AI.method: 开发了基于拓扑引导原子类型化的自动化可微分OPLS-AA力场参数化流程，通过DMFF框架优化Lennard-Jones参数，以实验密度为拟合目标、离子电导率为独立验证指标，并在天琼平台上进行高通量MD模拟。
AI.result: 生成了涵盖67种溶剂和15种锂盐的超过10,000种配方的数据集，包含密度、介电常数、粘度、扩散系数和离子电导率五种核心性质；t-SNE可视化揭示了不同盐化学的部分聚类、随浓度和温度的连续性质梯度以及物理自洽性。
AI.conclusion: 准确的迁移力场和大型数据集为数据驱动的离子电解质理性设计提供了坚实基础。

title: Pauli Spectrum and Stabilizer Rényi Entropy in Gapless Symmetry-Protected Topological Phases
summary: Quantum entanglement is widely used as a diagnostic of topological phases of matter. Beyond entanglement, non-stabilizerness captures a distinct aspect of quantum many-body states by quantifying their distance from the manifold of stabilizer states. In this work, we study the stabilizer Rényi entropy in symmetry protected topological (SPT) phases, including both gapped SPT, non-intrinsically gapless SPT, and intrinsically gapless SPT phases. Under symmetry preserving perturbations, we find numerically that the stabilizer Rényi entropy exhibits an extremum near the phase transition. However, the stabilizer Rényi entropy alone cannot distinguish different SPT phases. In contrast, the Pauli spectrum reveals a characteristic crossing structure at the transition point. This crossing reflects the exchange of dominant Pauli-string correlations associated with the non-local string order parameters of the two topological distinct phases. For gapped SPT and non-intrinsically gapless SPT phases, the crossing structure can be understood from a local-unitary duality that maps the Pauli spectrum between the two phases. For intrinsically gapless SPT phases, such a local-unitary mapping is absent. Instead, we find that the Pauli spectrum mapping is generated by a non-invertible duality transformation. These results show that although the stabilizer Rényi entropy provides only a coarse diagnostic of phase transitions, the Pauli spectrum contains finer information about the exchange of string order sectors. Our findings demonstrate that quantum magic offers a complementary perspective for characterizing both gapped and gapless SPT phases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了稳定子Rényi熵在对称性保护拓扑(SPT)相（包括有能隙、无能隙非本征、无能隙本征SPT相）中的表现。发现稳定子Rényi熵在相变点附近呈现极值，但无法区分不同SPT相；而Pauli谱在相变点展示出特征性的交叉结构，反映了拓扑不同相之间非局域弦序参量的主导Pauli-弦关联交换。对于有能隙和非本征无能隙SPT相，该交叉结构可通过局域幺正对偶性理解；对于本征无能隙SPT相，则需非可逆对偶变换生成Pauli谱映射。
AI.motivation: 量子纠缠作为拓扑相诊断工具已被广泛使用，但量子"魔术"(non-stabilizerness)作为衡量量子态与稳定子流形距离的另一独立方面，其在对称性保护拓扑相中的表现尚未被充分探索。本文旨在研究稳定子Rényi熵和Pauli谱能否提供超越纠缠的、区分不同SPT相的精细诊断能力。
AI.method: 数值计算稳定子Rényi熵在对称性保持微扰下的行为；分析Pauli谱在相变点附近的交叉结构；利用局域幺正对偶性和非可逆对偶变换解释Pauli谱映射机制。
AI.result: 稳定子Rényi熵仅在相变点附近显示极值，无法区分不同SPT相；Pauli谱则在相变点呈现特征性交叉结构，反映不同拓扑相之间主导Pauli-弦关联的交换；对于有能隙和非本征无能隙SPT相存在局域幺正对偶映射，而对于本征无能隙SPT相则需要非可逆对偶变换。
AI.conclusion: 稳定子Rényi熵仅提供相变的粗糙诊断，而Pauli谱包含更精细的弦序参量交换信息。量子魔术为刻画有能隙和无能隙SPT相提供了互补的视角。

title: Universal fluctuations of first discoveries in competitive exploration
summary:
Random exploration is usually quantified by how fast new space is found, from
  the range of a single walker to the territory collectively covered by many
  walkers. In competitive exploration, first arrival secures an exclusive resource, as when foragers compete for food items or agents capture distributed targets. It is then no longer enough to know which sites have been discovered: one must determine, for each discovered site, which searcher reached it first. We introduce the discovery
  share $X_n$, the fraction of the first $n$ collective discoveries secured by
  a tagged searcher. For two identical competitors, exchange symmetry fixes
  $\langle X_n\rangle=1/2$, but the central question is whether this equal
  split emerges in each long exploration history or only on average, \emph{i.e.} whether early
  competitive advantages are erased or persist. Here we show that the answer is
  controlled by the spectral dimension $d_s$, defined by the large-time decay of the probability that a single searcher is at
  its starting point after $t$ steps, $p_0(t)\sim t^{-d_s/2}$.
  Across ordinary diffusion, long-range superdiffusion and subdiffusion induced
  by crowding or memory, $d_s$ separates persistent randomness in
  recurrent exploration $(d_s<2)$, anomalously slow non-Gaussian concentration
  for $2\le d_s<3$, and Gaussian concentration, logarithmically corrected at
  $d_s=3$, for $d_s\ge3$. For $d_s\ge2$, we derive exact asymptotic
  variances, including prefactors, and the discovery scale on which competitive
  imbalances are erased. Two-point correlations of first-discovery labels identify the memory mechanism behind these regimes.
  The same phase structure persists under changes in geometry, competitor
  heterogeneity, number of competitors and memory, revealing a general fluctuation
  theory of first-arrival inequalities.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了竞争探索中的首次到达不平等性，提出了“发现份额”X_n用于衡量竞争者在n次集体发现中获得的份额，并发现竞争结果的涨落由谱维数d_s控制，揭示了d_s<2时持久随机性、2≤d_s<3时异常慢的非高斯集中、d_s≥3时高斯集中三种相结构。
AI.motivation: 在竞争探索中，首次到达者获得独占资源（如觅食、目标捕获），但仅知道哪些地点被发现是不够的，需要确定每个发现点由谁先到达。核心问题在于竞争中的早期优势是否会持续存在还是被抹平。
AI.method: 引入发现份额X_n作为核心统计量，利用谱维数d_s（由单搜索者回到起点的概率衰减决定）进行理论分析，推导出不同d_s下的渐近方差及发现尺度，并通过首次发现标签的两点相关性揭示记忆机制。
AI.result: 发现d_s<2时竞争结果存在持久随机性（复发性探索）；2≤d_s<3时出现异常慢的非高斯集中；d_s≥3时呈现高斯集中（d_s=3处需对数修正）。该相结构在几何、竞争者异质性、竞争者数量及记忆性变化下仍然保持。
AI.conclusion: 建立了竞争探索中首次到达不平等性的一般涨落理论，表明谱维数d_s是决定竞争优势能否被抹平的关键控制参数。

title: Emergent $\mathbb{Z}$-type topology in a quasi-one-dimensional extended QWZ model
summary: We investigate the emergence of zero-dimensional topological end states in nanoribbons described by the Qi-Wu-Zhang (QWZ) model and its extensions with longer-range couplings. While dimensional reduction from two to one dimension is often assumed to preserve the symmetry classification of the parent system, here an additional symmetry can emerge originating from the real-space geometry of the ribbon. This symmetry acts as a chiral symmetry, combining orbital and spatial transformations, and promotes the effective one-dimensional system from symmetry class D to class BDI. We demonstrate that the existence of such a symmetry depends both on the long and end termination of the ribbon and exhibits an even-odd effect with respect to ribbon width, revealing that the commonly studied rectangular ribbons constitute a special high-symmetry case. For the conventional QWZ model, we derive analytic expressions for the topological phase boundaries of finite-width nanoribbons and characterize the resulting hybridization-gap phases through ($\mathbb{Z}_2 $) and winding-number invariants. We further show that extended QWZ models with longer-range couplings support phases with multiple topological end states and higher winding numbers. These phases arise through distinct mechanisms, including the hybridization of multiple edge modes inherited from higher-Chern-number bulk phases. Our results demonstrate that both long and end termination can fundamentally alter the topological classification of confined Chern insulators, highlighting the interplay between crystalline geometry, emergent symmetries, and dimensional reduction.

AI.tldr: 研究QWZ模型纳米带中零维拓扑末端态的涌现，发现 ribbons 的实空间几何可以催生额外手征对称性，将系统从D类提升至BDI类，并受长/端终止和 ribbon 宽度奇偶性影响。扩展模型支持多拓扑末端态和更高绕数，揭示了几何、对称性与维度约简的复杂关联。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为从二维到一维的维度约简会保持母系统的对称性分类，但作者发现纳米带的实空间几何可以催生额外的对称性，从而改变拓扑分类。本文旨在揭示这一机制的来源及其对拓扑末端态的影响。
AI.method: 基于QWZ模型及其扩展（含长程耦合），通过解析推导有限宽度纳米带的拓扑相边界，利用$\mathbb{Z}_2$不变量和绕数刻画 hybridization-gap 相，并分析长/端终止和宽度奇偶性对对称性的影响。
AI.result: 发现纳米带几何可引入额外手征对称性，将对称类从D提升至BDI；该对称性存在依赖长/端终止和宽度奇偶性，常规矩形 ribbon 是特例；扩展QWZ模型支持多拓扑末端态和更高绕数，源于高陈数体相的多边缘模杂化。
AI.conclusion: 长/端终止可从根本改变受限陈绝缘体的拓扑分类，强调晶体几何、涌现对称性与维度约简之间的相互作用。

title: Martensitic Transformation in Crystal-Amorphous Superlattices of NiTi Shape Memory Alloy
summary: Shape memory alloys (SMAs) exhibit unique thermo-mechanical properties arising from reversible martensitic transformation. Tailoring these properties through coherent second phases is effective but is often limited by the difficulty of identifying thermodynamically compatible phases. Crystal-amorphous superlattices (CAS), in which the second phase is derived from the base material itself, provide an attractive alternative. However, the influence of partial amorphization on martensitic transformation and thermo-mechanical behavior remains largely unexplored. Here, large-scale molecular dynamics simulations are used to investigate temperature- and stress-induced martensitic transformations in CAS-NiTi with different crystalline phase fractions. Partial amorphization fundamentally modifies the transformation pathway, introducing an initial continuous (second-order-like) transformation before the conventional first-order martensitic transformation. The amorphous phase also enhances transformation reversibility, reducing the thermal hysteresis from 275 K in fully crystalline NiTi to 95-110 K in CAS-NiTi. Simultaneously, the elastic modulus and the critical stress for stress-induced martensitic transformation increase by approximately 60-90 percent, depending on the crystalline fraction. These improvements originate from heterogeneous nucleation at crystal-amorphous interfaces, retained austenite that promotes the reverse transformation, and mechanical constraint imposed by the amorphous phase. These findings establish crystal-amorphous superlattices as a promising microstructural design strategy for tailoring the thermo-mechanical performance of shape memory alloys.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模分子动力学模拟，研究了晶态-非晶态超晶格（CAS）NiTi形状记忆合金中部分非晶化对马氏体相变及热-力学行为的影响。研究发现，部分非晶化引入了连续（类二级）相变路径，显著降低了热滞（从275 K降至95-110 K），同时提高了弹性模量和应力诱导马氏体相变的临界应力（约60-90%）。这些性能提升源于晶态-非晶界面的异质形核、残余奥氏体促进逆相变以及非晶相的力学约束效应。
AI.motivation: 形状记忆合金（SMA）的性能可通过引入共格第二相进行调控，但寻找热力学兼容的相十分困难。晶态-非晶态超晶格（CAS）利用基体材料本身衍生出第二相，避免了兼容性问题，然而部分非晶化对马氏体相变和热-力学行为的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用大规模分子动力学模拟，系统研究了不同晶态相体积分数下CAS-NiTi的温度诱导和应力诱导马氏体相变行为。
AI.result: 部分非晶化改变了相变路径，引入了连续的类二级相变；热滞从275 K（全晶态）降至95-110 K（CAS-NiTi）；弹性模量和应力诱导马氏体相变临界应力提高约60-90%。
AI.conclusion: 晶态-非晶态超晶格是一种有望用于调控形状记忆合金热-力学性能的微观结构设计策略。

title: Superconductivity on the verge of metal-insulator transition in Cu$_{1-x}$Zn$_x$Ir$_2$S$_4$ probed by $μ$SR
summary: The thiospinel CuIr$_2$S$_4$ undergoes a metal-insulator transition below $\approx$230 K, which is suppressed by substitution of Cu with Zn (Cu$_{1-x}$Zn$_x$Ir$_2$S$_4$) to induce superconductivity for $0.2\lesssim x\lesssim0.8$. We show that the temperature/field dependence of superfluid density in samples with $x = 0.3$ and 0.4 ($T_{\rm c} \approx 3$ K and 2.5 K) investigated by muon spin rotation and relaxation ($μ$SR) is consistent with a fully gapped $s$-wave pairing. Meanwhile, the relatively high resistivity (10$^{-3}$-10$^{-2}$ $Ω\:$cm) in their normal state suggests that the superconductivity is in the "dirty limit" where the mean free path is much shorter than the coherence length ($\ell \ll ξ_0$). This indicates that the potential anisotropy associated with unconventional pairing mechanisms expected under the strong electron correlations is smeared out by the electron scattering. Based on these observations, we discuss potential link between the Zn substitution-induced superconductivity and that recently discovered in CuIr$_2$S$_4$ under high pressure ($>18$ GPa) where the existence of strong electron scattering is also suggested.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过μSR实验发现，Cu₁₋ₓZnₓIr₂S₄体系中的超导态具有s波全能隙配对特性，并指出在“脏极限”条件下电子散射抑制了非常规配对机制的各向异性，同时探讨了Zn掺杂诱导超导与高压诱导超导之间的潜在联系。
AI.motivation: 探究Cu₁₋ₓZnₓIr₂S₄体系中Zn掺杂诱导的超导配对机制，并分析其与高压诱导超导现象的潜在关联。
AI.method: 使用μ子自旋旋转和弛豫（μSR）技术测量x=0.3和0.4样品的超流密度随温度和磁场的变化关系，并结合正常态电阻率分析电子散射情况。
AI.result: 超流密度的温度/磁场依赖性符合完全能隙的s波配对；正常态电阻率较高（10⁻³-10⁻² Ω·cm），表明体系处于脏极限（ℓ ≪ ξ₀）。
AI.conclusion: Zn掺杂诱导的超导与高压诱导超导均处于强电子散射环境中，电子散射抹平了强关联体系中可能存在的非常规配对各向异性，二者可能具有相似的物理起源。

title: Phase-field modeling of elastically driven abnormal grain growth
summary: Grain-refined metals typically exhibit high strength, yet their engineering applications are often constrained by grain coarsening under thermo-mechanical loading. Recent experiments have revealed abnormal grain growth (AGG) in ultrafine-grained Ni thin films subjected to cyclic loading at room temperature. Unlike conventional AGG, which generally requires significant plastic deformation or high temperatures, this phenomenon occurs within the regime of macroscopic elastic deformation. This AGG is characterized by the preferential growth of grains with an in-plane <100> orientation aligned with the loading direction. Here, we investigate the underlying physical mechanisms by combining phase-field simulations with micromechanical analysis. The results indicate that elastic energy reduction provides a thermodynamically plausible driving force for this orientation-selective grain growth. Phase-field simulations reveal the evolution kinetics of AGG and confirm that local grain geometry and stress states play critical roles in determining the grain growth pathway. By applying this framework to systems with varying elastic anisotropy, we establish a general approach for investigating elastically driven AGG in polycrystalline materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过相场模拟和微观力学分析揭示了超细晶Ni薄膜在室温循环加载条件下发生异常晶粒长大的物理机制，发现弹性各向异性驱动的能量降低是取向选择性晶粒长大的热力学驱动力。
AI.motivation: 传统细晶金属在热-机械载荷下易发生晶粒粗化，而近期实验观察到超细晶Ni薄膜在室温循环加载（宏观弹性变形区）出现异常晶粒长大，其机理尚不明确，亟需理论解释。
AI.method: 采用相场模拟结合微观力学分析的方法，研究弹性各向异性驱动的异常晶粒长大行为，并推广至不同弹性各向异性系统以建立一般性框架。
AI.result: 发现弹性应变能降低是取向选择性晶粒长大的热力学驱动力；局部晶粒几何和应力状态对长大路径起关键作用；成功在多种弹性各向异性系统中验证该框架的普适性。
AI.conclusion: 建立了弹性驱动的异常晶粒长大的通用研究框架，为理解细晶材料在循环加载下的微观结构演化提供了理论基础。

title: Cuprate d-wave superconductivity based on Non perturbative many body theory for spin fluctuation
summary: We employ the nonperturbative many-body spin GW method to compute the single-particle Green's function, and the covariance method to evaluate the correlation functions of two body, for the Hubbard model for superconductors. The key transition temperatures, namely the Neel temperature and the superconducting critical temperature Tc are found to be in quantitative agreement with experimental data. The evolution of the Fermi surface in different doping regimes is also presented, which clearly shows transitions from pseudogap to strange metal and to Fermi liquid phase. The method has been benchmarked at strong coupling and low temperature and is free from the fermion sign problem. Simulations on lattices up to 64 times 64 are also feasible, making access to the thermodynamic limit possible. This approach may offer a new route toward investigating strongly correlated systems, especially cuprate superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文采用非微扰多体自旋GW方法计算单粒子格林函数，并用协方差方法评估两体关联函数，对超导体的Hubbard模型进行研究。关键转变温度（Neel温度和超导临界温度Tc）与实验数据定量吻合。展示了不同掺杂区域的费米面演化，清晰呈现从赝能隙到奇异金属再到费米液体的相变。该方法在强耦合和低温下进行了基准测试，无费米子符号问题，可在64×64晶格上模拟，为研究强关联系统（特别是铜氧化物超导体）提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理强关联系统（如铜氧化物超导体）时面临费米子符号问题或无法达到热力学极限，亟需一种既无符号问题又能在大尺度上精确计算的方法。
AI.method: 采用非微扰多体自旋GW方法计算单粒子格林函数，结合协方差方法计算两体关联函数，对Hubbard模型进行数值模拟。
AI.result: 1) Neel温度和超导临界温度Tc与实验数据定量一致；2) 清晰展示了从赝能隙到奇异金属再到费米液体的费米面演化；3) 方法无费米子符号问题；4) 可在64×64晶格上模拟，达到热力学极限。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为研究强关联系统（特别是铜氧化物超导体）提供了一条新的有效途径，弥补了传统方法的不足。

title: Geometric Characteristics of Subproblems in Ising-Machine-Assisted Large Neighborhood Search
summary: Large-scale quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) formulations of constrained combinatorial optimization problems often exceed the input-size limit of present Ising machines or suffer from degraded solution quality as the number of binary variables increases. Large neighborhood search (LNS) mitigates this difficulty by sequentially optimizing restricted subproblems, but the structural factors that distinguish subproblems beyond the number of binary variables remain insufficiently characterized. In this study, we examine vehicle routing problems and compare a construction based on the vehicle routes of the current solution, denoted by LNS-K, with a construction based on QUBO variables and constraint relations, denoted by LNS-Q, while controlling the number of binary variables in the subproblems. Under the tested conditions, LNS-K obtained shorter total distances than LNS-Q in the matched-size comparisons, and the position variance, a measure of the spatial spread of the selected customers, decreased during the iterations in LNS-K. These observations suggest that subproblem design for sequential optimization with Ising machines should consider not only subproblem size but also semantic and geometric structures inherited from the current solution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大邻域搜索(LNS)中不同子问题构建方式对Ising机器求解车辆路径问题的影响，发现基于当前解路径结构的子问题(LNS-K)优于基于QUBO变量和约束关系的子问题(LNS-Q)，表明子问题设计需考虑语义和几何结构。
AI.motivation: 大规模QUBO公式通常超出Ising机器的输入限制或导致解质量下降，LNS虽能缓解此问题，但区分子问题的结构因素尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 在控制子问题二进制变量数量的条件下，比较两种子问题构建方式：基于当前解车辆路径的LNS-K，与基于QUBO变量和约束关系的LNS-Q，应用于车辆路径问题。
AI.result: 在匹配大小的比较中，LNS-K获得的总距离短于LNS-Q；LNS-K中位置方差（所选客户空间分布的度量）在迭代过程中下降。
AI.conclusion: 使用Ising机器进行顺序优化时，子问题设计不仅应考虑子问题大小，还应考虑从当前解继承的语义和几何结构。

title: Evidence of length scale effect in contact electrification in conducting thin film heterostructures
summary: Contact electrification between two conducting materials is expected to exhibit length scale effect because the screening effect will diminish in conductors as a function of material dimensions. As a consequence, the interfacial charge accumulation will diffuse away from interface/surface to a critical penetration depth as a function of material dimension. This work experimentally demonstrates the length scale effect in a permalloy and degenerately doped p-Si heterostructure system due to the flexoelectricity mediated contact electrification. The contact electrification induced interlayer charge transfer is observed through the whole thickness in case of 400 nm thick p-Si samples. Whereas, the charge carrier diffuses to a depth of 51 nm from the interface in case of 2 um thick Si. The length scale effect also leads to metal-insulator transition in p-Si layers in both cases. These results present a new opportunity to tailor the physical properties in conducting materials using contact electrification.

AI.tldr: 本文实验证明了在坡莫合金与重掺杂p-Si异质结构中，由于挠曲电介导的接触起电，电荷积累存在长度尺度效应：对于400 nm厚的p-Si，接触起电诱导的层间电荷转移贯穿整个厚度；而对于2 μm厚的Si，载流子仅扩散至界面下51 nm深度。该效应还导致p-Si层发生金属-绝缘体转变。
AI.motivation: 两类导电材料之间的接触起电预期存在长度尺度效应，因为导体的屏蔽效应会随材料尺寸变化而减弱。然而该效应缺乏实验验证，本文旨在通过实验证明这一现象。
AI.method: 以坡莫合金（permalloy）和重掺杂p-Si构成异质结构，利用挠曲电（flexoelectricity）介导的接触起电，通过改变p-Si层厚度（400 nm vs 2 μm），观察电荷积累的穿透深度差异。
AI.result: 1) 400 nm厚p-Si中接触起电诱导的电荷转移贯穿整个厚度；2) 2 μm厚Si中载流子仅扩散至界面下51 nm深度；3) 两种情况下p-Si层均出现金属-绝缘体转变。
AI.conclusion: 接触起电的长度尺度效应为利用接触起电调控导电材料的物理性质提供了新途径。

title: Data-driven multi-objective optimization for alloy recycling using factorization machines and quantum annealing
summary: Quantum annealing has the potential to provide practical quantum advantage for complex optimization tasks. Here, we present a systematic assessment of an integrated factorization-machine and quantum-annealing workflow (FM+QA) for a technologically relevant application: multi-objective Pareto optimization in metal up-cycling through alloy design. To address the non-convex nature of the Pareto front, we employ the recently proposed data-driven Tchebycheff scalarization (DDTS) scheme. Our results show that FM+QA extends the applicability of QUBO-based optimization to data-driven materials discovery problems with multiple competing objectives. In particular, we analyze the scaling behavior of the approach and compare quantum annealing with classical simulated annealing using both regular binary encoding and one-hot encoding. Finally, we provide a critical perspective on the problem sizes and encoding strategies for which quantum-annealing-based optimization may become practically beneficial in the near future.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了集成分解机与量子退火（FM+QA）的工作流，用于金属升级回收中合金设计的多目标Pareto优化。采用数据驱动Tchebycheff标量化（DDTS）处理非凸Pareto前沿。结果表明FM+QA扩展了QUBO优化在数据驱动材料发现中的应用，并分析了量子退火与经典模拟退火在不同编码策略下的扩展行为，提供了量子退火优化在未来可能具备实际优势的问题规模和编码策略的批判性视角。
AI.motivation: 将量子退火（QA）应用于多目标Pareto优化这一实际材料工程问题（金属升级回收中的合金设计），探索其在复杂优化任务中的实际优势。
AI.method: 集成分解机（Factorization Machine）与量子退火的工作流（FM+QA），结合数据驱动Tchebycheff标量化（DDTS）处理非凸Pareto前沿，采用QUBO框架进行优化，并与经典模拟退火（SA）在二进制编码和独热编码下进行对比。
AI.result: FM+QA成功扩展了QUBO优化在数据驱动材料发现中的应用范围，量化了该方法在不同编码策略下的扩展行为，并与经典模拟退火进行了性能对比。
AI.conclusion: 量子退火在特定问题规模和编码策略下可能在未来展现出实际优势，但需谨慎评估其相较于经典方法的实用性。

title: Resolving the inverse problem in pulse response analysis of TAP reactors
summary: Pulse experiments in the temporal analysis of products (TAP) reactor are one of the most important methods for studying transient kinetics of gas-solid catalytic reactions. The Y-procedure (Yablonsky et al., Chem. Eng. Sci. 62, 6754, 2007) is a model-free analysis framework for inferring the relationship between the reaction-rate $R$ and the reactant concentration $C$ from measurements of the outlet flux of gas. While elegant in conception, its application is hindered by the amplification of measurement noise that results from having to backtrack diffusive transport from the outlet to the reaction zone. Here, we explicitly recognize the inverse problem inherent in the Y-procedure and treat it using well-developed tools from the field of inverse problems. While previous implementations of the Y-procedure used Fourier-based filtering, we do not pre-process the measurements with an ad hoc noise-filter. Instead, we use a basis of localized square pulses to formulate a discrete inverse problem, whose regularized solution is obtained via the truncated singular value decomposition (TSVD) method. This method requires one to select a cutoff mode number; while we show how the choice of this regularization parameter can be guided by a Picard plot, we also develop an objective selection strategy for state defining experiments, for which $R(C)$ is a single-valued function. We apply our proposed inverse-problem approach to synthetic data corresponding to linear and nonlinear reactions and compare the results with the Fourier-filtration method. The former produces better reconstructions of the $R$ vs $C$ relationship, especially for nonlinear reactions. Our work facilitates the automation of pulse response analyses and enables the application of other discrete inverse-problem techniques, such as Tikhonov regularization or machine-learning methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对TAP反应器脉冲实验中的Y-procedure，提出了一种基于逆问题理论的正则化方法，使用局部化方形脉冲基和截断奇异值分解（TSVD）替代传统的傅里叶滤波，有效解决了测量噪声放大问题，并在线性和非线性反应合成数据上展示了优于传统方法的性能。
AI.motivation: Y-procedure在从出口通量反推反应速率与浓度关系时，因需要回溯扩散输运过程而严重放大测量噪声，传统傅里叶滤波方法对噪声处理存在不足，需要更系统和客观的噪声处理策略。
AI.method: 将Y-procedure明确视为逆问题，采用局部化方形脉冲基构建离散逆问题，通过截断奇异值分解（TSVD）进行正则化求解，并利用Picard图指导截断模式数的选择，同时针对状态定义实验开发了客观的选择策略。
AI.result: 在合成数据上（线性与非线性反应），所提出的逆问题方法在重构R vs C关系方面优于傅里叶滤波方法，尤其对非线性反应改善显著。
AI.conclusion: 该工作促进了脉冲响应分析的自动化，并为其他离散逆问题技术（如Tikhonov正则化或机器学习方法）的应用打开了大门。

title: $H-T$ Phase diagram of CeRh$_{2}$As$_{2}$: Refinement of the parity-switch scenario
summary: The superconductivity of CeRh$_2$As$_2$ has drawn attention due to its first-order transition in magnetic fields. At first glance, the multiple superconducting (SC) phases as well as the first-order transition appear consistent with the parity-switch scenario, which emphasizes the role of strong Rashba spin-orbit coupling enabled by the locally non-centrosymmetric crystal structure. However, experimental phase diagrams exhibit notable deviations from this simple picture: thermodynamic measurements reveal a nearly vertical phase boundary of the high-field SC phase despite the orbital depairing effect, while transport measurements show that the initial slope of the high-field SC phase is steeper than that of the low-field SC phase. Here, we show that these discrepancies can be understood by considering the combined effects of nonsymmorphic band structure and coexisting antiferromagnetic order. We demonstrate that the symmetry-enforced electronic structure around the Dirac node and type-II Van Hove saddle points near the X point in the Brillouin zone boundary becomes more anisotropic with increased interlayer hopping amplitude, and this anisotropic band structure naturally accounts for the anomalous initial slope of the odd-parity SC phase. Meanwhile, a phenomenological theory incorporating coexisting antiferromagnetism explains the nearly vertical thermodynamic phase boundary as a consequence of field-enhanced odd-parity superconductivity enabled by the over-suppression of Pauli depairing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合非对称能带结构和反铁磁序的协同效应，解释了CeRh₂As₂超导体中高场超导相异常的初始斜率与近垂直相边界，揭示了这些偏离传统宇称开关图像的现象背后的物理机制。
AI.motivation: 实验观测到的CeRh₂As₂超导相图与宇称开关理论预期存在显著偏差：热力学测量显示高场SC相边界近乎垂直（违背轨道退配对效应预期），输运测量则表明高场SC相初始斜率比低场SC相更陡。现有理论无法解释这些异常，因此需要新的物理机制。
AI.method: 理论分析与模型构建：1）考虑非对称能带结构（狄拉克节点和X点附近II型范霍夫鞍点的对称性保护电子结构）随层间跳跃振幅增强而各向异性增加；2）引入共存反铁磁序的唯象理论，解释由于Pauli退配对被过度抑制导致的场增强奇宇称超导现象。
AI.result: 1）各向异性能带结构自然解释了奇宇称SC相的异常初始斜率；2）反铁磁序通过抑制Pauli退配对使高场超导得到场增强，从而解释了近垂直的热力学相边界。
AI.conclusion: 非对称能带结构与反铁磁序的协同效应是理解CeRh₂As₂复杂超导相图的关键，也为探索其他具有局域非中心对称结构的多序参量超导体提供了理论框架。

title: Data-driven atomistic modelling of hybrid halide perovskite passivation
summary: Molecular passivation of surface defects is key to improving the optoelectronic performance of hybrid halide perovskite materials, but the underlying atomistic mechanisms are incompletely understood. While machine-learned interatomic potentials are now widely used to simulate complex molecular and crystalline systems, their application to experimentally-realistic scenarios - such as molecules coordinating to perovskite surfaces - is still far from trivial. Here, we describe a multistep training pipeline, resembling continuous fine-tuning used for large language models, to underpin atomistic modelling and computational experiments in this domain. Our protocol involves two components: (i) a large, curated, and open dataset of diverse metal and hybrid halide perovskite structures ('hyP-26'); and (ii) a small, specialised dataset for an amino-silane molecule passivating the surface, providing highly specific information for fine-tuning. We apply this approach to explore collective behaviour at a mixed-composition halide perovskite surface passivated with a varying coverage of amino-silane molecules, revealing an evolution of interactions with increasing molecular surface coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种类似大语言模型微调的多步训练流程，结合大型通用数据集（hyP-26）和小型专用数据集，构建机器学习原子间势能模型，用于模拟氨基硅烷分子钝化混合卤化物钙钛矿表面的集体行为，揭示了分子覆盖度增加时相互作用的演化。
AI.motivation: 卤化物钙钛矿材料中表面缺陷的分子钝化机制尚未被原子层面完全理解，现有的机器学习原子间势能难以应用于分子配位钙钛矿表面这类实验真实场景。
AI.method: 提出类似大语言模型连续微调的多步训练流程：(i) 构建大型开源数据集hyP-26（包含多种金属和杂化卤化物钙钛矿结构）；(ii) 构建小型专用数据集（氨基硅烷分子钝化表面的高特异性信息）进行微调，最终得到适合该领域的原子间势能模型。
AI.result: 该方法成功应用于混合组分卤化物钙钛矿表面被不同覆盖度氨基硅烷分子钝化的集体行为模拟，揭示了随分子表面覆盖度增加时相互作用的演变规律。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多步训练流程可有效将机器学习原子间势能应用于分子-钙钛矿表面配位的实验真实场景，为理解表面钝化机制提供了新工具。

title: Orbital-Selective Mott and Antiferromagnetic Phases in Diagonally Compressed Kagome Lattice
summary: We perform determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the half-filled Hubbard model on a diagonally compressed kagome lattice, introducing exponential decay long-range hopping $t(r) = t_0 \exp\bigl(-r / r_0\bigr)$ to account for the evolving bond length. By varying the lattice angle $θ$ and the on-site interaction $U$, double occupancy, charge compressibility, and spin-spin correlation functions of the whole system and each sub-lattice are measured. We find that geometric compression induces a clear sublattice differentiation: for $θ\gtrsim52^\circ$, the A sublattice establishes long-range hoppings, which in turn suppresses the metallic behavior of the $B/C$ sublattice and drives a selective Mott transition; for $θ\lesssim52^\circ$, the $B$-$C$ chains develop long-range antiferromagnetic correlations within the finite-size simulations, which in turn suppresses the metallic behavior of the $A$ sublattice and drives a selective Mott transition. The critical interaction $U^c_A$ for the $A$ sites decreases sharply near the onset of $B$-$C$ antiferromagnetic correlations, while $U^c_{B/C}$ increases. These competing orders give rise to an orbital-selective Mott phase and a rich $U$-$θ$ phase diagram featuring paramagnetic-metal, paramagnetic-Mott, antiferromagnetic-metal, and antiferromagnetic-Mott states. Our results highlight the complex interplay between lattice geometry, magnetic frustration, and strong correlations in frustrated two-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究了半填充Hubbard模型在斜角压缩kagome晶格上的行为。通过引入指数衰减的长程跳跃和改变晶格角度θ及相互作用U，发现了几何压缩诱导的亚晶格分化现象：当θ≳52°时，A亚晶格建立长程跳跃，抑制B/C亚晶格的金属性，驱动选择性Mott相变；当θ≲52°时，B-C链发展长程反铁磁关联，抑制A亚晶格的金属性。该研究揭示了晶格几何、磁阻挫和强关联之间的复杂相互作用，构建了包含顺磁金属、顺磁Mott、反铁磁金属和反铁磁Mott态的丰富相图。
AI.motivation: 动机是研究几何压缩对阻挫二维系统中强关联电子行为的调控作用，特别是亚晶格分化与选择性Mott相变之间的竞争关系，以及晶格几何、磁阻挫和强关联三者之间的复杂相互作用。
AI.method: 使用行列式量子蒙特卡洛（determinant quantum Monte Carlo）模拟方法，对半填充Hubbard模型在斜角压缩kagome晶格上进行研究。引入指数衰减长程跳跃项t(r)=t₀exp(-r/r₀)来刻画键长变化，通过改变晶格角度θ和局域相互作用U，测量了双占据数、电荷压缩率和自旋-自旋关联函数等物理量。
AI.result: 发现了几何压缩诱导的清晰亚晶格分化现象，并确定临界角度约为52°。在此角度两侧，分别出现A亚晶格或B-C亚晶格主导的选择性Mott相变。A亚晶格的临界相互作用U^c_A在B-C反铁磁关联出现时急剧下降，而U^c_{B/C}则上升。构建了包含顺磁金属、顺磁Mott、反铁磁金属和反铁磁Mott态的丰富U-θ相图。
AI.conclusion: 几何压缩能够有效调控kagome晶格上的电子关联行为，产生轨道选择性的Mott相，揭示了晶格几何、磁阻挫和强关联之间的复杂相互作用，为理解阻挫二维系统中竞争电子序的物理机制提供了重要见解。

title: Critical behavior of the driven Curie-Weiss model
summary: We complete the phase diagram of the macroscopic Curie-Weiss magnet in a time-periodic external field, as a function of temperature and driving parameters. There is a regime (large enough driving amplitude and frequency, at low temperatures) where stable paramagnetic and ferromagnetic phases coexist. In particular, we present a new detailed analysis of the (nonequilibrium) specific heat, diverging at the same critical inverse temperature $β_c$ as the magnetic susceptibility. The new Curie temperature decreases with the driving, and we find critical exponent $α=1$ for $β\downarrow β_c$, and $α\simeq 0.86$ for $β\uparrow β_c$, even for small driving. A Floquet analysis shows the nature of the criticality, which is dynamical, with implications that remain unseen and are mostly impossible when the system is in thermal equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文完成了交流场驱动下居里-外斯磁体的完整相图，发现了顺磁相与铁磁相共存的新区域，并揭示比热在临界点处的不对称临界指数（α=1 和 α≈0.86），通过Floquet分析表明该临界性具有动力学本质。
AI.motivation: 传统平衡态统计力学无法描述周期驱动下的磁性系统，且此前对交流场中居里-外斯模型的相图认识不完整，尤其缺乏对比热等非平衡热力学量的详细分析。
AI.method: 采用宏观居里-外斯模型，施加时间周期性外场；通过Floquet分析研究临界动力学性质；计算非平衡比热和磁化率，提取临界指数。
AI.result: 在低温和大幅/高频驱动下发现顺磁与铁磁相共存；新的居里温度随驱动增强而降低；比热在 β↓β_c 方向临界指数 α=1，β↑β_c 方向 α≈0.86，即使小驱动也不对称。
AI.conclusion: 驱动场的存在引入了平衡态无法观测的动力学临界行为，相图显著改变，非平衡比热发散具有方向依赖性，拓展了对非平衡相变的理解。

title: Graphene Electric Double-Layer Transistors for Enhanced-Sensitivity Label-Free Detection of Human Serum Albumin
summary: Accurate detection of human serum albumin (HSA) is essential for the early diagnosis and monitoring of renal and hepatic disorders. We present a graphene-based electrolyte-gated field-effect transistor (EGFET) for label-free, real-time quantification of HSA under non-Faradaic operation. Devices exploit the high interfacial capacitance of the electric double layer (EDL) to transduce electrostatic perturbations induced by albumin adsorption into measurable conductance modulation. Negatively charged HSA molecules induce systematic modulation of the graphene channel, producing a concentration-dependent displacement of the Dirac voltage consistent with p-type doping. To establish a molecular-level interpretation of the sensing response, Brownian Dynamics simulations show that HSA adsorbs onto graphene through multiple adsorption orientations associated with heterogeneous interfacial charge distributions and variable dipole alignments relative to the surface. Adsorption is energetically stabilized by van der Waals interactions. Analysis of transfer characteristics across concentrations ranging from 0.01 to 30mgmL-1 reveals a correlation between surface charge density and carrier transport modulation within the electric double layer. Optimized devices exhibit a limit of detection of 0.0087 mg mL-1 and a linear dynamic range extending to 10 mg mL-1. The response remains non-Faradaic under sub-volt operation with reversible and reproducible behavior. The use of an inverse-mobility analytical metric highlights the role of disorder-enhanced carrier scattering in signal amplification, enabling sensitive electrostatic detection while preserving reversible device operation. These results establish liquid-gated graphene EGFETs as a promising platform for quantitative protein sensing and provide insight into disorder-mediated transport mechanisms in graphene bioelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于石墨烯电解质栅控场效应晶体管（EGFET）的非法拉第、无标记实时检测人血清白蛋白（HSA）方法。通过双电层电容感知白蛋白吸附引起的静电扰动，结合布朗动力学模拟揭示吸附取向与界面电荷分布机制。器件在0.01–30 mg/mL范围内实现检测，检测限达0.0087 mg/mL，并利用逆迁移率分析指标放大信号，为石墨烯生物电子器件中的无序介导输运机制提供了新见解。
AI.motivation: 人血清白蛋白（HSA）的精确检测对肾脏和肝脏疾病的早期诊断与监测至关重要，现有方法存在标记、实时性差等局限，亟需开发无标记、实时、灵敏的检测平台。
AI.method: 利用石墨烯EGFET的非法拉第操作模式，通过双电层的高界面电容将白蛋白吸附引起的静电扰动转化为可测的电导调制；结合布朗动力学模拟分析HSA在石墨烯上的多种吸附取向及界面电荷分布；采用逆迁移率（inverse-mobility）分析指标放大无序增强的载流子散射信号。
AI.result: 器件在0.01–30 mg/mL浓度范围内工作，狄拉克电压随浓度呈p型掺杂位移；检测限0.0087 mg/mL，线性动态范围延伸至10 mg/mL；亚伏操作下保持非法拉第、可逆、可重复响应。
AI.conclusion: 液态栅控石墨烯EGFET是定量蛋白质传感的有前景平台，并为石墨烯生物电子器件中无序介导的输运机制提供了新见解。

title: NanoBTE: Fast Iterative Solution of the Phonon Boltzmann Transport Equation for Nanoscale Heat Transport
summary: Nanoscale heat dissipation has become a critical challenge in advanced semiconductor devices, where phonon transport can strongly deviate from the classical Fourier description owing to boundary scattering and ballistic effects. Here, we propose NanoBTE, a deterministic finite-volume solver for the non-gray phonon Boltzmann transport equation under the relaxation-time approximation. NanoBTE supports complex two- and three-dimensional geometries, band-resolved phonon properties, discrete-ordinates angular quadrature, volumetric heat generation, and multiple phonon boundary conditions, including thermalizing, diffuse, and specular reflections. To improve the efficiency of multiscale simulations, we implement both sequential and synthetic iterative schemes, with the latter coupling the microscopic phonon transport equation to a macroscopic diffusion-type temperature equation to accelerate convergence in near-diffusive regimes. Furthermore, NanoBTE adopts a band-direction task decomposition strategy, enabling efficient MPI-based CPU parallelization and GPU acceleration of the dominant sparse transport operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NanoBTE，一个基于确定性有限体积法的非灰体声子玻尔兹曼输运方程求解器，支持复杂几何、多种边界条件、高效并行化与多尺度模拟加速，用于纳米尺度热耗散分析。
AI.motivation: 纳米尺度半导体器件中热耗散成为关键挑战，声子输运因边界散射和弹道效应强烈偏离经典傅里叶描述，亟需高效准确的数值求解工具。
AI.method: 采用确定性有限体积法求解弛豫时间近似下的非灰体声子玻尔兹曼输运方程；支持2D/3D复杂几何、能带分辨声子特性、离散纵标角积分、体积热源及多种边界条件；实现顺序迭代与合成迭代两种多尺度加速方案；采用能带-方向任务分解策略实现MPI并行与GPU加速。
AI.result: 实现了高效的多尺度模拟能力，在近扩散区域通过合成迭代加速收敛；基于能带-方向分解的并行策略有效支持大规模计算。
AI.conclusion: NanoBTE为纳米尺度器件热管理提供了高效的声子输运模拟工具，兼具精度与计算效率。

title: Hidden Gauge Freedom in Complex-Pole Hierarchical Equations of Motion
summary: While complex-pole hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM) have dramatically expanded the reach of numerically exact quantum dynamics simulations of open quantum systems, they suffer from numerical instabilities rooted in the non-Hermitian structure of their Liouvillian. Yet, the origin of this structure remains obscure. Here, we report a previously unknown gauge freedom in complex-pole HEOM: a continuous family of analytically equivalent Liouvillians, all encoding the same bath correlation function, whose numerical properties vary dramatically. This gauge controls both the eigenspectrum and non-normality of the hierarchy generator, revealing spectral divergence and non-normal error amplification as two distinct instability mechanisms. By optimizing this gauge, we introduce GO--HEOM, which eliminates divergences in strongly coupled Brownian oscillator environments and extends numerically exact simulations of sub-Ohmic dynamics -- including through the delocalized-to-localized quantum phase transition -- to previously inaccessible coupling strengths. Because this gauge transformation is independent of the bath-correlation decomposition scheme, our GO--HEOM becomes a general, broadly compatible strategy for accessing numerically exact quantum dynamics of open quantum systems over arbitrary coupling and highly non-Markovian regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文发现复杂极点HEOM中存在一种之前未知的规范自由度，通过优化该规范提出GO-HEOM方法，有效消除了强耦合环境中的数值不稳定性，扩展了开放量子系统数值精确模拟的适用范围。
AI.motivation: 复杂极点HEOM虽扩展了开放量子系统动力学模拟的能力，但其非厄密结构导致的数值不稳定性根源不明，亟需揭示这种不稳定性的来源并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 发现复杂极点HEOM中存在连续族的规范自由度（规范变换），该规范控制层级生成元的本征谱与非正规性，揭示了谱发散和非正规误差放大两种不稳定机制；通过优化该规范，提出GO-HEOM方法。
AI.result: GO-HEOM消除了强耦合布朗振子环境中的发散问题，将亚欧姆动力学的数值精确模拟（包括离域-局域化量子相变）推广到此前无法达到的耦合强度。
AI.conclusion: GO-HEOM独立于浴关联函数分解方案，是一种通用、广泛兼容的策略，可访问任意耦合和高度非马尔可夫区域的开放量子系统数值精确量子动力学。

title: Anomalous Structural Response of Quasi-One-Dimensional Antiferromagnetic Metal KMn6Bi5 under high pressure
summary: We report high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction measurements on the quasi-one-dimensional (Q1D) antiferromagnetic metal KMn6Bi5 up to 12.5 GPa, revealing the detailed pressure evolution of its atomic coordination environment. We find that the lattice exhibits pronounced anisotropic compressibility-the relative changes in the a and b lattice parameters reach a/a0=0.91 and b/b0 = 0.94 at 12.5 GPa-and a distinct structural anomaly emerges near 11 GPa without any symmetry-breaking. Detailed structural analysis further uncovers an anomalous hardening of the Mn nanotubes between 5 and 11 GPa, followed by a configuration optimization of the Mn/Bi nanotubes around 11 GPa. These features correlate closely with the reported pressure-temperature phase diagram of KMn6Bi5 and compare favorably with the chemical pressure effects induced by substituting K with Na, Rb, or Cs. Our findings provide key microscopic insights into how coordination environment modulation governs the stability of electronic orders in low-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 通过高压单晶X射线衍射实验，揭示了准一维反铁磁金属KMn6Bi5在12.5 GPa下的原子配位环境演化，发现晶格具有显著的各向异性压缩性，并在11 GPa附近出现无对称性破缺的结构异常，与压力-温度相图和化学压力效应高度关联。
AI.motivation: 理解低维系统中配位环境调控如何影响电子有序态的稳定性，为探索压力作用下准一维反铁磁金属的结构-物性关联提供微观层面的关键见解。
AI.method: 采用高压单晶X射线衍射测量，在0至12.5 GPa压力范围内系统研究KMn6Bi5的晶格参数和原子配位环境的变化，并结合化学压力效应（K被Na、Rb、Cs替换）进行对比分析。
AI.result: 晶格展现出显著的各向异性压缩性（a轴压缩至0.91，b轴压缩至0.94）；在11 GPa附近出现无对称性破缺的结构异常；Mn纳米管在5-11 GPa区间出现异常硬化，随后在11 GPa附近发生构型优化。
AI.conclusion: 这些结构特征与已报道的压力-温度相图高度吻合，且与化学压力效应一致，说明配位环境调制是控制低维系统电子有序稳定性的关键因素。

title: Supercritical fluid of quantum electrons in three-dimensional superconducting fullerides
summary: The supercritical fluid (SCF) of quantum electrons at the Mott metal-insulator transition without symmetry breaking is one of the most elusive phenomena in strongly correlated electron physics. Prior studies of Cr-doped V2O3 and organic Mott systems reported discrepant critical exponents. A key limitation is that the scaling analysis relies on a single experimental observable, leaving the roles of phase coexistence, inhomogeneity, and percolation unaddressed. Here we report the first experimental identification of a thermodynamically equilibrated SCF phase and its associated Mott endpoint in the three-dimensional superconducting fullerides CsxRb3-xC60, using two independent probes of electrical conductivity and magnetic susceptibility, which reveal two distinct metal-insulator transition lines converging at a single Mott endpoint. A hypothesis-free two-particle analysis of magnetic susceptibilities yields a metal-insulator coexisting SCF by exhibiting the maximum two-phase mixing entropy, in agreement with a picture of a thermodynamically equilibrated Widom line. Simultaneously, conductivity scaling yields a critical exponent in the regime of quantum critical predictions. Our new dual-probe approach provides a unified microscopic picture of the Mott SCF with a characteristic length scale below current diffraction resolution, in addition to a new interpretation on the origin of superconducting Tc-dome.

AI.tldr: 本文通过电导率和磁化率双探针实验，首次在三维超导富勒烯CsxRb3-xC60中鉴定出热力学平衡的超临界流体（SCF）相及其Mott端点，解决了长期存在的临界指数不一致问题，并提出了统一微观图像。
AI.motivation: 先前对Cr掺杂V2O3和有机Mott系统的研究报道了不一致的临界指数，且传统标度分析仅依赖单一实验观测量，无法解决相共存、不均匀性和渗流等问题，亟需多探针方法揭示Mott金属-绝缘体转变中超临界流体的本质。
AI.method: 采用电导率和磁化率两种独立探针同步测量三维超导富勒烯CsxRb3-xC60；对磁化率进行无假设的双粒子分析以提取两相混合熵；对电导率进行标度分析提取临界指数。
AI.result: 发现两条不同的金属-绝缘体转变线汇聚于单一Mott端点；磁化率双粒子分析显示最大两相混合熵，证实热力学平衡的Widom线图像；电导率标度得到的临界指数符合量子临界预言。
AI.conclusion: 双探针方法提供了Mott超临界流体的统一微观图像，其特征长度尺度低于当前衍射分辨率，并为超导Tc穹顶的起源提供了新解释。

title: On data-driven parameterizations of multidimensional generalized Langevin dynamics in the presence of a quadratic potential
summary: We propose a numerical algorithm to construct a Markov model with an extended list of variables to parameterize the equation of motion of a multidimensional coarse-grained physical system in an external potential, when memory effects are relevant. Our method uses autocorrelation data of the stationary velocities, but it avoids the inverse problem of finding the corresponding memory kernel from these data in a first step. Rather, the data are used to construct a Prony series approximation of the autocorrelation function, and the parameters of this Prony series provide the corresponding Markov model. Numerical results for molecular dynamics data show a good match for parameterized models with five auxiliary variables for a one-dimensional, and twelve auxiliary variables for a two-dimensional system.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种数值算法，通过扩展辅助变量构建马尔可夫模型，以参数化存在记忆效应的多维粗粒化物理系统的运动方程，避免了直接从速度自相关数据求解记忆核的逆问题。
AI.motivation: 当多维粗粒化物理系统受到外部势能作用且记忆效应显著时，传统方法需要从速度自相关数据反推记忆核，这是一个病态逆问题。作者希望避开这一困难，直接构建等效的马尔可夫模型。
AI.method: 利用平稳速度的自相关数据，将其拟合为Prony级数近似，再根据Prony级数的参数构建对应的马尔可夫模型（引入辅助变量扩展状态空间）。
AI.result: 对分子动力学数据的数值实验表明：一维系统使用5个辅助变量、二维系统使用12个辅助变量时，参数化模型与原始数据吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效简化了记忆核的求解过程，为具有记忆效应的粗粒化建模提供了一种可行的替代方案。

title: Robustness of quantized Hall resistivity under cavity coupling at zero temperature
summary: Recent experiments have shown that strong light-matter coupling in electromagnetic cavities can modify transport properties of quantum Hall systems through the formation of Landau polaritons, prompting questions about the robustness of topological protection. While earlier theory demonstrated that the Hall conductivity can be modified at finite temperature and finite polariton lifetime (or finite broadening), experiments primarily probe the resistivity tensor. Our phenomenological model reveals an asymmetry between conductivity and resistivity in quantum Hall systems under strong light-matter interaction, showing that at zero temperature the Hall resistivity remains completely immune to cavity-induced modifications arising from polariton broadening, independent of the light-matter coupling strength. These results provide a deeper explanation for the absence of renormalization in the von Klitzing constant in experiments probing the even QH plateaus through the Hall resistivity at low temperature, and clarify the distinct roles of dissipation and strong light-matter coupling in hybrid light-matter systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了强光-物质耦合下量子霍尔系统中的电导率与电阻率之间的不对称性，发现零温下霍尔电阻率完全不受腔诱导修正的影响，解释了为什么实验中没有观察到冯·克利青常数的重整化。
AI.motivation: 实验表明电磁腔中的强光-物质耦合可以通过形成朗道极化子改变量子霍尔系统的输运性质，引发了对拓扑保护鲁棒性的疑问。先前的理论证明霍尔电导率在有限温度和有限极化子寿命下会被修正，但实验主要探测的是电阻率张量，因此需要澄清这一差异。
AI.method: 构建了一个唯象模型，分析强光-物质相互作用下量子霍尔系统中电导率与电阻率之间的不对称性。
AI.result: 零温下霍尔电阻率完全免疫于由极化子展宽引起的腔诱导修正，且与光-物质耦合强度无关。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果解释了为什么在低温下通过霍尔电阻率探测偶数量子霍尔平台时，冯·克利青常数没有观察到重整化，并阐明了耗散与强光-物质耦合在混合光-物质系统中的不同作用。

title: Enhanced hydrogen response of copper-doped TiO$_2$ synthesised by helium-assisted magnetron sputtering
comment: Revised version submitted to Applied Surface Science
summary: Cu-doped TiO$_2$ thin films for hydrogen sensing were synthesised by reactive DC magnetron sputtering in Ar/O$_2$/He mixtures, with the He fraction used as a control parameter for film growth. By combining normal-angle deposition (NAD) and glancing-angle deposition (GLAD) with post-deposition annealing, the effects of He on microstructure formation and sensor performance were examined. X-ray diffraction and electron microscopy revealed that He promotes nanostructuring, lattice expansion in as-deposited NAD films, increased porosity after annealing, and a stronger anatase character in the final oxide layers. These structural changes, which enhance the reactive surface area, lead to improved hydrogen sensing at 300\,$^\circ$C in 1~vol.\,\% H$_2$. The response of NAD films increased from 1.4 to 6.0 simply by replacing part of the argon with helium, whereas GLAD films showed only a modest increase. The observed nanostructuring is discussed in terms of a simulation-supported growth scenario involving energetic backscattered He, a reduced hammering effect, and cooling-related suppression of adatom mobility, which together favour the formation of a more open sensing layer. Helium-assisted sputtering represents a useful physical route for tailoring oxide thin films for gas-sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在Ar/O₂/He混合气氛中通过反应直流磁控溅射制备Cu掺杂TiO₂薄膜用于氢气传感，发现He的加入能促进纳米结构形成、增大比表面积，使NAD薄膜对1 vol.% H₂在300°C下的响应从1.4提升至6.0。
AI.motivation: 探索通过He辅助溅射这一物理途径来调控氧化物薄膜的微观结构，从而改善气体传感器的性能。
AI.method: 采用反应直流磁控溅射（Ar/O₂/He混合气体），结合正角度沉积（NAD）和掠角沉积（GLAD）以及后退火处理，利用He分压作为生长控制参数，并通过XRD、电子显微镜等进行表征。
AI.result: He促进了纳米结构化和晶格膨胀，增加了退火后的孔隙率，增强了锐钛矿特征；NAD薄膜的氢气响应从1.4提高到6.0，而GLAD薄膜提升幅度较小。
AI.conclusion: He辅助溅射是一种有效的物理手段，可用于调控氧化物薄膜的微观结构，从而优化气体传感性能。

title: Combinatorial Compression in Nucleobase Self-Assembly Governed by Seeding Kinetics
summary: Crystallization from chemically complex mixtures is governed not only by thermodynamic stability but also by kinetic competition among structurally related components during nucleation and growth. When multiple compatible molecules compete for incorporation into early nuclei, the number of possible local recognition motifs can expand, delaying access to productive crystalline pathways. Here, we investigate this effect using supersaturated aqueous mixtures of the canonical nucleobases adenine (A), thymine (T), and uracil (U) as a minimal model for competitive supramolecular crystallization. Time-resolved turbidity measurements showed that ternary A+T+U mixtures crystallize more slowly and less efficiently than selected binary systems, despite containing individually crystallizable components. This inhibition is consistent with competition-induced kinetic frustration, where structurally similar hydrogen-bonding partners compete during early nucleation, delaying formation of a productive crystalline nucleus. We then show that preformed A+T crystalline seeds rescue ordered growth from the ternary mixture. Seeding sharply reduces the lag time, increases the apparent nucleation/onset rate, and redirects the solid product toward the A+T crystalline pathway, as confirmed by HPLC. Thus, the seed acts not only as a nucleation accelerator but as a selector of molecular composition and assembly trajectory within a multicomponent solution. We describe this process as kinetic compression: the reduction of accessible supramolecular assembly pathways through amplifications of selected productive growth pathways. These findings establish seeded crystallization as a mechanism for selecting compositional pathways in competitive molecular mixtures and suggest a physical route by which ordered molecular subsets can emerge from chemically complex environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了化学复杂混合物中竞争性超分子结晶的动力学抑制现象，发现三元碱基混合物（A+T+U）结晶比二元系统更慢，而预形成的A+T晶体种子可以加速并引导结晶路径，这种现象被称为"动力学压缩"。
AI.motivation: 探究在化学复杂混合物中，多种结构相似组分竞争性结晶时产生的动力学抑制机制，以及种子结晶如何选择性地引导结晶路径。
AI.method: 以腺嘌呤(A)、胸腺嘧啶(T)和尿嘧啶(U)组成的三元混合水溶液为模型，通过时间分辨浊度测量、HPLC分析和种子结晶实验进行研究。
AI.result: 三元A+T+U混合物结晶比二元系统更慢且效率更低；预形成的A+T晶体种子能显著缩短延迟时间、提高成核速率，并将固体产物导向A+T结晶路径。
AI.conclusion: 种子结晶不仅是成核加速器，更是分子组成和组装轨迹的选择器，通过"动力学压缩"机制减少可访问的超分子组装路径，为从化学复杂环境中涌现有序分子子集提供了物理途径。
