title: Nonlocal Kondo-exchange-driven intrinsic anomalous Hall effect in localized-$4f$ antiferromagnetic metals
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures in main text + supplemental material
summary: The anomalous Hall effect in antiferromagnetic metals has attracted considerable attention. Most known realizations involve itinerant $d$ electrons that simultaneously mediate charge transport and magnetic order. Here, we focus on $f$-electron materials, where localized magnetic moments and conduction electrons are hosted in different orbitals. We develop a theoretical framework to describe the impact of localized antiferromagnetic order on itinerant electrons. Applying this approach to the recently discovered $4f$ antiferromagnetic metal $\mathrm{Ce}_{2}\mathrm{Cu}\mathrm{Ge}_{6}$, we identify the origin of both the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity and the spin splitting of the energy bands as spin-dependent intersite hopping induced by nonlocal Kondo exchange coupling, rather than a Zeeman-type effective field acting locally on the conduction electrons.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了f电子反铁磁金属中反常霍尔效应的机制，以Ce₂CuGe₆为例，发现反常霍尔电导和能带自旋劈裂源于非局域Kondo交换耦合引起的自旋依赖的位点间跳跃，而非局域有效塞曼场。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁金属中的反常霍尔效应备受关注，但以往研究主要集中在d电子体系（同一轨道同时承担电荷输运和磁序），而f电子体系中局域磁矩与巡游电子分属不同轨道，其反常霍尔效应机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 建立了描述局域反铁磁序对巡游电子影响的理论框架，并将其应用于分析新型4f反铁磁金属Ce₂CuGe₆。
AI.result: 发现Ce₂CuGe₆中本征反常霍尔电导和能带自旋劈裂的起源是非局域Kondo交换耦合诱导的自旋依赖的位点间跳跃，而非局域有效塞曼场。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了f电子反铁磁金属中反常霍尔效应的独特物理机制，扩展了反铁磁自旋电子学的理论理解。

title: Ising-Machine-Assisted Large Neighborhood Search with Flexibly Tunable Subproblem Size
summary: Ising machines are heuristic solvers for combinatorial optimization, but their solution quality can degrade when large-scale constrained problems are solved directly. Ising-machine-assisted large neighborhood search (LNS) instead repeatedly updates a feasible current solution by solving smaller subproblems. An existing feasibility-preserving method for the vehicle routing problem (VRP) re-optimizes the entire routes of selected vehicles and thus cannot adjust the subproblem size finely. We propose LNS-VT, which introduces the number of consecutive steps re-optimized per vehicle as a parameter to control the subproblem size finely while preserving feasibility. For a 300-site, 5-vehicle VRP, its best setting reduced the objective value by approximately 10\% relative to the existing method after 100 iterations, and the appropriate setting changed with the current solution quality. Applying the same principle to the quadratic multiple knapsack problem, we confirmed that an appropriate subproblem size also exists, indicating that subproblem-size control is important in Ising-machine-assisted LNS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LNS-VT方法，通过精细控制子问题规模（每辆车连续重优化步数），在伊辛机辅助的大邻域搜索中提升大规模约束优化问题的求解质量。在300站点5车辆VRP上，最佳设置相比现有方法目标值降低约10%，且最优子问题规模随当前解质量变化。该原理在二次多背包问题上也得到验证。
AI.motivation: 伊辛机直接求解大规模约束优化问题时解质量下降；现有可行性保持的VRP方法重优化整条车辆路线，无法精细调整子问题规模。
AI.method: 提出LNS-VT，引入"每辆车连续重优化步数"作为可控参数，在保持可行性的同时实现子问题规模的精细调节。
AI.result: 在300站点5车辆VRP上，最佳设置比现有方法目标值降低约10%（100次迭代后）；子问题最优规模随当前解质量动态变化；该原理在QMKP上也得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 子问题规模控制对伊辛机辅助的LNS至关重要，不同问题领域均存在最优子问题规模，且需根据解质量动态调整。

title: Nonlocal Orbital-Angular-Momentum Dichroism of Vortex Light in Strained Crystals
summary: Vortex light carries orbital angular momentum (OAM) in its transverse phase, unlike spin, which is encoded in polarization. We show that this phase cannot produce OAM dichroism in any continuously translation-invariant system, even when optical nonlocality and multipole light--matter coupling are included. Nonuniform strain in a two-dimensional Dirac material bypasses this no-go condition by supplying transverse momentum transfer through a long-wavelength pseudo-gauge field, so that the OAM dichroism factorizes into a nonlocal elasto-optic tensor and the overlap of the vortex transverse phase current with the strain field. For a micron-scale Gaussian bubble, the resonant OAM-odd conductivity reaches \(\sim10^{-3}e^2/\hbar\), within reach of differential optical measurements.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了在连续平移不变系统中涡旋光的轨道角动量（OAM）无法产生二色性，但通过在二维狄拉克材料中引入非均匀应变（通过赝规范场）可以突破这一限制，实现可测量的OAM二色性响应。
AI.motivation: 探索涡旋光轨道角动量（OAM）是否能产生二色性，并寻找在何种物理条件下可以突破连续平移不变系统的限制。
AI.method: 理论推导表明连续平移不变系统中OAM二色性不存在（no-go定理），提出通过二维狄拉克材料中的非均匀应变引入伪规范场来提供横向动量转移，从而绕过该限制。
AI.result: OAM奇偶电导率在微米级高斯气泡下可达~10^{-3}e^2/ħ，处于差分光学测量可探测范围内。
AI.conclusion: 非均匀应变是打破OAM二色性对称性、实现可观测OAM响应的有效途径，为涡旋光与物质相互作用提供了新机制。

title: Anomalous Peak Formation in the Second Stability Zone of Quadrupole Mass Filters: Role of Non-linear Resonances Induced by Single Rod Defects
summary: Operating a quadrupole mass filter (QMF) within its second stability zone offers superior mass resolving power but introduces extreme sensitivity to structural imperfections. While symmetric misalignments are well-documented, this work combines analytical modeling with SIMION trajectory simulations to investigate the unaddressed electrodynamic impact of a completely localized, asymmetric defect on a single rod. Unlike diagonally symmetric perturbations, which reduce the four-fold rotational symmetry to two-fold symmetry while maintaining a smooth stability landscape, a single-rod defect breaks the remaining symmetry, giving rise to pronounced transmission ridges within the second stability zone. Spatial multipole expansion reveals that this structural breakdown injects odd-parity harmonics -- dominated by the hexapole A3 field -- which couple the orthogonal transverse equations of motion. By tracking secular indices through explicit zone-II Floquet projection mappings, we demonstrate that these asymmetric fields drive destructive, higher-order nonlinear secular resonances. Ions traversing these precise parametric coordinates undergo rapid amplitude growth and collide with adjacent electrodes, establishing critical geometric tolerance frameworks and operating conditions for high-performance mass spectrometry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了四极质量分析器(QMF)在第二稳定区运行时，单杆局部非对称缺陷对性能的影响。通过分析建模和SIMION轨迹模拟发现，此类缺陷会引入奇次谐波（主要是六极场A3），破坏对称性并引发非线性共振，导致离子振幅增长并撞向电极，从而限制了高分辨质谱的几何公差和操作条件。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已充分探讨对称性偏差对QMF的影响，但局部化、非对称的单杆缺陷的电动动力学效应尚未被研究，而这种缺陷在实际制造中难以避免，对QMF在第二稳定区（高分辨模式）的性能至关重要。
AI.method: 结合分析建模与SIMION轨迹模拟，采用空间多极场展开分析谐波成分，并通过显式Floquet投影映射追踪第二稳定区内的进动指数，表征非线性共振行为。
AI.result: 单杆缺陷打破了剩余的对称性，在第二稳定区内产生显著的传输脊；注入的奇次谐波（主要是六极场A3）耦合了正交横向运动方程，驱动高阶非线性共振，导致离子振幅快速增长并与相邻电极碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为高分辨质谱中QMF的几何公差和操作条件提供了关键框架，指出单杆非对称缺陷是限制性能的重要因素，对精密制造和仪器设计具有指导意义。

title: Topological Electronic States and Phonon Mediated Superconductivity in Ru Based Ternary Pnictides: ZrRuAs and HfRuP
summary: This study investigates the structural, electronic, mechanical, optical, thermodynamic, and superconducting properties of ZrRuAs and HfRuP. Electronic band structure calculations reveal topological semimetallic behavior in both compounds with several bands crossing the Fermi level. The inclusion of spin orbit coupling lifts band degeneracies in both compounds. The Fermi surface shows both electron and hole segments. The estimated Pugh ratio, Poisson ratio and machinability index indicate that both compounds are ductile in nature and exhibit excellent machinability. Optical results show metallic reflectivity and notable absorption in the ultraviolet region. Thermodynamic analysis indicates stable behavior. The estimated superconducting transition temperatures are 9.75 K for ZrRuAs and 9.03 K for HfRuP that indicates strong coupling conventional superconductivity. The results provide a detailed view of the physical and superconducting properties of ZrRuAs and HfRuP and help to close the existing research gaps in these topological superconducting materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，系统研究了ZrRuAs和HfRuP两种拓扑半金属材料的结构、电子、力学、光学、热力学及超导特性，发现二者均具有延展性、优异可加工性、紫外吸收、稳定热力学行为，超导转变温度分别为9.75 K和9.03 K，属于强耦合常规超导体。
AI.motivation: 填补ZrRuAs和HfRuP这两种拓扑超导材料在物理性质和超导特性方面的研究空白。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理计算，对两种化合物进行电子能带结构、自旋轨道耦合效应、费米面、力学常数（Pugh比、泊松比、可加工性指数）、光学性质、热力学性质及超导转变温度的系统分析。
AI.result: 两种化合物均呈现拓扑半金属行为，自旋轨道耦合解除能带简并；费米面由电子和空穴区段构成；具有延展性和优异可加工性；在紫外区域具有显著吸收；热力学稳定；ZrRuAs和HfRuP的超导转变温度分别为9.75 K和9.03 K，属于强耦合常规超导。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为ZrRuAs和HfRuP的物理和超导特性提供了详细认识，填补了相关拓扑超导材料的研究空白。

title: Chirped Floquet linear drives activate forbidden charge-to-spin conversions in Rashba two-dimensional electron gases
summary: In Rashba two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs), charge-to-spin conversion via the Edelstein effect is conventionally limited to the transverse plane. Accessing longitudinal or out-of-plane pathways typically requires static magnetic fields or interface engineering, which cause stray fields and lack tunability. While dynamic circular or elliptical Floquet drives can also unlock these forbidden pathways, a simple Floquet linear drive cannot. Here, we propose an alternative approach: a \textit{chirped} Floquet linear drive. The chirp induces in-plane Floquet-Zeeman fields and an odd-parity momentum drift, which simultaneously break rotational and time-reversal symmetries. This mechanism activates the forbidden Edelstein charge-to-spin conversions in Rashba 2DEGs. Experimentally accessible via programmable spatial light modulators or optical delay lines, this tunable chirped linear drive offers a broadly applicable route to spin-orbit torque switching and high-efficiency spintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用啁啾（chirped）线性Floquet驱动，通过打破旋转和时间反演对称性，在Rashba二维电子气中激活原本禁阻的Edelstein电荷-自旋转换，实现纵向和面外自旋极化，为自旋轨道转矩开关和高效率自旋电子学提供了可调谐的新途径。
AI.motivation: 传统Rashba二维电子气中，Edelstein效应的电荷-自旋转换局限于横向平面，纵向或面外通道需要静态磁场或界面工程，这些方法存在杂散场且缺乏可调谐性。现有动态圆/椭圆Floquet驱动虽能打开禁阻通道，但线性Floquet驱动无法实现。因此，需要一种无需静态场、可调谐且简单的方法来激活禁阻的自旋转换通道。
AI.method: 提出啁啾（chirped）线性Floquet驱动方案。啁啾驱动在面内诱导Floquet-塞曼场和奇宇称动量漂移，同时打破旋转对称性和时间反演对称性，从而激活Rashba 2DEG中原本禁阻的Edelstein电荷-自旋转换。该方案可通过可编程空间光调制器或光学延迟线实验实现。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，啁啾线性驱动能够有效激活被禁阻的Edelstein效应，实现纵向和面外方向的电荷-自旋转换，且具有可调谐性。
AI.conclusion: 啁啾线性Floquet驱动是一种无需静态磁场、可调谐且实验可行的新方案，可广泛适用于自旋轨道转矩开关和高效率自旋电子学器件。

title: Semi-Markovian switching in a fluctuating harmonic trap: An age-structured formulation
summary: We study a Brownian particle in a harmonic trap whose stiffness switches between two values with arbitrary waiting-time statistics, generating semi-Markovian dynamics. To treat the resulting temporal memory, we formulate the problem in an enlarged age-structured state space, restoring Markovianity and yielding a local Fokker--Planck description. Within this framework, we derive exact steady-state integral equations for the spatial and birth distributions and obtain exact expressions for stationary moments, injected power, and potential energy. In the second part of the paper, we analyze the stochastic-resetting limit, corresponding to a particle alternately released and trapped. By representing the stationary spatial distribution as a superposition of Gaussian states with fluctuating variance, the problem can be reformulated as a switching process in variance space. This yields exact integral equations for the variance distributions and leads to a simplified description amenable to direct analytical treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了谐波陷阱中布朗粒子在刚度随机切换（半马尔可夫过程）下的动力学，通过年龄结构状态空间恢复马尔可夫性，推导出稳态积分方程和精确矩，并分析了随机重置极限下的方差分布。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多假设切换过程为马尔可夫（指数等待时间），但实际系统中等待时间可能服从任意分布（半马尔可夫），产生时间记忆效应，需要新的理论框架来处理这类非马尔可夫随机切换动力学。
AI.method: 1) 引入年龄结构状态空间（augmented age-structured state space）将半马尔可夫过程转化为局部Fokker-Planck方程；2) 推导稳态空间分布和birth分布的精确积分方程；3) 在随机重置极限下，将空间分布表示为方差随机波动的Gaussian态叠加，转化为方差空间的切换过程。
AI.result: 1) 得到稳态矩、注入功率和势能的精确表达式；2) 在随机重置极限下，获得方差分布的精确积分方程，实现了问题的简化描述。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立的年龄结构框架为处理半马尔可夫随机切换系统提供了普适方法，方差空间视角下的随机重置问题可进一步直接解析处理，具有广泛适用性。

title: Hybrid-order nonlinear topological phases
summary: The bulk-boundary correspondence (BBC), which relates topological invariants to boundary modes, is well understood for linear systems but remains an open question in the presence of nonlinearity, where multigap topologies make the BBC obscure and the topological description troublesome. We address this by developing an auxiliary-system formalism that enables topological classification of nonlinear-eigenvalue systems. In the two-dimension (2D) case, we show that two fixed eigenvalues can harbor first-order gapless boundary modes and second-order corner modes. Stacking this 2D system along the third dimension (3D) reveals distinct hybrid-order realizations. Under uniform stacking, the corner states in the $xy$ plane transform into hinge states along the $z$ axis, yielding a 3D second-order phase, while the gapless boundary states become side-surface states, yielding a 3D first-order phase. For dimerized stacking, these states are further confined to the two ends of the $z$ axis, yielding a 3D third-order phase, and localized at the hinges, yielding a 3D second-order phase. Our results establish a multiband bulk-boundary correspondence and identify stacking engineering as a versatile platform for exploring hybrid-order topological phases in nonlinear systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过发展辅助系统形式主义，建立了非线性系统中的多带体-边界对应关系，并展示了堆叠工程作为探索混合阶拓扑相的平台。
AI.motivation: 线性系统中的体-边界对应关系已被充分理解，但在非线性系统中，由于多带隙拓扑使体-边界对应变得模糊且拓扑描述困难，这一问题仍未解决。
AI.method: 开发了一种辅助系统形式主义，用于非线性特征值系统的拓扑分类。通过沿第三维度堆叠二维系统，研究均匀堆叠和二聚化堆叠下的拓扑相实现。
AI.result: 在二维中，两个固定特征值可容纳一阶无隙边界模和二阶角模。均匀堆叠产生三维二阶相（角态→铰链态）和三维一阶相（无隙边界态→侧表面态）；二聚化堆叠产生三维三阶相（态被限制在z轴两端）和三维二阶相（态局域在铰链处）。
AI.conclusion: 建立了多带体-边界对应关系，并指出堆叠工程是探索非线性系统中混合阶拓扑相的通用平台。

title: Color Centers in Cubic Boron Nitride
summary: Cubic boron nitride (c-BN) is a wide-bandgap semiconductor (WBGS) with potential applications in both power electronics and quantum technologies. Color centers in WBGS can be used as single photon emitters and quantum sensors. Several zero phonon lines have been measured in c-BN experiment but not yet identified. To systematically probe the combinatorially complex chemical space of defects, we generate a large-scale point defect data set for c-BN. We apply density functional theory calculation implemented in a high-throughput workflow Automatic Defect Analysis and Qualification (ADAQ) to broadly screen for point defect complexes containing s- or p-elements. More than 8000 defects have been calculated in different charge and spin states. The calculated properties are stored in defect database and are then filtered to find defects with properties similar to the NV-center in diamond. More accurate calculations using hybrid functionals are then performed on a selected set of promising defects to further assess their suitability for quantum technology. In particular, we reexamined the ONVB defect which likely explains the GC-2 line. The hybrid calculations also suggest other defect candidates with bright emission, such as two carbon defects and the NaB- defect.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高通量计算和密度泛函理论，系统筛选了立方氮化硼（c-BN）中超过8000种点缺陷复合物，旨在寻找类似金刚石NV色心的量子技术候选缺陷，并重新验证了ONVB缺陷以解释GC-2光谱线，同时提出了碳缺陷和NaB-缺陷等新候选者。
AI.motivation: c-BN作为宽禁带半导体在量子技术中有潜力，但其零声子线的实验观测尚未得到理论识别。为系统探索缺陷的巨大化学空间并寻找适合量子技术的色心，作者进行了大规模计算筛选。
AI.method: 采用高通量工作流ADAQ结合密度泛函理论，计算了8000多种含s/p元素的点缺陷复合物在不同电荷和自旋态下的性质，存储在缺陷数据库中；随后以金刚石NV色心为参照进行筛选，最后用杂化泛函对候选缺陷进行高精度计算。
AI.result: 重新验证了ONVB缺陷很可能是实验观测的GC-2光谱线的来源；同时通过杂化泛函计算发现了其他有潜力的缺陷，包括两种碳缺陷和NaB-缺陷，它们具有明亮的发射特性。
AI.conclusion: 高通量计算结合高精度验证是识别c-BN中量子技术相关色心的有效策略，ONVB缺陷和新型碳/NaB-缺陷值得进一步实验探索。

title: Physically-Relevant Information Learning in High-Dimensional Time-Derivatives Spaces
summary: Understanding the physics of many-body complex dynamical systems is typically non-trivial. High-dimensional analysis approaches are often deemed necessary to prevent losing important information. Typically, these use order parameters or descriptors capturing information related to, e.g., relative positions, symmetries, etc., of the units in the studied system. However, in many cases, gaining information related to the relative positions (or velocities) of the constitutive units alone may be insufficient, and to reach a more complete physical knowledge, one should ideally learn and correlate with each other both structure and dynamics. Here we demonstrate how to efficiently achieve such a goal by building and navigating high-dimensional Time-Derivatives (TiDe) space. A TiDe space can be easily generated for virtually any type of system/phenomenon under study from the time-series data collected along its observation over time. Each TiDe's dimension corresponds to a growing-order time-derivative of the extracted data, thus containing information related to different types of physical phenomena/events that can be easily extracted via unsupervised approaches. We demonstrate how, by definition, TiDes can be directly analyzed without a need for prior dimensionality reduction, providing results that are intrinsically intuitive to interpret. We show the potential of the method by analyzing two prototypical example datasets extracted from molecular dynamics simulations or experimental tracking of different complex dynamical systems. Our results demonstrate how efficiently one can navigate and learn in such information-rich TiDe spaces, which provide robust general frameworks for data analysis and for studying complex dynamical systems from the data collected along their observation over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过构建高维时间导数（TiDe）空间来高效分析复杂多体动力学系统的方法。TiDe空间由观测数据的不同阶时间导数构成，无需降维即可直接分析，能同时捕获结构和动力学信息，并通过无监督学习提取物理现象。作者在分子动力学模拟和实验追踪数据上验证了该方法的高效性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统高维分析方法通常仅关注相对位置、对称性等结构信息，但仅凭这些信息不足以全面理解复杂动力学系统的物理本质。作者认为需要同时关联学习系统的结构与动力学信息，以达成更完整的物理认知。
AI.method: 构建时间导数（TiDe）空间：从观测时间序列数据中提取不同阶次的时间导数作为空间的各个维度。每个维度对应一个增长阶次的导数，包含不同类型物理现象/事件的信息。该空间可直接通过无监督方法进行分析，无需预先降维。
AI.result: 在分子动力学模拟和实验追踪两个典型复杂动力学系统数据集上，TiDe空间能够高效地导航和学习，提供了直观可解释的分析结果，验证了该方法作为通用数据分析框架的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TiDe空间为研究复杂动力学系统提供了一种通用的、信息丰富的分析框架，能够同时捕获结构和动力学信息，且结果直观可解释，无需降维即可直接分析。

title: Optical switching of antiferromagnetic domains by nonreciprocal heat current
comment: 23 pages for main text, 6 pages for supplementary information
summary: What distinguishes front from back? In physics, such directionality emerges only when an underlying symmetry is broken. Antiferromagnets that inherently break both space-inversion and time-reversal symmetries provide a striking example, exhibiting nonreciprocal optical responses that depend on the direction of light propagation. Beyond distinguishing antiferromagnetic domains, we show that this nonreciprocity can deterministically create them. Using mid-infrared light, we demonstrate deterministic switching of antiferromagnetic domains in the magnetoelectric antiferromagnet LiFePO4, where illumination from opposite sides selectively stabilizes opposite domain states. Remarkably, the switching persists over a broad wavelength range rather than being confined to a narrow transition-specific spectral region, overcoming the spectral and material constraints of resonance-based optical switching schemes. The broadband switching originates from the material's intrinsic nonreciprocity through optically generated heat currents. Our results establish nonreciprocity as a general principle for deterministically controlling symmetry-broken phases with light.

AI.tldr: 本文发现反铁磁体LiFePO₄中的非互易光学响应可用于确定性切换反铁磁畴：不同方向的中红外光照可选择性地稳定相反畴态，且该效应在宽波长范围内有效，源于非互易性产生的光致热流。
AI.motivation: 探究反铁磁体中因空间反演和时间反演对称性破缺而产生的非互易光学响应，并展示这种非互易性不仅能区分反铁磁畴，还能确定性创建它们。
AI.method: 使用中红外光从不同方向照射磁电反铁磁体LiFePO₄，观测非互易光学响应导致的确定性反铁磁畴切换，并分析其波长依赖性及物理机制。
AI.result: 成功实现反铁磁畴的确定性切换：相反方向光照选择性稳定相反畴态；该效应覆盖宽波长范围，不受限于特定共振频率；切换机制源于材料本征非互易性产生的光致热流。
AI.conclusion: 非互易性可作为用光确定性控制对称性破缺相的一般性原理，克服了传统共振光学切换方案的频谱和材料限制。

title: Nucleation and time-reversal symmetry breaking in nonconserved scalar field theories
summary: Classical nucleation theory (CNT) describes the formation of a stable phase from a metastable one in terms of a single reaction coordinate that corresponds to the radius of a nucleating droplet. In this work, we provide a full account of nonequilibrium nucleation theory (NNT), which generalizes CNT to non-equilibrium field theories with non-conserved order parameter. We present two equivalent derivations of the dynamics of the droplet radius: a stochastic route, based on a direct projection of the stochastic field equation onto the radial reaction coordinate, and a route based on the minimization of the Freidlin-Wentzell action. Crucially, the quasipotential barrier predicted by NNT differs from the one found when assuming the instanton to be the time-reversal of the relaxation dynamics. Whereas the interfacial density profile differs from that on the relaxation path, an analytical derivation of NNT remains possible using a careful definition of the reaction coordinate. This leverages the perturbative structure that (in common with CNT) emerges in the limit of large critical radius. We further derive with similar techniques the dynamics of capillary waves, whose stability is required for the CNT/NNT precept of a near-spherical droplet to prevail. After deriving our theory for generic non-conserved field-theories, we address two explicit examples: a non-equilibrium generalization of Model A (Active Model A), and a population dynamics model (with two choices of noise that each break time-reversal symmetry). In both cases, we validate our analytical NNT against numerical results obtained by action minimization, with excellent agreement. NNT provide a systematic framework for constructing nucleation theories in a broad class of non-equilibrium systems from active matter, reaction-diffusion systems and population dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非平衡成核理论（NNT），将经典成核理论推广至非平衡场理论，通过随机投影与Freidlin-Wentzel作用量最小化两种等价方法推导液滴半径动力学，并成功应用于Active Model A和种群动力学模型。
AI.motivation: 经典成核理论仅适用于平衡态，无法描述非平衡系统（如活性物质、反应扩散系统）中的成核现象，亟需建立适用于非守恒序参量非平衡场理论的推广框架。
AI.method: 1) 随机路径：将随机场方程直接投影到径向反应坐标；2) Freidlin-Wentzell作用量最小化路径。两种方法等价地导出液滴半径动力学。通过准势垒与时间反演假设下的势垒差异，以及界面密度分布与弛豫路径的不同，利用大临界半径极限下的微扰结构进行分析。
AI.result: NNT预测的准势垒不同于假设瞬子为时间反演弛豫路径的结果；在非平衡Model A推广与种群动力学模型（两种打破时间反演对称性的噪声选择）中，分析结果与数值作用量最小化结果高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: NNT为非平衡系统（活性物质、反应扩散、种群动力学等）中构建成核理论提供了系统化框架。

title: Computational Determination of Optimal Growth Protocols for Metastable Polymorphs
summary: The reliable growth of a desired target structure remains a central challenge for organic-inorganic interfaces. Specific interface structures can exhibit properties that are superior compared to those of other possible interface structures, but identifying growth conditions that selectively produce a given surface structure is difficult, particularly when the target structure is thermodynamically metastable. Here, we demonstrate how time-dependent temperature and pressure protocols can be optimized to promote the high-yield formation of a metastable surface polymorph. To this end, we combine kinetic Monte Carlo simulations with a parameterized nucleation-and-growth model and apply optimal control theory to predict growth recipes that maximize the yield of the desired target structure. Applying this approach to a prototypical model of an organic molecules adsorbed on a metal surface, we identify experimentally plausible protocols that guide the system through phase space while avoiding kinetic growth regimes in which formation of the thermodynamically stable structure is favored. Compared to a manually optimized three-step protocol, the optimized control trajectory increases the yield of the desired metastable phase from 73 % to 97 % for the same total protocol duration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合动力学蒙特卡洛模拟、成核生长模型和最优控制理论的方法，通过优化温压协议（温度和压力随时间变化的程序）来促进亚稳态表面多晶型物的高产率生长，在有机分子吸附于金属表面的模型中，将目标亚稳态相的产率从手动优化的73%提升至97%。
AI.motivation: 有机-无机界面中，特定亚稳态界面结构具有更优性能，但如何选择性地生长目标结构（尤其是热力学亚稳态）是一个核心挑战，现有方法难以精准控制生长条件。
AI.method: 结合动力学蒙特卡洛模拟与参数化成核生长模型，并应用最优控制理论，预测能最大化目标亚稳态结构产率的温度-压力时间演化协议。
AI.result: 在有机分子/金属表面模型体系中，优化后的控制协议将目标亚稳态相的产率从手动三步协议的73%提升至97%，且总持续时间相同。
AI.conclusion: 证明最优控制理论可以有效引导系统避开热力学稳定相有利的动力学生长区间，从而高产率获得亚稳态目标结构，为实验设计提供可行的温压协议方案。

title: cQED-iCIPT2: A Near-Exact Method for Polaritonic Chemistry
summary: Strong light-matter coupling in optical cavities provides a versatile platform for modulating chemical structure, reactivity, and spectroscopy, and hence motivates the development of ab initio cavity quantum electrodynamics (cQED) methods that can treat the electronic and photonic degrees of freedom on an equal footing. We present such a method, cQED-iCIPT2, by combining the near-exact iCIPT2 (iterative configuration interaction with selection and second-order perturbation theory) with the cQED Hamiltonian in two ways, cQED-PN-iCIPT2 and cQED-CS-iCIPT2. The former works directly in the photon-number representation, whereas the latter employs a coherent-state transformation that restores origin invariance of the cQED Hamiltonian and avoids artificially strong coupling in charged systems. To efficiently handle the tensor-product structure of the electron-photon wavefunction, we introduce a graded configuration space organized by photon numbers and decompose the key computational steps (selection, diagonalization, and perturbation correction) into intra- and inter-subspace steps, so as to maximize the reuse of the existing infrastructure in the MetaWave platform (J. Phys. Chem. A 2025, 129, 5170). The selection step enables automatic determination of the optimal number of photons without a priori truncation. The efficacy of the methods is showcased dissociation of N2, torsion of ethylene, proton transfer reactions in malonaldehyde and aminopropenal, and low-lying excited states of polyacenes. The results provide numerically accurate reference data and meanwhile reveal how the cavity can fine-tune reaction barriers, alter potential energy surfaces, and induce state crossings. As such, this work establishes a robust near-exact framework for polaritonic chemistry in the presence of both strong electron correlation and strong light-matter coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出cQED-iCIPT2方法，将近精确的电子结构方法iCIPT2与腔量子电动力学哈密顿量结合，发展了两种变体（cQED-PN-iCIPT2和cQED-CS-iCIPT2），用于处理强光-物质耦合下的极化子化学，并在多种分子体系中展示了其数值精度与物理洞察能力。
AI.motivation: 光腔中的强光-物质耦合为调控化学结构、反应性和光谱学提供了新平台，但缺乏能够同等处理电子和光子自由度的从头算方法，因而需要发展精确的腔量子电动力学计算方法。
AI.method: 将近精确的iCIPT2方法与cQED哈密顿量结合，发展两种变体：cQED-PN-iCIPT2（直接在光子数表示中工作）和cQED-CS-iCIPT2（采用相干态变换以恢复原点不变性）。引入按光子数组织的分级组态空间，将关键计算步骤分解为子空间内和子空间间操作，以最大化复用现有计算基础设施。
AI.result: 在N2解离、乙烯扭转、丙二醛和氨基丙烯醛的质子转移反应以及多并苯的低激发态等体系中展示了方法的有效性，提供了数值准确的参考数据，并揭示了腔如何微调反应势垒、改变势能面和诱导能态交叉。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了在强电子相关和强光-物质耦合并存条件下用于极化子化学的鲁棒近精确计算框架。

title: Near itinerancy and slow singlet formation in the triangular lattice NaRuO2
summary: NaRuO$_2$ forms a delafossite-like structure that contains triangular sublattices of edge-sharing RuO$_6$ octahedra. It shows no evidence of magnetic order down to 100 mK and persistent spin fluctuations, suggestive of a quantum disordered magnetic ground state. In order to characterize the physical regime from which this disordered state arises, we use resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) at the Ru-$L_{2,3}$-edge, along with pulsed high-field magnetization to characterize both the local electronic structure and the magnetic interactions. Despite significant spin-orbit coupling inferred from XAS measurements, a spin-orbit exciton, characteristic of a spin-orbit assisted Mott insulator, was not observed with RIXS due to the presence of damped intraorbital excitations, which are characteristic of a metal. Corroborated by models of the high-field magnetization to a random singlet model, we propose a picture of a nearly itinerant system with strong magnetic and charge fluctuations that destabilize long-range magnetic order.

AI.tldr: NaRuO₂是一种类铜铁矿结构的材料，在极低温下仍无磁有序，表现出量子无序基态。通过RIXS、XAS和高场磁化测量发现，尽管存在显著的SOC，但材料并非SOC辅助的Mott绝缘体，而是更像近巡游体系，强磁和电荷涨落抑制了长程磁序。
AI.motivation: 探究NaRuO₂为何在极低温下仍无磁有序，表征其量子无序基态源于何种物理机制，明确其局域电子结构和磁相互作用。
AI.method: 利用Ru-L₂,₃边的共振非弹性X射线散射(RIXS)和X射线吸收光谱(XAS)，结合脉冲高场磁化测量，分析局域电子结构和磁相互作用。
AI.result: XAS显示存在显著SOC，但RIXS未观测到SOC辅助Mott绝缘体特征的自旋-轨道激子，代之以阻尼的轨道内激发（金属特征）。高场磁化数据符合随机单重态模型。
AI.conclusion: NaRuO₂处于近巡游体系，强磁和电荷涨落破坏了长程磁有序，形成量子无序基态。

title: A universal emulator for planar Ising lattices
summary: We introduce the notion of an Ising emulator for two-dimensional Ising models: flat, unit-edge-length lattices can be represented as site- or bond-diluted supercells of a single host lattice, for which the Feynman--Vdovichenko/Kac--Ward solution is fixed once and for all. We construct explicit square and triangular emulators and show that a single transition matrix, supplemented by lattice-specific binary masks, gives all the thermodynamic quantities of interest for both ferro- and antiferromagnetic couplings. We apply the framework to all eleven Archimedean lattices, to all twenty $2$-uniform lattices -- whose thermodynamics is obtained here for the first time -- and to several pentagonal lattices, and show that the same construction extends directly to fractal and disordered Ising models, with no modification to the underlying machinery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种“伊辛模拟器”方法，通过将二维伊辛模型的各种晶格结构统一表示为单一宿主晶格的稀释超胞，并利用固定的Feynman-Vdovichenko/Kac-Ward解，从而高效计算多种晶格（包括阿基米德晶格、2-均匀晶格、五边形晶格、分形及无序模型）的热力学性质。
AI.motivation: 现有的二维伊辛模型求解方法通常针对特定晶格单独推导，缺乏统一框架。作者希望找到一个普适性方法，能够用一套固定的数学工具处理多种晶格结构，包括规则晶格、不规则晶格甚至分形和无序系统。
AI.method: 提出“伊辛模拟器”概念：将目标晶格表示为单一宿主晶格（如方格或三角格）的位点稀释或键稀释超胞，利用预先求解好的Feynman-Vdovichenko/Kac-Ward转移矩阵，再通过二进制掩码来适应具体晶格。该方法同时适用于铁磁和反铁磁耦合。
AI.result: 成功构建了方格和三角格的模拟器，应用于全部11种阿基米德晶格、全部20种2-均匀晶格（首次获得后者的热力学结果），以及多种五边形晶格。该方法还可直接扩展到分形和无序伊辛模型，无需修改底层机制。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架为二维伊辛模型的求解提供了一个高效、通用且可扩展的工具，尤其适用于非规则和复杂晶格结构。

title: Spin-orbit torque-driven synthetic antiferromagnetic oscillator
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary information is available as ancillary file
summary: Antiferromagnets offer a promising route toward robust spintronic devices because of their compensated magnetic order and exchange-enhanced spin dynamics. Here, we demonstrate a spin-orbit torque (SOT)-driven antiferromagnetic oscillator based on a nanoconstriction patterned from a synthetic antiferromagnet (SAF). Spin-rectification spectroscopy reveals electrical excitation of both acoustic and optical SAF eigenmodes, whose field and frequency dependences are quantitatively described by an antiferromagnetic resonance model. In addition to these linear eigenmodes, we observe low-field spin-rectification peaks that emerge only above a threshold DC current near the spin-flop transition. Their current-polarity-dependent sign and locking to an injected RF frequency provide electrical spin-rectification signatures consistent with current-selected chiral self-oscillatory dynamics. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce the threshold excitation of SOT-driven self-oscillations and injection locking, while macrospin simulations predict stable and chaotic nonlinear dynamics within the same spin-flop region. We interpret the multi-peak, weakly RF-frequency-dependent responses as a qualitative signature of complex nonlinear dynamics. These results establish SAF nanoconstrictions as an experimentally accessible platform for studying current-driven antiferromagnetic-like oscillator dynamics and motivate future work on nonlinear spintronic devices for signal processing and reservoir-computing concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文在合成反铁磁（SAF）纳米收缩结构中实现了自旋轨道矩（SOT）驱动的反铁磁振荡器，观测到了声学和光学本征模、自旋翻转转变附近的阈值激发自激振荡，以及复杂的非线性动力学行为。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁材料因其补偿磁序和交换增强的自旋动力学，有望实现鲁棒的自旋电子学器件，但反铁磁振荡器的实验实现仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 利用纳米收缩结构从合成反铁磁中图案化，通过自旋整流谱学技术，结合微磁模拟和宏自旋模拟，系统研究SOT驱动的反铁磁振荡动力学。
AI.result: 成功激发声学和光学SAF本征模；在自旋翻转转变附近观察到阈值电流以上的自旋整流峰，具有电流极性依赖和注入锁定特性；发现多峰、弱频率依赖的复杂非线性动力学响应。
AI.conclusion: SAF纳米收缩结构可作为研究电流驱动反铁磁振荡动力学的实验平台，为信号处理和储备池计算等非线性自旋电子学器件奠定基础。

title: Dyna-Mat: End-to-end benchmarking of foundation machine learning interatomic potentials in finite-temperature ensembles
summary: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are increasingly being used as drop-in replacements for first-principles calculations, enabling simulations of materials at length and time scales that were previously inaccessible. However, due to lack of ground truth data, their accuracy on structural and dynamical observables in finite thermodynamic ensembles is yet to be established. Here, we introduce Dyna-Mat-v1.0, a benchmark dataset of condensed-phase first-principles molecular dynamics trajectories designed to test foundation MLIPs at realistic finite-temperature conditions. Using this dataset, we evaluate 15 foundation MLIPs across four model tiers by comparing both single-point energy and force errors on first-principles configurations and observables generated from MLIP-driven trajectories. We find that "on average" models with lower single-point force errors also yield lower errors for structural and dynamical observables. However, there are individual systems for which low force errors lead to qualitative failures in the predicted structure. Pressure remains poorly described across most models, pointing to limitations in the density functional theory stress labels available in current large-scale training datasets. Finally, we construct an accuracy-cost Pareto frontier to identify the best trade-offs for molecular dynamics with foundation MLIPs, finding that the latest generation of cross-trained models is close to Pareto-optimal according to the accuracy metrics considered here. Overall, Dyna-Mat-v1.0 shows that end-to-end finite-temperature validation is essential for quantifying the predictive behaviour of foundation MLIPs, and provides a simple, scalable route for assessing them beyond static and harmonic benchmarks relevant to materials design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Dyna-Mat-v1.0基准数据集，用于在有限温度条件下评估基础机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）。通过评估15个MLIP模型，发现低力误差模型通常也能获得更好的结构/动力学可观测量，但存在例外；压力描述普遍较差；新一代交叉训练模型接近Pareto最优。
AI.motivation: 基础MLIPs被广泛用作第一性原理计算的替代方案，但由于缺乏真实数据，其在有限温度系综下结构/动力学可观测量的准确性尚未得到验证。
AI.method: 构建了Dyna-Mat-v1.0基准数据集（包含凝聚相第一性原理分子动力学轨迹），评估15个基础MLIPs（涵盖四个模型层级），比较单点能量/力误差以及MLIP驱动的轨迹可观测量。
AI.result: 1) 平均而言，低力误差模型对应更低的结构/动力学可观测量误差；2) 存在个别系统低力误差导致定性失败的案例；3) 压力描述普遍较差，归因于DFT应力标签的局限性；4) 新一代交叉训练模型接近Pareto最优。
AI.conclusion: 端到端的有限温度验证对于量化基础MLIPs的预测行为至关重要，Dyna-Mat-v1.0提供了一种超越静态和谐波基准的简单可扩展评估方法。

title: Nonlinear Hall effect in Floquet-driven monolayer 1T$'$-MoS$_2$
summary: We study the nonlinear Hall effect in Floquet-driven monolayer \(1T'\)-MoS\(_2\), a low-symmetry quantum spin Hall material whose tilted Dirac bands sustain an intrinsic Berry-curvature dipole without the need for strain or trigonal warping. We show that off-resonant circularly polarized light offers a way to control both the sign and the magnitude of the nonlinear Hall response through optically induced topological phase transitions using a Floquet effective Hamiltonian and nonlinear semiclassical transport theory. We show that the anisotropic crystal symmetry enforces a selection rule in which the Berry-curvature dipole elements satisfy $D_x\equiv0$, while a finite $D_y$ originates from the intrinsic band tilt. The Berry curvature is recreated in momentum space as the Floquet drive successively inverts individual spin-valley sectors, resulting in an identical sign reversal of the nonlinear Hall conductivity and the Berry-curvature dipole at each bulk gap closing. In contrast, tuning the band tilt modifies only the magnitude of the response without changing its sign, establishing the observed sign reversal as an unambiguous transport signature of genuine Floquet topological phase transitions. We further show that the nonlinear Hall response can be controlled by the driving strength, perpendicular electric field, Fermi energy, and temperature, providing multiple experimental knobs for observation. Our findings establish the sign of the nonlinear Hall response as a universal transport fingerprint of Floquet-engineered topology and point to monolayer \(1T'\)-MoS\(_2\) as a viable platform for all-electrical detection of nonequilibrium topological phases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Floquet驱动下单层1T'-MoS₂中的非线性霍尔效应，发现离共振圆偏振光可通过拓扑相变控制非线性霍尔响应的符号和大小，并揭示了Berry曲率偶极子的选择定则和符号反转作为Floquet拓扑相变输运指纹的机制。
AI.motivation: 探索在低对称性量子自旋霍尔材料1T'-MoS₂中，无需应变或三角翘曲即可存在的本征Berry曲率偶极子，并研究如何通过Floquet驱动实现非线性霍尔效应的光学调控，为检测非平衡拓扑相提供全电学手段。
AI.method: 采用Floquet有效哈密顿量和非线性半经典输运理论，分析离共振圆偏振光对体系拓扑性质的影响，研究Berry曲率偶极子在不同驱动条件下的变化规律。
AI.result: 发现各向异性晶体对称性导致Berry曲率偶极子D_x≡0，而有限D_y源于本征能带倾斜；Floquet驱动通过逐次翻转自旋-谷锁定区间的拓扑序，使非线性霍尔电导与Berry曲率偶极子在能隙闭合处同步符号反转；能带倾斜仅改变响应大小而不影响符号。
AI.conclusion: 非线性霍尔响应的符号是Floquet工程拓扑的普适输运指纹，单层1T'-MoS₂可作为全电学检测非平衡拓扑相的理想平台。

title: From Stacking Disorder to Cubic Order: Ice Crystallization from Deeply Supercooled Water
summary: Crystallization far from equilibrium can generate morphologies that defy classical crystal habits, yet the microscopic mechanisms linking atomic-scale disorder to emergent macroscopic order remain elusive. Here we use in situ cryogenic transmission electron microscopy with a membrane-encapsulated microdroplet platform to directly visualize the freezing of deeply supercooled water at molecular resolution. We show that homogeneous nucleation produces stacking-disordered ice composed of mixed hexagonal and cubic sequences, in which cubic ice initially exists only as isolated monolayers. The gradual thickening of these cubic layers constitutes the key kinetic mechanism that governs the entire crystallization pathway. As thickening proceeds, nanoscale, defect-free cubic ice germs nucleate on the basal planes of the disordered lattice. These faceted cubic germs act as facet-registered kinetic seeds that enforce cubic twinning and sequentially multiply growth branches. This kinetic pathway reproducibly generates robust eight-branched dendrites with global cubic (octahedral) symmetry, even though each branch remains highly stacking-disordered. At later stages, latent heat release drives a crossover to the thermodynamically favored hexagonal phase; remarkably, the pre-established global cubic symmetry is retained. These results reveal how strong kinetic driving forces convert microscopic disorder into emergent macroscopic symmetry, providing a general framework for understanding and controlling rapid crystallization far from equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文利用原位低温透射电镜结合膜封装微液滴平台，以分子分辨率直接观察深过冷水冻结过程，揭示了堆垛无序冰的成核与生长机制：均相成核产生混合六方/立方堆垛序列，立方层逐步增厚形成无缺陷立方晶种，进而通过面注册动力学种子诱导立方孪晶和分支增殖，最终生成具有八分支枝晶的宏观立方对称结构，即使在后期释放潜热向六方相转变时仍保留该对称性。
AI.motivation: 澄清远平衡结晶过程中微观原子尺度无序如何涌现为宏观有序形态这一长期未解之谜，特别是深过冷水均相成核的微观机制。
AI.method: 采用原位低温透射电镜(cryo-TEM)结合膜封装微液滴平台，以分子分辨率直接可视化观察深过冷水的冻结过程。
AI.result: 发现均相成核产生堆垛无序冰（混合六方和立方序列），立方冰初始仅为单分子层；立方层逐步增厚是控制整个结晶路径的关键动力学机制；在无序晶格的基面上成核出无缺陷立方冰晶种，这些晶种作为面注册动力学种子诱导立方孪晶并顺序增殖生长分支，最终产生具有八分支枝晶的全局立方（八面体）对称性；后期潜热释放驱动向热力学稳定的六方相转变，但预建立的全局立方对称性得以保留。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了强动力学驱动力如何将微观无序转化为涌现的宏观对称性，为理解和控制远平衡快速结晶提供了通用框架。

title: Spin-momentum locking of polariton edge states in honeycomb lattices
summary: Transverse-electric/Transverse-magnetic splitting in dielectric-mirror microcavities introduces an effective spin-orbit coupling for photons. While the bulk states remain linearly polarized, for exponentially localized edge states in a photonic lattice, this coupling induces elliptical polarization whose handedness is locked to the propagation direction, analogous to the transverse spin of evanescent electromagnetic waves. We reveal spin-momentum locking through Stokes polarimetry of zigzag edge states in a honeycomb exciton-polariton lattice. The effect persists in a stretched honeycomb supporting a photonic bandgap, where spin-polarized carrier injection enables selective lasing of either chiral edge states. Our results provide a route toward ultrafast spin-controlled unidirectional propagation in polariton systems without external magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 本文发现介电镜微腔中的TE/TM分裂会导致光子有效自旋-轨道耦合，使得光子晶格中指数衰减的边缘态出现椭圆极化，其手性与传播方向锁定（自旋-动量锁定）。在激子-极化子蜂窝晶格中通过Stokes偏振测量验证了该效应，并实现了无外磁场条件下的自旋控制单向激射。
AI.motivation: 探究介电镜微腔中TE/TM分裂引起的自旋-轨道耦合如何影响光子边缘态的极化特性，并探索无需外磁场即可实现自旋控制单向传播的物理机制。
AI.method: 构建激子-极化子蜂窝晶格，通过Stokes偏振测量分析zigzag边缘态的极化特性；利用拉伸蜂窝结构形成光子带隙，通过自旋极化载流子注入实现手性边缘态的选择性激射。
AI.result: 验证了边缘态的自旋-动量锁定：椭圆极化手性与传播方向绑定；在带隙结构中实现了自旋极化的选择性激射，可分别激发不同手性的边缘态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在极化子系统中实现超快自旋控制的单向传播提供了新路径，无需外加磁场即可操控光传播方向，对拓扑光子学和自旋光子学具有重要意义。

title: Physics adapted generative AI for metal insulator transition materials under label scarcity
summary: Metal-insulator-transition (MIT) materials are promising candidates for switchable electronics, neuromorphic hardware, and reconfigurable photonics, yet experimentally verified examples remain limited and the underlying mechanisms are often complex. We argue that generative AI for MIT discovery should move beyond the search for stable crystal structures alone and instead prioritize mechanism-informed phase-transition hypotheses. A modular physics-adapted framework, combined with staged verification of phase competition, electronic contrast, transition-pathway plausibility, and control accessibility, can guide credible discovery under severe label scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于生成式AI的金属-绝缘体相变（MIT）材料发现框架，强调应从单纯搜索稳定晶体结构转向机制驱动的相变假设生成，并通过模块化物理适配与分阶段验证（相竞争、电子对比、路径可行性、可控性）在标签稀缺条件下实现可信发现。
AI.motivation: 目前实验验证的MIT材料十分有限，且潜在机制复杂，现有的生成式AI方法仅关注稳定晶体结构搜索，忽视了相变机制的重要性。
AI.method: 提出一种模块化的物理适配框架，包含分阶段验证策略：相竞争分析、电子对比评估、转变路径合理性检验、控制可及性验证，从而在严重标签稀缺的情况下指导可信的材料发现。
AI.result: 该框架能够超越单纯结构搜索，生成机制优先的相变假设，并通过分阶段验证提升发现的可信度。
AI.conclusion: MIT材料的AI发现应优先考虑机制指导的相变假设，而非仅搜索稳定晶体结构；模块化物理适配与分阶段验证是解决标签稀缺问题的有效路径。

title: Morphology-Property Interplay in Chemo-Mechanics of Ion-Intercalation Active Particles
summary: Morphology, material property, and mechanical constraint jointly govern the chemo-mechanical behavior of ion-intercalation particles, yet their coupled effects remain insufficiently understood. Here we establish a thermodynamically consistent single-particle framework and combine analytical solutions with multiphysics simulations to determine how these factors regulate lithiation and stress generation. We study hollow spherical, cylindrical, and ellipsoidal particles with isotropic or transversely isotropic material properties under fully constrained, inner-free, or unconstrained boundary conditions. We show that the transient lithiation pathway and the associated stress and strain fields are governed not by morphology, property, or constraint alone, but by their coupled interaction: isotropic particles are sensitive to the mechanical constraint, whereas transversely isotropic particles exhibit persistent heterogeneous lithiation dominated by anisotropic diffusivity. Flux decomposition analysis reveals that the mechanical contribution to Li flux is negligible in spheres but dominant in ellipsoids. Correlation analysis further shows that Li concentration and volumetric strain exhibit strong anti-correlation in unconstrained particles but weak correlation under full constraints. Bayesian optimization of hollow ellipsoids identifies Pareto-optimal morphologies that balance lithiation capacity against peak tensile stress. These results provide a unified framework for the morphology-property interplay in intercalation particles and offer morphology design principles for chemo-mechanical stability.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个热力学一致的单粒子框架，结合解析解与多物理场模拟，研究了离子插层颗粒中形态、材料属性和机械约束对化学-机械行为的耦合作用，发现各因素并非独立调控锂化路径和应力应变场，而是通过耦合交互共同决定。贝叶斯优化识别出了平衡锂化容量与峰值拉伸应力的 Pareto 最优形态。
AI.motivation: 离子插层颗粒的化学-机械行为受形态、材料属性和机械约束共同调控，但其耦合效应尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 建立热力学一致的单粒子框架，结合解析解与多物理场模拟；采用通量分解分析、相关性分析以及贝叶斯优化方法。
AI.result: 各向同性颗粒对机械约束敏感，横观各向同性颗粒因各向异性扩散率表现出持续的非均匀锂化；机械通量在球体中可忽略，在椭球体中占主导；浓度与体积应变在无约束时强反相关，在全约束时弱相关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了形态-属性交互的统一框架，以及实现化学-机械稳定性的形态设计原则。

title: Phase-Factor-Controlled Interaction and Bonding between a Chiral Bobber and a Skyrmion String in the Conical Phase
summary: Skyrmion interactions govern the formation of skyrmion lattices, clusters, and particle-like growth patterns. In contrast, the interaction between a chiral bobber and a skyrmion string remains largely unexplored, despite the role of bobbers as intermediate states in skyrmion-string formation and annihilation. Here we show that this interaction is intrinsically phase dependent in the conical phase. Using three-dimensional micromagnetic simulations, we compute the locally relaxed constrained energy landscape as a function of the bobber--skyrmion separation $R$ and the surface phase factor $φ_0$. We find that changing $φ_0$ qualitatively reshapes the interaction, producing repulsive, attractive, and bonding-like regimes that cannot be reduced to a conventional distance-dependent potential. Real-space analysis shows that this behavior originates from phase-dependent reconstruction of nonaxisymmetric outer distortion shells. The phase-controlled interaction persists over a finite field range and follows the expected top--bottom phase relation of surface-sensitive conical textures. These results identify the conical phase direction, often hidden in projected or thickness-averaged descriptions, as a previously underappreciated degree of freedom in the interaction between skyrmion strings and finite-length chiral textures, as demonstrated here for chiral bobbers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三维微磁学模拟，发现手性磁泡（chiral bobber）与斯格明子弦（skyrmion string）之间的相互作用本质上是相位依赖的，不可简化为简单的距离势能，其中表面相位因子φ₀可调控排斥、吸引甚至键合-like的相互作用模式。
AI.motivation: 尽管斯格明子间的相互作用已被广泛研究，但手性磁泡作为斯格明子弦形成与湮灭的中间态，其与斯格明子弦的相互作用机制仍未被探索。
AI.method: 使用三维微磁学模拟，计算局域松弛约束能量景观随磁泡-斯格明子间距R和表面相位因子φ₀的变化。
AI.result: 改变φ₀可定性重塑相互作用，产生排斥、吸引和键合-like区域；该行为源于相位依赖的非轴对称外部畸变壳重构；相位控制的相互作用在有限磁场范围内持续，并遵循表面敏感锥形纹理的上下相位关系。
AI.conclusion: 锥形相方向（常被投影或厚度平均描述所隐藏）是斯格明子弦与有限长度手性纹理之间相互作用的一个先前被低估的自由度。

title: Beyond the Parasitic Limit: A Nanoprobing Framework for De-embedding Intrinsic Ferroelectric Properties at the Deep Sub-Micrometer Scale
summary: The continued scaling of ferroelectric devices is critical for next-generation computing architectures, yet it is fundamentally challenged by a metrological bottleneck: at the deep sub-micrometer scale, intrinsic material properties are heavily masked by extrinsic parasitic impedances and geometric fringing fields. Here, we introduce a quantitative, in-situ nanoprobing framework capable of resolving the true electrical response of ferroelectric capacitors down to 165 nm in diameter without the need for lithographic bond pads. Using 20 nm thick AlScN as a model system, we establish a non-linear 'Screened Power Law' model to decouple attofarad-level device capacitances from massive near-field probe interactions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the apparent degradation of dielectric loss at the nanoscale is a geometric dilution artifact, which we overcome through a conductance scaling analysis. Finally, we apply this framework to large-signal characterization, utilizing leakage-compensation and noise filtering protocols to extract pristine intrinsic hysteresis (C-V and J-E) loops in the discrete few-grain limit. These findings provide a universal analytical toolkit required to overcome the measurement limits of deep-submicron ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种定量原位纳米探测框架，能够在无需光刻焊盘的情况下解析直径小至165 nm的铁电电容器的真实电学响应，并通过“屏蔽幂律模型”、电导缩放分析及泄漏补偿等协议，克服了深亚微米尺度下铁电材料测量的寄生阻抗和几何边缘场干扰瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 铁电器件的持续微缩对下一代计算架构至关重要，但在深亚微米尺度下，本征材料特性被外部寄生阻抗和几何边缘场严重掩盖，存在计量学瓶颈，亟需一种能够分辨真实电学响应的定量方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出原位纳米探测框架，无需光刻焊盘；2) 以20 nm厚AlScN为模型系统，建立非线性“屏蔽幂律模型”解耦attofarad级器件电容与近场探针相互作用；3) 通过电导缩放分析克服纳米级介电损耗退化的几何稀释伪影；4) 利用泄漏补偿和噪声滤波协议提取本征大信号C-V和J-E磁滞回线。
AI.result: 成功实现了直径小至165 nm的铁电电容器的真实电学响应解析，在离散的少数晶粒极限下提取了纯净的本征磁滞回线，消除了寄生效应和几何稀释伪影的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一套通用的分析工具包，克服了深亚微米铁电体的测量极限，为铁电器件的继续微缩和下一代计算架构的发展奠定了基础。

title: Emergent Fermi polarons in Dirac materials
summary: We investigate band-structure effects on the absorption spectra of quantum impurities in Dirac materials. We uncover the formation of novel quasiparticles -- Dirac-Fermi polarons -- emerging from the dressing of impurities by excitations near the Dirac point. These quasiparticles are remarkably robust, persisting for both attractive and repulsive interactions, and across the full range of electron and hole doping. We show that their spectroscopic signature is a generic feature of Dirac materials, accessible with established techniques in both solid-state and ultracold atomic platforms. Our results establish polaron spectroscopy as a powerful probe of Dirac points at energies far from the Fermi surface, providing direct access to band-structure effects beyond conventional approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文研究狄拉克材料中量子杂质的吸收光谱，发现了新型准粒子——狄拉克-费米极化子，这些准粒子在吸引和排斥相互作用以及各种掺杂条件下都稳定存在，并展示了其光谱特征可作为探测狄拉克点的有力工具。
AI.motivation: 探究狄拉克材料中能带结构对量子杂质吸收光谱的影响，揭示超越传统方法的新物理现象。
AI.method: 通过理论分析狄拉克材料中杂质与狄拉克点附近激发之间的耦合，研究吸收光谱中的能带结构效应。
AI.result: 发现了狄拉克-费米极化子这一新型准粒子，其在吸引/排斥相互作用及各种掺杂条件下均稳定存在；光谱特征是狄拉克材料的通用特性，可在固态和超冷原子平台中观测。
AI.conclusion: 极化子光谱学可作为探测远离费米面的狄拉克点的有力工具，为研究能带结构效应提供了新途径。

title: Quasi-two-dimensional Majorana zero modes from finite-size-coupled chiral hinge states
summary: Majorana zero modes (MZMs) in topological superconductors have attracted broad research interest for their potential applications in topological quantum computation. In this work, we propose a quasi-two-dimensional route to realize spatially separated MZMs in a chiral higher-order topological insulator (HOTI) proximitized by a conventional $s$-wave superconductor through a theoretical model study. In three dimensions, the chiral HOTI hosts gapless hinge states along the $z$ direction, arising from a mass term that anisotropically gaps the surface Dirac cones of a topological insulator. By confining the sample along the $x$ direction while keeping it extended along $y$ and finite along $z$, opposite $z$-directed chiral hinge states hybridize and effectively form one-dimensional helical channels. Incorporating the superconducting proximity effect into this quasi-two-dimensional system induces effective $p$-wave pairing in these helical channels, thereby opening a topological gap. A fully open-boundary sample then hosts four localized MZMs, one at each endpoint of the helical channels, realizing a second-order topological superconductor characterized by Majorana corner modes. In addition to MZMs, we also find that superconducting pairing in this model produces extended Majorana hinge modes in three dimensions. Furthermore, representative disorder calculations indicate that these Majorana corner modes are robust against weak-to-moderate disorder, provided the excitation gap remains open. These results establish finite-size-coupled chiral hinge states as a promising platform for engineering multiple MZMs via conventional superconducting proximity effect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过将手性高阶拓扑绝缘体与传统s波超导体近邻耦合，在准二维体系中实现空间分离的马约拉纳零模。通过限制样品尺寸使手性铰链态杂化形成一维螺旋通道，超导近邻效应诱导有效p波配对，在开边界条件下产生四个局域马约拉纳零模（角态），并验证了其对中等强度无序的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 利用高阶拓扑绝缘体中的手性铰链态，通过有限尺寸耦合和超导近邻效应，构建准二维平台以实现多个空间分离的马约拉纳零模，为拓扑量子计算提供可扩展的物理实现方案。
AI.method: 理论模型研究：从三维手性高阶拓扑绝缘体出发，沿x方向限制样品使其准二维化，使沿z方向传播的相反手性铰链态杂化形成一维螺旋通道；引入s波超导近邻效应，在螺旋通道中诱导有效p波配对打开拓扑能隙；全开边界条件下，体系呈现二阶拓扑超导相，在螺旋通道端点产生四个局域马约拉纳零模。
AI.result: 1）在准二维有限尺寸样品中，通过手性铰链态杂化与超导近邻效应，成功实现了四个空间分离的马约拉纳零模（角态）；2）在三维体系中还发现了扩展的马约拉纳铰链模；3）无序计算表明，在激发能隙保持打开的条件下，这些马约拉纳角模对弱到中等强度无序具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 有限尺寸耦合的手性铰链态为通过常规超导近邻效应工程化多个马约拉纳零模提供了有前景的平台，该方法兼具可扩展性和对无序的鲁棒性，有望推动拓扑量子计算的实际应用。

title: Correlated-Electron Theory of Triplet-Triplet Multiexciton States in Polypentacene
summary: We present correlated-electron calculations of optical spin-singlet and triplet-triplet multiexciton states in three- and four-unit pentacene oligomers as microscopic models for polypentacene. The calculations use the Pariser-Parr-Pople Hamiltonian, multiple-reference singles and doubles configuration interaction, and a molecular exciton basis that resolves Frenkel, charge-transfer, and triplet-pair (T1T1) configurations in real space. We find that the complete set of 1(T1T1) eigenstates lies in a narrow, nearly degenerate energy window near the lowest optical exciton and that no eigenstate can be identified with a single localized triplet-pair configuration. Instead, each triplet-pair eigenstate is a quantum superposition of configurations containing all accessible intertriplet separations. This electronic structure explains the perceived absence of intramolecular triplet diffusion in pentacene oligomers, polypentacene, and polytetracene solutions, while leaving open the possibility of intermolecular singlet fission in films with appreciable interchain interactions.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过理论计算研究了并五苯低聚物中的光学自旋单重态和三重态-三重态多激子态，发现所有1(T1T1)本征态处于窄能量窗口内，不存在单一的局域化三重态对构型，而是所有可及间距的量子叠加态，这解释了为何在并五苯低聚物和聚合物溶液中观察不到分子内三重态扩散，同时为分子间单重态裂变留下可能性。
AI.motivation: 理解并五苯低聚物/聚合物中多激子态（尤其是三重态对态）的电子结构，解释实验上观测不到分子内三重态扩散的现象，并探讨单重态裂变机制的可能性。
AI.method: 采用Pariser-Parr-Pople哈密顿量、多参考单双激发组态相互作用（MRSDCI）以及分子激子基组，在实空间中分辨Frenkel、电荷转移和T1T1三重态对构型，对三单元和四单元并五苯低聚物进行关联电子计算。
AI.result: 完整的1(T1T1)本征态位于最低光学激子附近的一个窄近简并能量窗口内；没有本征态可被识别为单一局域化三重态对构型；每个三重态对本征态是所有可及间距构型的量子叠加态。
AI.conclusion: 这种量子叠加电子结构解释了并五苯低聚物、聚并五苯和聚并四苯溶液中分子内三重态扩散缺失的原因，同时为具有显著链间相互作用的薄膜中分子间单重态裂变保留了可能性。

title: Quantum Geometric Friedel Oscillations
summary: In conventional Friedel oscillations, the real-space charge density oscillations induced by an impurity are characterized by an oscillation period set by the Fermi momentum. In this work, we show that the conventional theory is incomplete when the Bloch wavefunctions carry nontrivial quantum geometry. We demonstrate that in metals with an isolated (nearly) flat band at the Fermi energy, quantum geometry induces a distinct type of oscillations, which we call the \emph{quantum geometric Friedel oscillations} (QGFOs). The period of the QGFOs is set by the momentum space separation of the quantum metric hot spots of the flat band. The conventional and quantum metric-induced oscillations coexist at low temperatures. At higher temperatures, the conventional Friedel oscillations away from the impurity site are set by the thermal length such that the oscillations can be easily washed out by temperature effects. Remarkably, the QGFOs decay length is set by the quantum metric length which is defined by the integration of the quantum metric of the flat band. As a result, the QGFOs can persist even at temperatures much larger than the bandwidth of the flat band. Moreover, the decay length is independent of temperature for a wide range of temperatures which is a manifestation of the quantum metric protection. In conclusion, we show that the quantum metric induces novel Friedel oscillations. Our work suggests that the measurement of the QGFOs is a powerful way to detect the quantum metric length (which is associated with the integral of the quantum metric) and the quantum metric hot spot separations (which are associated with the distribution of the quantum metric in the momentum space).

AI.tldr: 本文发现传统Friedel振荡理论在布洛赫波函数具有非平凡量子几何时不完备，并提出了一种由量子度量诱导的新型Friedel振荡（QGFOs），其周期由平带的量子度量热点在动量空间的分隔决定，衰减长度由量子度量长度决定，可在远高于平带宽度的温度下持续存在。
AI.motivation: 传统Friedel振荡理论忽略了布洛赫波函数的量子几何效应，作者希望揭示量子度量对杂质诱导电荷密度振荡的影响，并证明传统理论在量子几何非平凡时是不完备的。
AI.method: 作者在具有孤立（近乎）平带的金属体系中，通过分析量子度量热点在动量空间的分隔，理论推导出新型Friedel振荡（QGFOs），其周期由量子度量热点间距决定，衰减长度由量子度量长度（量子度量在动量空间的积分）决定。
AI.result: QGFOs的衰减长度由量子度量长度决定，不依赖温度（量子度量保护），可在远高于平带宽度的温度下持续存在，而传统Friedel振荡在高温下会被热效应抹除。两种振荡在低温下共存。
AI.conclusion: 量子度量诱导了新型Friedel振荡（QGFOs），测量QGFOs可有效探测量子度量长度和量子度量热点在动量空间的分隔。

title: Janus MgAlB_2 MBene: a dipole-engineered anode for ultrafast Li-ion transport and exceptional lithium storage
summary: In this work, we propose a group II/IIIA-based Janus MBene, MgAlB_2, and investigate its electrochemical properties using first-principles calculations. The substitution of one Mg layer in Mg_2B_2 MBene by an Al layer breaks the structural symmetry and generates a permanent out-of-plane polarization, giving rise to a distinct electronic environment compared with the parent Mg_2B_2 and Al_2B_2 monolayers. Electronic-structure analysis reveals enhanced orbital hybridization among B, Mg, and Al states near the Fermi level, resulting in improved electronic delocalization across the monolayer. The Janus MgAlB_2 monolayer is found to possess excellent dynamical, mechanical, and thermal stability. Owing to its polarization-modified energy landscape, Li ions migrate with an exceptionally low diffusion barrier of 17.1 meV, corresponding to a room-temperature diffusion coefficient of 3.43x10^-10 cm^2/s. Unlike the pristine Mg_2B_2 and Al_2B_2 monolayers, which support only a single stable adsorption layer, MgAlB_2 accommodates two complete Li layers. Detailed analysis shows that the residual polarization retained after first-layer lithiation continues to promote Li adsorption, whereas increasing Li-Li electrostatic interactions eventually limit further storage. As a result, the Janus monolayer delivers a high theoretical specific capacity of 1470.24 mAh/g together with a small volume expansion of only 3.7% during maximum lithiation. The present study demonstrates that intrinsic polarization can be utilized to regulate both the thermodynamics and kinetics of Li storage, providing a design strategy for high-rate and high-capacity two-dimensional electrode materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，提出了一种基于II/IIIA族的Janus型MBene材料MgAlB₂，利用其结构不对称性产生的永久面外极化，实现了低扩散势垒（17.1 meV）、高理论容量（1470.24 mAh/g）和低体积膨胀（3.7%）的优异锂存储性能。
AI.motivation: 探索如何利用材料内部的固有极化来同时调控锂存储的热力学和动力学性能，为设计高倍率、高容量的二维电极材料提供新策略。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算方法，构建Janus MgAlB₂单层结构，通过对比其与母体Mg₂B₂和Al₂B₂的电子结构、极化特性、锂离子扩散路径及多层吸附行为，系统评估其电化学性能。
AI.result: Janus MgAlB₂具有优异的动力学、机械和热稳定性；锂离子扩散势垒低至17.1 meV，室温扩散系数为3.43×10⁻¹⁰ cm²/s；可容纳两层锂，理论容量高达1470.24 mAh/g，体积膨胀仅3.7%。
AI.conclusion: 固有极化可用于有效调控锂存储的热力学和动力学行为，Janus结构设计是开发高性能二维电极材料的一种可行策略。

title: Tunable Nonlinear Landscapes in Graphene Nanoelectromechanical Systems
summary: Nonlinear nanomechanical resonators give convenient solid-state access to classical analogs of extreme nonlinear optics and to phononic signal processing. Here we report integer high-harmonic generation and phononic frequency combs in a suspended monolayer graphene drum. A gate voltage breaks the out-of-plane symmetry of the membrane and tunes its fundamental flexural mode onto a 1:2 internal resonance with a higher mode at twice the frequency, where the quadratic coupling between the two modes becomes large. A single drive tone then generates phase-locked integer harmonics in sequence, and at larger drive these fill in to a dense frequency comb. Raising the drive further, we find a reverse period-doubling transition: the comb spacing doubles, the line density halves, and energy flows back into the even-order comb lines. The measured spectra yield the quadratic ($ζ$) and cubic ($β$) nonlinear coefficients of the membrane. These results show how the tunable nonlinear landscape of graphene supports distinct dynamical regimes on demand, allowing a single gated device to act in turn as a frequency multiplier, a broadband comb source, and a chaotic generator.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在悬浮单层石墨烯鼓中实现整数高次谐波产生和声子频率梳，通过栅极电压调控可实现频率乘法器、宽带梳状源和混沌发生器等多种动力学模式。
AI.motivation: 探索非线性纳米机械谐振器中的极端非线性光学类比行为，以及声子信号处理的新机制。
AI.method: 利用栅极电压打破石墨烯膜的对称性，使其基频弯曲模式与高频模式形成1:2内共振，增强二次耦合，通过单驱动音调产生相位锁定的整数谐波序列。
AI.result: 观察到整数高次谐波产生、密集频率梳、反向周期倍增转变（梳间距加倍、线密度减半）等现象，并测得了膜的二次（ζ）和三次（β）非线性系数。
AI.conclusion: 石墨烯可调谐的非线性景观支持按需切换不同的动力学状态，单个栅控器件可分别作为频率倍增器、宽带梳状源和混沌发生器使用。

title: First-principles study of the electronic structure and optical properties of two-dimensional $α$-graphdiyne
summary: The structural, electronic, and optical properties of monolayer $α$-graphdiyne ($α$-GDY) are systematically investigated using density-functional theory within the plane-wave pseudopotential formalism. The electronic band structure reveals a gapless Dirac crossing at the K point, demonstrating the Dirac semimetallic character of the monolayer. The calculated total and orbital-projected density of states show that the electronic states near the Fermi level are dominated by the carbon $2p$ orbitals, while the contribution of the $2s$ orbitals is comparatively weak. The optical response exhibits pronounced polarization dependence. The in-plane dielectric function displays a strong Drude-like response and negative values of the real dielectric function at low photon energies, whereas the out-of-plane component remains positive throughout the investigated energy range. Consistently, the absorption coefficient, extinction coefficient, reflectivity, and electron energy-loss spectra reveal a pronounced optical anisotropy. The calculated plasma frequencies are approximately $3.21$~eV for the in-plane polarization and $1.06$~eV for the out-of-plane polarization, indicating substantially stronger collective electronic excitations within the atomic plane. These findings demonstrate that $α$-GDY combines Dirac-like electronic behavior with highly anisotropic optical properties, highlighting its potential for polarization-sensitive optoelectronic, plasmonic, and nanoelectronic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，系统研究了单层α-石墨二炔（α-GDY）的结构、电子和光学性质，发现其具有狄拉克半金属特性和显著的各向异性光学响应，适用于偏振敏感光电子和等离子体器件。
AI.motivation: 探索单层α-GDY作为一种新型二维碳同素异形体的电子结构和光学性质，评估其在光电子、等离子体和纳米电子器件中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 采用基于平面波赝势形式的第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT），计算了单层α-GDY的能带结构、态密度（总态密度和轨道投影态密度）、介电函数、吸收系数、消光系数、反射率、电子能量损失谱（EELS）以及等离子体频率。
AI.result: 1）能带在K点出现无带隙的狄拉克交叉，表现狄拉克半金属特性；2）费米面附近电子态主要由C-2p轨道贡献，2s轨道贡献较弱；3）面内介电函数呈现强Drude响应，低能区介电函数实部为负值，面外分量则始终为正；4）面内和面外等离子体频率分别为~3.21 eV和~1.06 eV，表现出显著的光学各向异性。
AI.conclusion: α-GDY兼具狄拉克半金属的电子行为和高度各向异性的光学性质，在偏振敏感光电子学、等离子体学和纳米电子学领域具有重要的应用前景。

title: Observation of Non-linear hall effect in Polycrystalline magnetic multilayes
summary: The Nonlinear Hall effect(NLHE) driven principally by the Berry curvature dipole has been established in non-centrosymmetric vander Waals crystals, topological semimetals, and moiré superlattices, but its extension to technologically mature heavy-metal/ferromagnet multilayer platforms remains largely unexplored. Here, we report the observation of a robust NLHE in polycrystalline magnetic multilayers, persisting from 2 K to room temperature. The second-harmonic transverse voltage is independent of both excitation frequency and applied out-of-plane magnetic field, while the vanishingly small third-harmonic response confirms that the observed signal is not dominated by a quantum-metric contribution and instead reflects a genuine second-order electronic response. A scaling analysis of the second-order Hall conductivity against the longitudinal conductivity identifies a dominant, conductivity-independent term establishing the intrinsic berry curvature dipole. Our theoretical analysis, supported by first-principles DFT calculations, further satisfies and corroborates the experimental results. These results establish sputter-deposited polycrystalline thin film as the first engineered magnetic multilayer platform for BCD-driven nonlinear Hall transport, extending the NLHE material landscape beyond van der Waals systems into scalable, industry-compatible thin-film spintronic architectures suitable for high frequency rectifications and nonlinear sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文在溅射沉积的多晶磁性多层膜中观测到了稳健的非线性霍尔效应（NLHE），证明其由贝里曲率偶极子（BCD）驱动，将该效应从范德华体系拓展至工业兼容的薄膜自旋电子学平台。
AI.motivation: 非线性霍尔效应（NLHE）已在非中心对称范德华晶体、拓扑半金属和莫尔超晶格中建立，但尚未在技术成熟的金属/铁磁体多层膜平台中得到验证，作者希望探索其在该体系中的存在。
AI.method: 在2K至室温范围内测量多晶磁性多层膜的二阶谐波横向电压，分析其对激励频率和外磁场的依赖性，通过三阶谐波响应排除量子度量贡献，并结合二阶霍尔电导率与纵向电导率的标度分析及第一性原理DFT计算进行验证。
AI.result: 观察到从2K到室温均稳健的NLHE信号；二阶谐波横向电压不依赖激励频率和外磁场；三阶谐波响应可忽略，证实信号源于本征BCD而非量子度量贡献；标度分析显示主导项与电导率无关，确认为本征贝里曲率偶极子；DFT计算结果与实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作将BCD驱动的NLHE材料版图从范德华体系拓展至可规模化、工业兼容的多晶薄膜自旋电子学架构，为高频整流和非线性传感器等应用提供了新平台。

title: Atomistic study of finite temperature properties in ferroelectric BiAlO$_3$
summary: The lead-free perovskite ferroelectrics captivate researchers with their unique functional properties leading to important technological applications. In the search for a new lead-free perovskite of technological importance, we develop a first-principles based atomistic model to accurately predict the properties of BiAlO$_3$ in experimentally relevant conditions. Consistent with the experimental observations, our simulations predict a rhombohedral ferroelectric ($R3c$) ground state for BiAlO$_3$ facilitated by a structural phase transition from paraelectric (cubic, $Pm\Bar{3}m$) phase. The room-temperature spontaneous polarization and Curie temperature are obtained to be 81 $μ$C/cm$^2$ (along [111] direction) and 1160 K, respectively. Our simulations reveal strong coupling between ferroelectric and antiferrodistortive modes for a broad spectrum of temperature and electric field. We find that hydrostatic pressure suppresses both spontaneous polarization and Curie temperature, while both uniaxial and biaxial stresses induce multiple phase transitions in BiAlO$_3$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理原子模型预测了无铅钙钛矿BiAlO₃在实验相关条件下的性质，发现其菱方铁电（R3c）基态，室温自发极化约81 μC/cm²，居里温度约1160 K，并揭示了铁电与反铁畸变模式的强耦合以及不同应力诱导的多相变行为。
AI.motivation: 寻找具有重要技术应用前景的新型无铅钙钛矿材料，研究BiAlO₃的关键性质以指导实验。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理的原子模型，在实验相关条件下预测BiAlO₃的性能，模拟结构相变、极化、居里温度等。
AI.result: BiAlO₃基态为菱方铁电相（R3c），室温自发极化81 μC/cm²（[111]方向），居里温度1160 K；存在强铁电-反铁畸变耦合；静水压抑制极化与居里温度，单轴和双轴应力诱导多相变。
AI.conclusion: BiAlO₃具有优异的高温铁电性能，其多场耦合特性为无铅铁电器件设计提供了新思路。

title: On the $\mathrm{In_{x}Ga_{1-x}As}$ channel noise in InP HEMTs from 4 K to 300 K
summary: The InP high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) is indispensable for low-noise amplifiers (LNAs) in radio astronomy and quantum computing. The composition of the $\mathrm{In_{x}Ga_{1-x}As}$ channel in InP HEMT is known to influence the LNA noise performance. However, the various physical mechanisms responsible for noise generation are not fully characterized and understood. Here, we investigate the $\mathrm{In_{x}Ga_{1-x}As}$ channel noise from 4 K to 300 K for 100-nm gate-length InP HEMTs with channel indium content of 53\%, 60\% and 70\%. Channel noise was quantified by extracting the equivalent drain noise temperature $\mathit{T}_{d}$ using both on-wafer and LNA-based measurements, covering 40-300 K and 4-40 K, respectively. The 60\% indium channel InP HEMT exhibited the lowest channel noise across the full temperature range. The $\mathit{T}_{d}$ extracted from on-wafer characterization was found to obey a parabolic temperature dependence which predicted the $\mathit{T}_{d}$ at 4 K for all InP HEMTs in good agreement with LNA-based measurements. By expressing the channel noise as the sum of one thermal and one excess noise term, it was found that the former increased linearly with ambient temperature and dominated at 300 K. The channel noise at 4 K was determined by the excess noise term and exhibited a non-monotonic dependence on the channel indium content in the InP HEMT. The results suggest that the excess noise in the InP HEMT originates not only from temperature-independent shot noise but also from impact ionization and real-space transfer noise.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了不同铟含量（53%、60%、70%）的InP HEMT器件在4K至300K温度范围内的沟道噪声特性，发现60%铟含量器件在全部温度范围内噪声最低，并将沟道噪声分解为热噪声和过剩噪声两部分，其中4K下的噪声主要由过剩噪声决定，且过剩噪声来源于散粒噪声、碰撞电离和实空间转移噪声。
AI.motivation: InP HEMT是射电天文学和量子计算中低噪声放大器的关键器件，其沟道InGaAs层的铟含量会影响噪声性能，但噪声产生的物理机制尚未被充分表征和理解，因此需要系统研究不同铟含量下沟道噪声的温度依赖特性。
AI.method: 制备了栅长100 nm、沟道铟含量分别为53%、60%和70%的InP HEMT器件，通过片上测试（40-300 K）和LNA基测试（4-40 K）提取等效漏极噪声温度Td，并将沟道噪声分解为热噪声和过剩噪声两项进行分析。
AI.result: 60%铟含量器件在全部温度范围内表现出最低的沟道噪声；片上测试提取的Td服从抛物线温度依赖关系，能准确预测4K下的Td；热噪声随环境温度线性增加，在300K时占主导；4K下噪声由过剩噪声决定，且过剩噪声随铟含量呈非单调变化。
AI.conclusion: InP HEMT中的过剩噪声不仅来源于与温度无关的散粒噪声，还与碰撞电离和实空间转移噪声有关，这为优化InP HEMT在低温下的噪声性能提供了物理依据。

title: Strain- and potential-controlled tunneling in monolayer MoS$_2$
summary: We present a theoretical study of spin- and valley-resolved quantum transport in monolayer MoS$_2$ under the combined influence of mechanical strain and an external scalar potential, a combination whose simultaneous unexplored. Within an effective massive Dirac Hamiltonian that incorporates intrinsic spin--orbit coupling, strain induces valley-dependent momentum shifts that lift the degeneracy between the $K$ and $K'$ valleys and strongly modify the transport characteristics. The scalar potential modifies the tunneling spectrum, leading to pronounced changes in resonant transmission, Fabry--Pérot interference, and conductance. We show that the interplay between strain and electrostatic potential enables efficient control of both valley and spin polarization of the transmitted current. In particular, we identify a dual-knob control scheme in which the barrier width governs the frequency of conductance oscillations while strain independently controls their phase and amplitude. Furthermore, we predict electrostatic spin inversion -- a sign reversal of spin polarization achievable purely by gate tuning at finite strain, requiring no geometric reconfiguration. Depending on the strain orientation, the transmission probability and conductance can be selectively suppressed or enhanced, resulting in highly tunable valley- and spin-polarized transport. These findings demonstrate that strain and potential engineering provide orthogonal and independently operable mechanisms for controlling conductance as well as spin and valley degrees of freedom in monolayer MoS$_2$, offering promising prospects for spintronic and valleytronic device applications.

AI.tldr: 本文理论上研究了单层MoS₂中机械应变与标量势共同作用下的自旋和谷分辨量子输运，发现应变和电势能独立控制自旋/谷极化，并提出静电自旋反转机制。
AI.motivation: 此前尚未探索机械应变与标量势同时作用下MoS₂的自旋-谷分辨量子输运特性，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用有效大质量狄拉克哈密顿量模型，引入本征自旋-轨道耦合，在应变和标量势共同作用下分析隧穿谱、共振传输、Fabry-Pérot干涉及电导。
AI.result: 应变控制振荡相位与振幅，势垒宽度控制振荡频率；发现静电自旋反转现象；应变方向可选择性增强或抑制传输概率和电导。
AI.conclusion: 应变与电势工程可正交、独立地操控MoS₂单层的电导及自旋/谷自由度，为自旋电子学和谷电子学器件应用提供新思路。

title: Surface Functionalization Enables Two-Dimensional Altermagnetism and Giant Tunnel Magnetoresistance
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) altermagnets (AMs) are highly desirable for ultrafast, stray-field-free spintronics because they combine compensated magnetic order and momentum-dependent spin splitting with the scalability, tunability, and interface compatibility of atomically thin materials. However, practical 2D AMs remain scarce. Rather than relying solely on the search for intrinsic 2D AMs, an appealing route is to transform known 2D antiferromagnets (AFMs) into AMs through symmetry engineering. Here, we propose surface functionalization as a symmetry-guided, nonvolatile chemical switch for realizing this AFM-to-AM transformation. By breaking inversion and out-of-plane mirror symmetries while preserving the rotation symmetry connecting opposite-spin sublattices, single-sided functionalization lifts spin degeneracy and induces altermagnetic spin splitting. Using monolayer FeSe as a representative platform, first-principles calculations show that hydrogenation, oxidation, and fluorination convert spin-degenerate antiferromagnetic FeSe into a d-wave AM with pronounced momentum-dependent spin splitting. At the device level, our transport simulations reveal that the functionalized FeSe monolayer magnetic tunnel junctions exhibit giant tunnel magnetoresistance (TMR) up to $1.87\times10^3\%$, originating from momentum-selective spin filtering between parallel and antiparallel Néel-vector configurations. The strong dependence of TMR on functionalization geometry further demonstrates that surface chemistry provides an effective control knob for altermagnetic transport. Our work establishes a symmetry-to-chemistry-to-device strategy for engineering 2D AMs and developing high-performance altermagnetic spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过表面功能化（如氢化、氧化、氟化）将已知二维反铁磁体（如单层FeSe）转化为d波交替磁体，实现高达1.87×10³%的隧穿磁电阻，为二维交替磁体自旋电子学提供了对称性-化学-器件的工程策略。
AI.motivation: 二维交替磁体兼具补偿磁序与动量依赖的自旋分裂，但实用材料稀缺。作者希望通过对称性工程将已知二维反铁磁体转化为交替磁体，而非仅寻找本征材料。
AI.method: 提出表面单侧功能化作为对称性引导的非易失性化学开关：通过打破反演和面外镜像对称性，同时保持连接相反自旋子格的旋转对称性，实现反铁磁到交替磁体的转变。以单层FeSe为例，采用第一性原理计算研究氢化、氧化、氟化处理。
AI.result: 表面功能化成功将自旋简并的反铁磁FeSe转化为d波交替磁体，具有显著的动量依赖自旋分裂。器件模拟显示，功能化FeSe单层磁隧道结的隧穿磁电阻高达1.87×10³%，源于平行与反平行Néel矢量构型间的动量选择性自旋过滤。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一种对称性-化学-器件的二维交替磁体工程策略，并展示了表面化学可作为调控交替磁体输运特性的有效手段，为高性能交替磁体自旋电子学器件开发提供了新路径。

title: Local Defects and the Topology of the Haldane Model
summary: We investigate the interplay between local defects and topology in the Haldane model within the framework of the tenfold classification. The Haldane model realizes a Chern-insulating phase characterized by an integer topological invariant ($C=\pm 1$) and supports chiral edge states. Introducing vacancies gives rise to localized states at the defect sites, classified by a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariant $ν= C\cdot m,\mathrm{mod},2$, where $m=N_A-N_B$ is the net sublattice imbalance of the vacancy configuration: an odd imbalance hosts a protected zero-energy mode, whereas an even imbalance does not. We identify three independent experimental signatures that distinguish these topological defect states from trivial (adatom) defects. First, vacancy-induced states exhibit characteristic dislocations in their wavefunction profiles that track the phase winding associated with the defect. Second, a fractional charge of $e/2$ accumulates at vacancy sites, while no such charge appears at adatoms. Third, the probability current circulating around a vacancy-induced state flows in the opposite direction to that of chiral edge states, in direct analogy with the current reversal produced by a vortex in a $p$-wave superconductor. All three signatures are in quantitative agreement with the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文在十重分类框架下研究Haldane模型中的局域缺陷与拓扑的相互作用，发现空位缺陷产生受$\mathbb{Z}_2$拓扑保护的零能模，并识别出三种区别于平凡缺陷的实验特征：波函数位错、$e/2$分数电荷积累、以及环绕缺陷的概率流方向反转。
AI.motivation: 探究Haldane模型中局域缺陷（空位）如何与拓扑相相互作用，以及如何通过实验特征区分拓扑缺陷态与平凡缺陷态。
AI.method: 基于十重分类框架，在Haldane模型中引入空位缺陷，利用$\mathbb{Z}_2$不变量$\nu = C \cdot m \mod 2$对缺陷态分类，并通过波函数、分数电荷和概率流三种手段分析其拓扑性质。
AI.result: 1. 空位缺陷可产生受$\mathbb{Z}_2$保护的零能模（当子晶格不平衡$m$为奇数时）；2. 缺陷态波函数呈现特征性位错；3. 空位处积累$e/2$分数电荷；4. 缺陷周围概率流方向与手征边界态相反。
AI.conclusion: 空位缺陷在Haldane模型中诱导出拓扑缺陷态，三种实验特征与$\mathbb{Z}_2$理论预测定量吻合，为区分拓扑缺陷与平凡缺陷提供了可观测的判据。

title: Electronic Structure, Optical Response, Thermal and Mechanical Behavior of B6X (X = S, Se) under Pressure: A Comprehensive Ab-initio Exploration
summary: This study presents a comprehensive investigation of the pressure dependent structural, electronic, optical, mechanical, and bonding properties of orthorhombic boron rich chalcogenides B6S and B6Se. Calculations were performed using density functional theory across a wide range of hydrostatic pressures. The computed elastic constants, bulk, Young, shear moduli, and Poisson ratio, revealed mechanical robustness and strong resistance to deformation, even under significant compression. Electronic band structure and density of states analyses indicate that the materials exhibit indirect bandgap semiconducting behavior. Optical results reveal clear pressure induced spectral shifts, particularly in the visible and ultraviolet regions, suggesting modified light matter interaction under compression. Phonon dispersion curves verified the dynamical stability of both materials within the investigated pressure range. Hardness estimations, combined with elastic parameters, and melting temperatures, further indicate that B6S and B6Se possess significant mechanical strength suitable for applications under harsh environments. The thermal properties suggest that both these compounds possess features suitable to be used as excellent thermal barrier coating materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用密度泛函理论研究了三斜相硼基硫族化合物B6S和B6Se在高压下的结构、电子、光学、力学和成键性质。结果表明两者均为间接带隙半导体，具有优异的力学强度、动态稳定性，且在高压下光学性质发生显著变化，适合用作热障涂层材料。
AI.motivation: 探索硼基硫族化合物B6S和B6Se在高压下的综合物理性质，评估其在极端环境下（如热障涂层）的应用潜力。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，在宽泛的静水压力范围内，分析结构、电子能带、态密度、光学性质、力学参数（弹性常数、模量、泊松比）、声子色散和热力学性质。
AI.result: （1）材料表现为间接带隙半导体；（2）弹性常数和模量显示优异的力学强度和抗变形能力；（3）光学性质出现明显的压力诱导光谱位移（可见光和紫外区）；（4）声子色散证实了动力学稳定性；（5）硬度、弹性参数和熔化温度表明具备极端环境下应用的力学强度；（6）热性能表明适合用作热障涂层材料。
AI.conclusion: B6S和B6Se在高压下保持结构稳定，力学性能优良，光学性质可调，热性能优越，是潜在的优异热障涂层材料，适用于恶劣环境。

title: A Unified Electrostatic-to-Spin Framework for Asymmetric Multi-Gate CMOS Quantum Devices
summary: In advanced complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) quantum chips, compact gate stacks make it difficult to connect lithographic geometry, electrostatic confinement and many-electron spin filling in one transparent model. This connection is central to design-technology co-optimization (DTCO). Here we develop a reduced-order analytical framework for asymmetric multigate silicon quantum-dot devices. Its electrostatic core, the Poisson-kernel coupled-interface Green-function (PK-GF) model, agrees with an independent finite-volume solution at the millivolt scale for the matched two-dimensional problem, without fitting to that solution. We then pass the gate-derived confinement, rather than a harmonic or fitted potential, to a spin-valley many-body calculation for a jellybean quantum dot with N = 2-17 electrons at B = 5 T. The unrestricted Hartree-Fock (UHF) solution supports occupation-dependent, Wigner-molecule-like charge localization but likely overestimates spin polarization. Complete active-space configuration interaction (CASCI) supports a low-spin branch within the tested active spaces, which aligns with the experiments. The workflow therefore connects CMOS layout, device electrostatics, and potential-determined quantum observables, providing an auditable modelling layer for CMOS-based qubit design and DTCO.

AI.tldr: 本文针对先进CMOS量子芯片中紧凑栅极堆叠难以统一描述光刻几何、静电约束和多电子自旋填充的问题，开发了一种非对称多栅硅量子点器件的降阶解析框架。其静电核心PK-GF模型与独立有限体积解在毫伏尺度吻合，并将栅极约束直接传递给包含2-17个电子的自旋-谷多体计算。UHF方法支持类维格纳分子电荷局域化但高估自旋极化，CASCI在测试活性空间内支持低自旋分支，与实验一致。该工作流连接了CMOS布局、器件静电和量子可观测量，为CMOS量子比特设计提供了可审计的建模层。
AI.motivation: 在先进CMOS量子芯片中，紧凑栅极堆叠使得光刻几何、静电约束和多电子自旋填充难以在一个透明模型中统一描述，而这种连接对设计-技术协同优化（DTCO）至关重要。现有研究缺乏一个能同时连接这三者的解析框架。
AI.method: 开发了非对称多栅硅量子点器件的降阶解析框架：1) 静电核心采用Poisson-kernel耦合界面格林函数（PK-GF）模型，与二维有限体积解在毫伏尺度一致；2) 将栅极约束（而非谐波或拟合势）传递给包含N=2-17个电子、B=5T条件下的"果冻豆"量子点自旋-谷多体计算；3) 分别采用UHF和CASCI方法求解。
AI.result: PK-GF模型与有限体积解在毫伏尺度吻合；UHF支持依赖占据数的类维格纳分子电荷局域化但高估自旋极化；CASCI在测试活性空间内支持低自旋分支，与实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流成功连接了CMOS布局、器件静电和势决定量子可观测量，为基于CMOS的量子比特设计和DTCO提供了可审计的建模层。

title: Lindblad theory of linear response susceptibility and dispersive readout in minimal Kitaev junctions
summary: The field of hybrid superconductor-semiconductor quantum dots is advancing toward the development of functional devices that leverage the advantages of both types of materials. However, the inherent complexity of these devices demands a comprehensive theoretical framework for a complete understanding of their responses to external probes, readout and the dissipation arising from environmental coupling. We present a Lindblad-based linear response formalism that captures the multi-level nature of these devices, their probe-readout flexibility, and the non-unitary effects of finite-frequency response, including the so-called Sisyphus and Hermes dynamical susceptibilities. These arise from fluctuations in the rates and jump operators, and are hence absent in standard Kubo linear response treatments. We exemplify the framework using quantum dot-based Kitaev chain setups which are promising candidates for topologically protected Majorana-based parity qubits. Our results shed light onto the validity of the standard curvature-based approximation for fermionic parity and qubit readout, show that Hermes terms compensate decoherence in dispersive readout and implement important corrections beyond thermalized states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于Lindblad方程的线性响应理论框架，用于理解混合超导-半导体量子点器件中的多能级响应、探测读出及环境耦合导致的耗散效应，并揭示了Sisyphus和Hermes动力学响应机制在标准Kubo理论中被忽略的重要性。
AI.motivation: 混合超导-半导体量子点器件正朝着功能化方向发展，但其固有的复杂性需要一个全面的理论框架来理解对外部探针的响应、读出以及环境耦合引起的耗散。现有标准Kubo线性响应理论无法捕捉有限频率响应中的非幺正效应（如Sisyphus和Hermes动力学响应）。
AI.method: 提出基于Lindblad方程的线性响应形式，该形式能够捕捉器件的多能级特性、探针读出的灵活性以及有限频率响应中的非幺正效应（包括rate和jump operator涨落导致的Sisyphus和Hermes动力学响应）。以量子点Kitaev链装置为例进行验证。
AI.result: 揭示了标准曲率近似在费米子奇偶性和量子比特读出中的有效性边界；发现Hermes项可以补偿色散读出中的退相干效应；在热化态之外实现了重要修正。
AI.conclusion: 该理论框架为理解和优化混合超导-半导体量子点器件（特别是基于Majorana的奇偶性量子比特）的响应和读出提供了更准确的理论基础，超越了标准Kubo理论和曲率近似的局限。

title: Tellurium sublattice instability driven amorphization in the chalcogenide AgSbTe2 under pressure
summary: Pressure provides a powerful thermodynamic route to access hidden structural states in functional materials, yet the microscopic origin of pressure-induced amorphization remains elusive in many complex chalcogenides. Here we report a detailed high-pressure structural study of AgSbTe2,combining synchrotron X-ray diffraction with density functional theory and molecular dynamics calculations up to 60 GPa. We uncover a pressure-driven transformation from the ambient R-3m phase to a fully disordered cubic Im3m phase, through an extended intermediate amorphous state. Enthalpy calculations reveal a near-degeneracy between the R3m and Im3m structures over a broad pressure range, dictating amorphization. Contrary to previously speculated cation vacancies, the amorphization is governed by a pronounced displacement instability of the Te sublattice.
